Traditionally, black-box ML models are very good at prediction, though often lack transparency, making it hard for stakeholders to understand and build trust in. Explainable models present how each feature contributes to the prediction This transparency enhances trust among coastal managers and policymakers. It aids better decision-making by explaining the drivers of erosion to users. Interpretable models thus help the stakeholders to focus mitigation efforts with directed attention on their part, which helps in ensuring sustainable coastal management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Public Health through Five Transfer Learning Model for Face Mask Detection Systems
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has highlighted the critical importance of face masks in mitigating virus transmission. This research investigates the application of deep learning techniques to develop an automated face mask detection system. By leveraging intelligent algorithms and machine learning, the system aims to accurately and efficiently identify the presence of face masks in real time using security cameras and other imaging technologies. Various neural network architectures, including ConvNet, InceptionV3, MobileNet, DenseNet, and VGG19, were evaluated for their performance in detecting face masks. Our results indicate that advanced models like InceptionV3, MobileNet, DenseNet, and VGG19 consistently outperform simpler architectures, with InceptionV3 achieving the highest accuracy. This study underscores the potential of deep learning in enhancing public health measures, ensuring compliance with mask mandates, and providing valuable data for policy formulation and resource allocation.

articleTitle: Unmasking the Illusion: A Novel Approach for Detecting Deep Fakes using Video Vision Transformer Architecture
abstract: Deepfakes are fake images, videos, audio, and text content that appear to be real. They are now easier than ever to create because of different AI tools. They aregenerally legal and have legitimate applications in many areas, but now a days they are commonly used for exploitation. Anyone can use deepfake tools to create fakevideos or images that spread misinformation, harass andintimidate others, and ultimately ruin people’s lives. Facial mapping technologies are used by Cyber criminals to create an accurate facial symmetry data set. They swapthe face of a person on to the face of another person. To tackle this problems, we propose this Deepfake Detection System. Key feature of our model is to classify the given input video into real or fake class. Our model will detect weather the given video is real one or is generated (manipulated) by deepfake generation techniques. Existing methodology related to deepfake detection involves various techniques. Currently, existing detection systems are using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) as a backbone, artificial neural networks (ANN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) algorithms. Each having its own benefits, drawbacks and related accuracy.We are trying to integrate two of these techniques i.e, Convolutional Neural Network and Vision Transformer. Basic aim to integrate or merge two techniques is to modify or increase the accuracy of model.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Singularity Detection Theory in Fault Diagnosis of Relay Protection Device in Power System
abstract: This paper discusses the principle of applying wavelet analysis and calculating Lip index, which is helpful to evaluate the intensity of signal anomaly. Then illustrate the voltage with actual measurement and current signals. This example illustrates how the wavelet transform is performed in detecting abnormal signals. Finally, this method is applied to the relay protection fault detection of power system, simplifying the calculation process of Lip index and singularity, and obtain relatively ideal results.

articleTitle: Compact AMC Antenna for Terrestrial Earth Exploration, Meteorological Satellites
abstract: The compact antenna design, utilizing the active metamaterial concept (AMC), caters to the needs of terrestrial earth exploration and meteorological satellites. With a growing demand for high-performance, miniaturized antennas capable of wideband operations, this innovation responds by proposing an antenna that maximizes electromagnetic properties through active metamaterials, achieving superior performance in a reduced form factor. Integrating an inventive active element with metamaterial-inspired structures, this antenna exhibits unconventional electromagnetic behaviors surpassing traditional passive antennas’ limitations. By embedding active components within the metamaterial framework, it dynamically manipulates its electromagnetic response, enabling frequency agility, beam steering, and adaptable radiation patterns. Operating within the X -band range of $8-11.5 \mathrm{GHz}$, this antenna’s compact size renders it suitable for deployment in space-restricted environments aboard meteorological satellites. Moreover, leveraging AMC materials, the antenna’s gain increases significantly from 2.97 dB to 5.92 dB, while directivity escalates from 4 dB to 5.14 dB. Notably, the AMC unit cell achieves an impressive return loss of -22 dB. These enhancements contribute to improved data acquisition and signal processing capabilities for earth exploration applications, amplifying the antenna’s effectiveness in remote sensing and weather monitoring missions.

articleTitle: Asynchronous SRAM: Towards Energy-Efficient Solutions
abstract: This paper focuses on design and implementation of an asynchronous SRAM system utilizing memory banking techniques on a 45 nm technology. This system comprises four 16KB SRAM and a 2 -to- $\mathbf{4}$ decoder, collectively forming a 64 KB memory space. The asynchronous nature of SRAM allows for independent read and write operations, enhancing speed and efficiency crucial for various applications. The 2-to-4 decoder facilitates memory bank selection based on address lines, enabling seamless access to desired memory locations. Chip select, output enable, and write enable signals control memory operations, ensuring data integrity and efficient power usage. Power distribution analysis reveals that the leakage power with the effectiveness of memory banking(64 KB) in reducing power consumption compared to the single-block design (16KB). The simulation results and power distribution analysis, the study demonstrates the effectiveness of memory banking techniques in reducing leakage power.

articleTitle: Prompt-Instructed Generative based AI for Enhancing Transformer effectiveness Analysis
abstract: This research study explored the usage of PromptInstructed generative based AI to enhance the computation of transformer performance analysis. By employing a futuristic generative-based framework, the research defines a novelty methodology that may automatically generate detailed performance-based reports referencing a Predefined prompt. The research framework manipulates the transformer-based models over different parameters like accuracy level, computational efficacy, and adaptability to diverged datasets. The findings indicated a significant advancement in model manipulation accuracy level by reducing manual type analysis time by $\mathbf{3 0 \%}$. Additionally, the current approach identified critical performance bottlenecks by offering actionable insights for the optimization process. Henceforth, the proposed approach aims to streamline the manipulation process cycle by providing combustive tools for practitioners to improve the efficacy and reliability of the transformer.

articleTitle: Compression technique by Analyzing Peak Signal to Noise Ratio value using various Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: Image compression method classifies the acquisition image and converts to grayscale image ($\text{P}=0.000$) using Support Vector Machine (SVM) compared with Decision Tree method. Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) are performed with the acquisition image. 1000 sample images are taken as input. The image compression of the acquisition image is carried out using the Support Vector Machine algorithm where the number of samples $(\text{N}=40)$ and the sample size is divided into two ($\mathbf{N}=\mathbf{2 0}$) for SVM and $(\mathbf{N}=20)$ for Decision tree. The peak to signal noise ratio of SVM with 92.20 kbps is better than the Decision tree 84.80 kbps. There is a significant difference in PSNR is $\text{P}=0.293$ within the limit of study, the Support Vector Machine algorithm performs better at finding the Peak to signal noise ratio when compared with the Decision Tree.

articleTitle: Aerial Landscape Image Classification Using CNN and Transfer Learning
abstract: This paper investigates the classification of aerial images depicting transmission towers, forests, farmland, and mountains. The classification task is accomplished using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture to extract features from input images, followed by Softmax for image classification. The dataset utilized for training and evaluation is a combination of the MLRNet dataset and self-collected images from Google satellite imagery. Our approach achieves results, with an overall accuracy of 87% on the built CNN model. Furthermore, by utilizing the pretrained VGG16 and MobileNetV2 models as a starting point for transfer learning, we achieve even higher accuracies. Specifically, VGG16 achieves an accuracy of $90 \%$, while MobileNetV2 outperforms both models with an accuracy of 96%. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of employing transfer learning with MobileNetV2 for classifying transmission towers, forests, farmland, and mountains.

articleTitle: Graph-Based Representation and Detection of Cyberbullying on Social Media Using GCNs
abstract: The widespread use of social media has contributed to an increase in instances of cyberbullying, which constitutes hateful and offensive interactions between users of digital platforms, necessitating effective detection methods to mitigate its impact. This study presents a novel approach to cyberbullying detection by employing Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), which are adept at processing graph-structured data, used to represent various complex relationships between words in text data. Trained on a substantial dataset of cyberbullying tweets, the architecture of the proposed GCN allows for the aggregation of features based on the relationships between tweets and words, enabling the model to capture complex dependencies inherent in the data. The model achieved a significant accuracy of $93.1 \%$, demonstrating high precision and recall metrics. This work not only advances the state of the art in automated cyberbullying detection but also lays the groundwork for future research leveraging graph-based methodologies in natural language processing tasks.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Reconstruction using AVAE Algorithm
abstract: Fingerprint recognition stands out as a crucial area of study in the forensic department. There are many challenges that persist in the fingerprint reconstruction field particularly partial and low-quality fingerprint impressions. This paper presents fingerprint reconstruction using Adversarial Variational Autoencoders. Here, we introduce an integrated model that blends the generative capabilities of Variational Autoencoders with adversarial training from Generative Adversarial Networks. This approach holds potential implications for enhancing biometric and forensic analysis with quality and completeness of fingerprint data.

articleTitle: Classification of Diseases in Citrus Fruits and Leaves using Data Science Technique with Pesticides Spraying System using Arduino
abstract: Agriculture is popularly called to be “backbone of global economy”. The genus Citrus, which contains a range of fruits distinguished by its unique perfume, high vitamin $\mathbf{C}$ content, and refreshing taste, is home to the group of fruits known as citrus fruits. They are widely cultivated and consumed around the world. Citrus fruits, beloved for their refreshing taste and high nutritional value, can face significant challenges from various diseases that impact both the trees and the fruit they bear. Among these diseases, citrus canker stands out as a bacterial affliction causing raised lesions on leaves, stems, and fruit. Though various technological advancements have replaced various industries, the agriculture sector cannot be replaced. Lack of proper planning and forecasting techniques leads to poor yield and wastage of the crops produced. Deep learning is widely employed for such classification. In this paper, we have used pre-trained Convolution Neural Network (CNN) models such as AlexNet and LeNet Architecture. It gave feasible result when it was retrained with a dataset of $\mathbf{2 0 2 9}$ images. This model classifies the fruits and leaves into 7 categories. After classifying the fruits, the output to send to the hardware implementation and pesticide and water spraying is triggered based on logical combinations of Arduino as well as taking into consideration the output of the soil moisture sensor. This project aims to improve the crop yield by early detection of diseases and provides an automated pesticide spraying system.

articleTitle: Research on Low-Voltage Power Grid Out-Of-Tolerance Method based on Multi-Model Fusion
abstract: In the field of accurate metering of power system, low-voltage energy meter is a direct tool for electricity settlement of users, and its accuracy directly affects the fairness and rationality of energy management and electricity fee recovery. However, traditional single-model calibration methods are often limited by factors such as equipment aging, environmental changes, and load fluctuations, which often make it difficult to maintain high accuracy on a consistent basis. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to explore the out-of-tolerance method of low-voltage watt-hour meter based on multi-model fusion, in order to improve the metering accuracy of watt-hour meter and ensure long-term stability and reliability by integrating multiple measurement technologies and data processing strategies.

articleTitle: Prediction of Raisin Class with Logistic Regression
abstract: This work investigates using a huge Kaggle dataset the utility of logistic regression for raisin categorization. The model was trained and validated on scaled features; GridSearchCV was then used to maximize hyperparameters. With performance matching more advanced machine learning methods, the top model on the test set achieved $\mathbf{8 4 \%}$ accuracy. To guarantee an overall evaluation, many performance criteria-including accuracy, recall, and F1 score-were examined. The resilience and accuracy of the model were further enhanced by good feature selection and ensemble techniques. The results imply that with suitable calibration and preprocessing, logistic regression-despite its simplicity-may be useful for raisin classification. The main underlined issue is the appropriate logistic regression-based categorization of raisin variances. We therefore improved performance by modifying the hyperparameter of the model and using scaling and feature selection methods. The high accuracy of the new model confirmed the usefulness of logistic regression for this kind of classification problem by great strength of endurance.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Load Control and Optimization Based on Large-scale Aggregation Air Conditioning
abstract: In view of the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms in smart grid load control and optimization, a grid load control and optimization scheme based on large-scale aggregate air conditioning is proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the group foraging theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce the interference, and the large-scale aggregation air conditioning is used to construct the power grid load control and optimization scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of power grid load control and optimization accuracy, and influencing factor processing time, and has obvious advantages. Grid load control and optimization plays an extremely important role in smart grids, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of smart grids. However, traditional image recognition algorithms have certain limitations in solving power grid load simulation problems, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, a grid load control and optimization scheme based on large-scale aggregate air conditioning is proposed to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors were accurately located through the group foraging theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and large-scale aggregation air conditioning was used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on large-scale aggregate air conditioning in smart grid load control and optimization can better solve the limitations of traditional image recognition algorithms and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: SVR-INC Fusion Based MPPT Algorithm for Photovoltaic Power Generation under Local Shadowing Conditions
abstract: In modern photovoltaic (PV) systems, the efficiency of the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm largely determines the system performance, especially under local shadowing conditions. Traditional MPPT algorithms such as perturbation observation (P&O) and incremental conductance (INC) methods are prone to fall into local optima when dealing with complex voltage-power (P-V) curves, resulting in sub-optimal power output. In this study, an MPPT algorithm based on the fusion of support vector regression (SVR) and incremental conductance method (INC) is proposed to improve the power output efficiency of the PV system under local shadowing conditions by combining the powerful prediction capability of SVR and the fast response characteristics of INC. Simulation results show that the SVRINC fusion algorithm outperforms the traditional method in terms of accurate tracking of the maximum power point, convergence speed and stability, and effectively improves the performance of the system under complex environmental conditions..

articleTitle: Design of Visual Fusion System for Automatic Visual Communication based on Automatic Orchestration Algorithm
abstract: The registration rate and fusion efficiency of traditional automated visual communication visual fusion system are low in the application process, which seriously affects the application effect of the system, so this paper designs the automatic visual communication visual fusion system based on the automatic orchestration algorithm and designs the overall architecture according to the system implementation function. The components of this system include memory, servers, and networks, forming a computer mode to avoid assembly, integration and optimization processes. The system can adopt the form of visual images to transmit image information to the audience, use computer technology to collect visual communication image information, further complete the transmission and fusion processing of information, and enhance the visual communication image display effect. The results show that the automatic visual communication visual fusion registration rate of the system designed based on the automatic orchestration algorithm is significantly improved, and the economic benefits and use value are higher.

articleTitle: Abstractive Summary Generation of Meeting Audio Files
abstract: With everyone worldwide working remotely, virtual platforms and meetings are the new medium to connect and interact. A lot of content and data is discussed during these calls, making transcription a problematic task. With this paper, we propose to build an AI-enabled tool that uses a speaker diarization process to determine the number of speakers. This tool will generate the transcripts and minutes of the meeting by taking a pre-recorded meeting audio file as input. We have used the open-source implementation of Unbounded Interleaved State Recurrent Neural Network (UIS-RNN) to determine the number of speakers, which outperforms the unsupervised learning-based clustering methods. We have used state-of-the-art results of the Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer (T5) summarization model based on transfer learning. Our results have shown that the diarization error rate of the system improved with the use of supervised diarization methods over the traditional clustering methods.

articleTitle: SVC-Based MPPT Algorithm For Photovoltaic Power Generation Under Local Shadows
abstract: In recent years, the integration of photovoltaic (PV) systems into the power grid has seen significant growth, driven by the global demand for renewable energy sources. However, the efficiency of PV systems is highly dependent on the capability of the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithms to adapt to varying environmental conditions such as partial shading. Traditional MPPT techniques like Perturb and Observe (P&O) or Incremental Conductance (INC) often struggle with the complex power-voltage characteristics under these conditions, leading to suboptimal performance. This study explores the application of Support Vector Regression (SVR) for enhancing the MPPT process in PV systems. By leveraging the powerful regression capabilities of SVR, the proposed algorithm accurately predicts the maximum power point (MPP) in real-time, even in the presence of multiple local maxima caused by partial shading.The methodology involves training an SVR model using historical PV data, where the model learns the relationship between voltage and power. The trained SVR model is then employed in the MPPT process to predict the power output for different voltage levels and guide the system to the global MPP. The simulation results demonstrate that the SVR-based MPPT algorithm significantly outperforms traditional methods, achieving faster convergence to the MPP and maintaining stable power output under dynamic shading conditions. Detailed analysis of PV characteristic curves, SVR model training, and real-time MPPT performance confirms the robustness and reliability of the proposed approach.Furthermore, the adaptability of the SVR model to learn from new data ensures that the MPPT algorithm remains effective over time, accommodating variations in irradiance, temperature, and shading patterns. This study concludes that integrating SVR into MPPT algorithms can substantially enhance the efficiency and reliability of PV systems, making it a promising solution for the challenges posed by partial shading and other environmental factors.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: This work presents a Kaggle Leap GestRecogn Dataset convolutional neural network (CNN) model for hand gesture recognition. Three Conv2D layers in the model with matching 32, 32, and 64 filters are defined by ReLU activation and max pooling respectively. Using dense layers totaling 256 units and a dropout rate of 0.3, the model produced an amazing $\mathbf{99. 97 \%}$ test accuracy and a test loss of 0.0019. Key hyperparameters are a fifty by fifty picture size, a thirty-two batch size, and seven training cycles. The challenge is precisely matching hand gestures from grayscale images. Sometimes traditional methods cannot allow notable variation in hand placements and lighting conditions. This work significantly improves gesture detection performance using a deep learningbased CNN model with suitable hyperparameters and architectural choices, therefore obtaining remarkable accuracy and resilience. This method considerably increases gesture identification accuracy, therefore enabling deep learning methods to address difficult pattern recognition problems in hand gesture datasets.

articleTitle: ResFedAvg: Restricting Extreme Updates
abstract: Federated machine learning is a distributed learning paradigm where multiple clients work together to train a common model without the need to share local data. FedAvg is the foundational Federated Learning (FL) algorithm that considers weights from all the participating client for arithmetic averaging to get a global model. RobFedAvg considers the extreme weights as outliers and prunes node-wise outliers before aggregation. Considering the high heterogeneity of datasets across the participating clients, the extreme weights represent significant learning on clients with highly heterogeneous data and shall not be outliers always. This paper proposes Restricted Federated Averaging (ResFedAvg), a new aggregation algorithm that considers extreme weights but limits its effect on averaging. Experimental evaluations are carried out on MNIST with IID and non-IID datasets. ResFedAvg performs better than RobFedAvg in terms of convergence and accuracy for IID and non-IID datasets.

articleTitle: Design and FPGA Implementation of Minimal Transient Notch Filter employing Time Varying Bandwidth
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a digital notch filter with an infinite impulse response structure. A variable notch bandwidth filter is designed to reduce the initial signal transient. The notch filter is designed to reduce signal transients by having a wide bandwidth during the initial samples. As time progresses, the notch bandwidth decreases to reach its minimum width. A new function is proposed to vary notch-width with time which produce notch filter with a reduced transient duration and a high-quality factor as compared to existing literature. For comparison, Simulink model for variable notch bandwidth filter is constructed to observe transient response. The proposed structure is implmented on FPGA using Xilinx System Generator for DSP tool which is used to filter the corrupted ECG signal.

articleTitle: Smart Ways to Reduce Gas Fees for NFT Platforms on the Polygon Blockchain
abstract: Non-fungible token (NFT) markets leveraging blockchain technology have surged in popularity, offering advantages like transparent ownership history, fractional ownership, and secure operations. However, high gas fees can make trading on the blockchain expensive. This paper investigates strategies to reduce these costs in NFT marketplace contract implementation and execution. We tested our solutions on the Polygon blockchain, using Solidity for smart contract development and Visual Studio Code for testing. Our approach focuses on creating efficient NFT marketplace contracts for listing properties, executing transactions, and ensuring secure ownership transfer. Our analysis demonstrates an average transaction cost reduction of $\mathbf{3 5. 1 4 \%}$ and a 5.10% decrease in the cost of a single transaction. These optimizations significantly lower gas fees, enhancing the efficiency and viability of NFT markets in the private sector.

articleTitle: Computer Software Programming based on C Language
abstract: In the process of computer software programming, using C language can simplify the procedure of program design and make the program run more accurately. Computer software is the process of writing programs executed by a computer. Computer software programming is the process of creating a computer program in any language to be executed on a computer system. Computer software development or just development refers to the design and development of application programs used on computers. It includes application design and programming tasks. The term “development” can also be used as a synonym for “programming”, but it usually refers only to the latter task. Developers can also be called application programmers, system programmers, or software engineers.

articleTitle: Detecting Malicious Network Activities: Machine Learning-Based ARP Poisoning Detection on RT-IoT2022 Dataset
abstract: This makes it possible to detect Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) poisoning attempts, which is essential for preserving network communications’ security and integrity, especially in the context of Internet of Things (IoT) deployments. Using the RT-IoT2022 dataset, which offers a thorough representation of network technology in IoT settings, a novel method in this paper has been demonstrated for recognising ARP poisoning attacks using machine learning (ML) techniques. Its ability to create reliable models for identifying malevolent ARP poisoning behaviour is made possible by the dataset’s extensive collection of network activity, including ARP traffic, device connections, and interaction patterns. Through the use of supervised learning methods like Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Random Forests (RF), Decision Trees (DT), and Support Vector Machines, the goal is to train classifiers that can accurately distinguish between unusual ARP poisoning activity and normal ARP traffic. It also examines how well feature engineering and selection methods work to improve the models’ performance. The effectiveness of the method has been evaluated for identifying ARP poisoning threats and its potential for practical use in IoT security applications through comprehensive testing and analysis. The results highlight the significance of utilising ML to improve cybersecurity in IoT environments and advance anomaly detection techniques in IoT networks. The finding demonstrates that the XGBoost is the most accurate method, with an accuracy percentage of $\mathbf{9 9. 7 6 \%}$. On the other hand, the rates for AdaBoost, DT, and RF are $\mathbf{9 3. 3 4 \%}, \mathbf{9 5. 2 1 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 8. 9 9 \%}$ respectively.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Sleep Disorder Classification and Sleep Quality Assessment
abstract: This study represents a significant advance in healthcare by using machine learning techniques to predict sleep disorders such as insomnia and sleep apnea by analyzing data collected from wearable sensors. The primary aim is to use various factors - including gender, age, occupation, sleep duration, physical activity level, stress, body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, heart rate, and total steps per day - to develop a nuanced and personalized approach to quality improvement sleep. This study highlights the importance of lifestyle factors such as daily workload and exposure to technology, as well as environmental conditions, highlighting how they play a major role in the prevalence and severity of sleep disorders. By integrating these different data points, the study aims to clarify the complex interplay between these variables and sleep health. To achieve its goals, the study uses several sophisticated machine learning algorithms. These include but are not limited to the k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) classifier, logistic regression, counterfactual, chi2, and several other algorithms that are adept at handling large and complex data sets. The methodology involves careful data cleaning and transformation processes to ensure the integrity and usability of data collected from wearables and other sources.

articleTitle: Advanced Multi-Class Bone Marrow Classification: EfficientNetB5 Techniques for Better Outcomes
abstract: Classifying bone marrow images into multiple categories presents challenges such as class imbalance, high intra-class variability, and the need for highly precise and interpretable diagnostic models. These issues complicate the development of reliable automated clinical diagnostic systems. Accurate classification is crucial for diagnosing various hematological disorders, yet achieving this requires overcoming obstacles like ensuring result precision and interpretability, dealing with significant morphological differences, and addressing class imbalance. This study explores the application of the advanced convolutional neural network, EfficientNetB5, to address these challenges in bone marrow image classification. By employing customized loss functions, advanced data augmentation, and techniques for model interpretability, our approach achieves an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$. These results demonstrate EfficientNetB5’s potential to enhance diagnostic accuracy and reliability in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Hand-Written Bramhi Script Recognition using Deep Learning
abstract: This work involves the classification of handwritten script using deep learning with a special interest in the comparison of different pre-trained models. As one of the oldest writing systems in the world, derived from the Dravidian and southeast Semitic scripts that were developed 4,500 years ago in India and Central America, Brahmi script also has variability due to the hand-written accented forms. To address these obstacles, different pre-trained models viz., Vision Transformer (ViT), MobileNetV2, VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet, and EfficientNet with the CNN are implemented and compared. The result of the implementation infers that all of these pre-trained models yield a higher accuracy than the custom CNN traditional CNN approach, with a peak improvement in performance shown by MobileNetV2. This lays the ground for future utilization of deep learning architectures which have the capability of preserving and understanding handwritten symbolic scripts.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Classification Using REXNET-150
abstract: This work develops a satellite image classification using the RexNet-150 architecture. On the training and validation datasets, the model achieves a perfect accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$. Analyzing satellite pictures with a resolution of $224 \times 224$ pixels, the model uses cutting-edge convolutional neural network (CNN) approaches This also contains normalization to help feature extraction be better. With a learning rate of $2 \times 10$ - 4, Cross Entropy Loss as the loss function, and a batch size of 32 the Adam optimizer is used to train the model. Over ten epochs, the training is carried out; early stopping is used to stop overfitting. This approach offers a rather reliable tool for automated cataract diagnosis, with the possibility to greatly increase diagnostic accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhancing Energy Efficiency in Emerging Nations: Comparative Analysis of Artix-7 and Kintex FPGAs Utilizing Fixed-Point Matrix Operators
abstract: Several emerging nations are now experiencing a massive energy crisis. As an alternative, a team of scientists and engineers has developed a Fixed-Point Matrix operator that uses less resources by combining the Xilinx Vivado program with several FPGA generations. By highlighting eco-friendly communication technology, this invention enhances. We tested and compared two separate families of field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs)—Artix-7 and Kintex—to find out which one provides the most power savings. By comparison, the Artix-7 family used 0.967 Watts of electricity, whereas the Kintex family used only 0.683 Watts, demonstrating the superior energy efficiency of the Kintex family. Additionally, while comparing temperatures, it was found that the Artix-7 family works at 32.4 degrees Celsius, but the Kintex family runs colder at 26.4 degrees Celsius. This research found that the Kintex family of fieldprogrammable gate arrays (FPGAs) shows better energy efficiency, which helps with. Embracing this approach will help us achieve sustainable development objectives by preserving energy for later use. Even while the Kintex board isn’t quite as cheap as the Artix-7 computer, it does provide a practical way to make technology more energy efficient, which is in line with Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET models based Quaternary MAX and MIN Circuits
abstract: In binary logic-based VLSI design, power consumption is one of the major concerns due to the continuous increase of chip density and decrease in the size of CMOS circuits. Quaternary logic, an emerging paradigm in digital circuit design, offers a promising alternative to traditional binary logic by incorporating four logical states. This paper presents a design of quaternary MAX and MIN circuits utilizing different models of 18nm FinFET technology. The simulations were performed on cadence virtuoso tool and a comparative analysis was performed using LVT, SVT and HVT FinFET models. The designed circuits are capable of efficiently determining the maximum and minimum values among multiple quaternary inputs, demonstrating superior performance compared to their binary counterparts in terms of circuit complexity and energy utilization.

articleTitle: Analyzing Anomalies in IoT Networks using Machine Learning Solutions with ACI-IoT-2023 Network Traffic Dataset
abstract: In the realm of the Internet of Things (IoT), anomaly detection is crucial to maintaining the safety and reliability of networks and linked devices. It is frequently not possible to identify sophisticated and dynamic threats using traditional rulebased methods, which is why machine learning (ML) techniques are being employed. This study investigates ML-based methods for anomaly identification in IoT network traffic, using the Army Cyber Institute’s Internet of Things (ACI-IoT) Network Traffic Dataset. The dataset makes it easier to train, test, and assess anomaly detection algorithms by providing a thorough and accurate depiction of IoT network behaviours. Using supervised ML algorithms such as Decision Trees (DT), Random Forests (RF), Adaptive Gradient Boosting (AdaBoost) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). This research attempts to create reliable anomaly detection systems that can recognise malicious activity and anomalous behaviours in IoT networks. This study advances IoT security by assessing the scalability and efficacy of these systems, and it guides the creation of best practices and standards for anomaly detection in IoT contexts. The results find that with a $\mathbf{9 9. 9 4 \%}$ accuracy rate, XGBoost is the most accurate technique. In contrast, the rates for DT, RF and AdaBoost are $\mathbf{5 7. 0 9 \%}, \mathbf{7 8. 0 9 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 8. 5 9 \%}$, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Human Resource Management System Based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Human resource management is the process of managing people in an organization. It involves activities such as recruitment, selection, training and development, compensation and benefits, performance appraisal and discipline. The success of an organization depends on its ability to manage human resources well. This paper will discuss various technologies of human resource management system based on genetic algorithm. The human resources management system can be divided into three main parts: recruitment; human resources. choice; And induction/training. Recruitment refers to finding qualified employment candidates, while selection refers to determining suitable candidates and selecting a qualified candidate for employment. In R&D projects where resources are mainly allocated by people, there are strong resource specificity. At the same time, the task conflict between multiple projects, the scarcity of R&D personnel and other constraints increase the difficulty of project scheduling and human resource allocation. If the scheduling scheme and personnel allocation are unreasonable, it will cause delays in construction period and cost overruns. Therefore, on the premise of ensuring the completion of the R&D project, how to reasonably arrange the multi-project task scheduling and the allocation of personnel in the task, shorten the total construction period as far as possible, and improve the economic benefits of the enterprise has important theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Compensation Technology of Semiconductor Laser based on FPGA
abstract: With the continuous improvement of science and technology, the population of central cities continues to increase, and people’s demand for communication speed is getting higher and higher, and optical communication plays an extremely important role in the field of communication. However, in the process of optical communication, nonlinear distortion will lead to unfavorable factors such as waveform distortion in the process of analog modulation of communication systems such as optical carrier microwaves, which will affect the high-speed transmission performance of data. Therefore, this paper proposes an FPGA digital predistortion technique to analyze the optimized nonlinear compensation technique. Firstly, the theory related to nonlinear distortion characteristics is used to evaluate the response characteristics of semiconductor lasers, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of nonlinear compensation technology to reduce them Interference factors in nonlinear compensation techniques. Then, the nonlinear distortion characteristic correlation theory calculates the modulated waveform containing predistortion information to form a nonlinear compensation technical scheme, and the nonlinear compensation technical results are formed Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, FPGA digital predistortion technology is a nonlinear compensation technology for optical transmitter module predistortion light source Both accuracy and predistortion effect estimation are more accurate than traditional communication techniques.

articleTitle: A Novel MobileInceptionNet Architecture for Apple Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: Diagnosis of agricultural plant leaf diseases is a significant, but a time-taking process, if performed manually. Therefore, automated systems are much required for the early diagnosis of the leaf diseases. Recent advancements in Deep Learning(DL) have accelerated the development of these autonomous systems. This study introduces a novel deep learning model designed, particularly to classify apple leaf diseases accurately, hence, addressing the critical aspect of agricultural management. The proposed model combines the efficiency and lightweight-nature of the MobileNet architecture with the strong feature extraction properties of Inception module and hence, is named MobileInceptionNet. To assess the efficiency of the model, metrics such as recall, precision, and f1score are used. An average precision, recall and F1-score of 0.947,0.946 and 0.946 respectively were recorded for experimental results across thirteen different classes. With a test accuracy of $\mathbf{9 4. 9 9 \%}$, the proposed model has demonstrated its potential in improving automatic diagnosis systems for apple leaf diseases.

articleTitle: Leveraging Linear Discriminant Analysis for the Onset of Parkinson’s Disorder
abstract: Parkinson’s Disorder (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor and non-motor signs, with a substantial impact on patients’ quality of life. Priory with an accurate predictive evaluation of this disorder onset is crucial for timely interventions and management of the disorder. This research study explored the efficacy of Linearly discriminant performance Evaluation (LDA) in analyzing the onset of Parkinson’s Disorder. It is a supervised machine learning mechanism, employed to analyze comprehensively collected information which comprises of clinical and biomarker aspects from patients in different circumstances of PD development. The information set also includes demographically aggregated information, motor examination results, and neuroimaging data. The related Feature selection and dimensionality reduction mechanism on the datasets were applied towards enhancing the framework’s performance evaluation and interpretability. The current framework trained and validated using cross-validation-based methods towards the confirmation of robustness and generalizability. The performance evaluation results showcased that the proposed LDA methodology effectively distinguished between individuals with and without Priory signs of Parkinson’s Disorder, by achieving a higher levels of correctness rate, sensitivity level, and related specificity. The framework’s discriminative capability suggests its potential as a valuable tool for Priory PD predictive evaluation in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Chili Crop Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Feature Extraction Using Transfer Learning with ResNet50
abstract: Crop diseases cause reduced production, underscoring the need for constant vigilance. Manual monitoring of crop diseases is laborious and error-prone. Early identification of crop leaf diseases using computer vision and artificial intelligence can mitigate the negative impact of diseases and overcome the limitations of continuous human surveillance. This research paper proposes a new Transfer Learning-based deep feature extraction model that uses ResNet50, MobileNet, and EfficientNetB0, along with multiple classifiers, to classify chili crop diseases. The proposed method was trained and tested on Plant Village datasets of chilli crop diseases. The results were analyzed by comparing the original data with the filtered data using transfer learning and the proposed method. The highest performance accuracy achieved on the Plant Village dataset was $\mathbf{9 9. 6 \%}$ with ResNet50, and the fastest CPU time for feature extraction was 29.3 seconds with MobileNet. Comparison with state-of-the-art deep learning models revealed higher accuracy with fewer computational resources when using the suggested model.

articleTitle: Advancing EEG Brain-Computer Interfaces with Efficient Machine Learning Classifications
abstract: In recent years, brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have advanced significantly through the integration of electroencephalogram (EEG) data, though the complexity of EEG signals remains challenging for traditional classification methods. This paper introduces a novel machine learning framework to enhance classification efficiency in EEG-based BCIs. We employ advanced algorithms, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs), to capture temporal and spatial dependencies in EEG data. Our approach leverages a combination of feature extraction techniques and dimensionality reduction to optimize classification, improving accuracy and speed. We performed a comparative analysis using a standardized EEG dataset, revealing our model’s significant improvement in classification accuracy and computational efficiency over traditional classifiers. These results highlight our method’s potential in realtime BCI applications. This study contributes to the theoretical understanding of EEG signal processing and paves the way for more responsive and user-friendly BCI systems.

articleTitle: Abnormal Power Consumption Detection of Low-Voltage Users Based on Power Consumption Characteristic Analysis and Outlier Algorithm
abstract: In the daily operation of the power system, accurate and rapid identification of abnormal electricity consumption behavior is essential to ensure the stable operation of the power grid and fair billing. With the development of smart grid technology, the use of electrical characteristic analysis and outlier algorithm to detect abnormal electricity consumption of low-voltage users has become an innovative and effective means. This article will delve into this topic and reveal how the combination of these two technologies can improve the accuracy and efficiency of abnormal electricity use detection.

articleTitle: Real-Time Pupil Localization and Eye Gaze Estimation Using Multistage Algorithm for Enhanced Eye Tracking
abstract: The most important aspect of a live eye gaze is accurate real-time pupil observing. Precise localization for pupil center is important for many applications, that includes face recognition and estimation of eye gaze, as it acts as an essential point in reference. The main aim presents a new method for accurately obtaining pupil eye properties from eye photos at different luminosities, focusing on the localization of recognized items of interest and the gaze location of the subject. The application area chosen is the eye localization in a video sequence’s frame, followed by iris and pupil recognition. Since the suggested method is based on the properties of the human eye, it may quickly and accurately determine if the pupil is determined. A multistage algorithm is utilized to extract these features, which have an increase in intensity towards the center of the eye. Pictures from the Internet and an actual indoor environment captured using lenses. The experiment’s findings indicate $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$ This ratio exhibits excellent results. The term “eye tracking” describes the measurement of gaze positions and movements to identify what people are looking at. The algorithm that has been put into practice can identify the pupil of a photo of a human eye or the human eye’s ocular ball. When an input image displays a closed eye, the classification model stops the gaze estimation process and filters out images with closed eyes. It also shows how to use a wearable camera to build an eye image data collection. It assessed the suggested approach from a number of angles.

articleTitle: Identifying Hyperpartisanship in News Media Using Bi-LSTM and Decoding-Enhanced BERT
abstract: Hyperpartisan news, which frequently uses strategies like sensationalism, attention-grabbing or clickbait headlines, and excessively emotive language, is known to deepen political division, disseminate false information, and erode public confidence in the media-especially in the dynamic and constantly evolving world of digital media today. Media-promoted bias can even polarize communities and affect election outcomes, weakening democratic processes and compromising social cohesiveness. The aim of this research work is to address these issues by detecting such politically biased news articles by employing two methodologies: a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 model and a Bi-LSTM model trained on FastText embeddings, to analyze a comprehensive dataset of news articles spanning the political spectrum. The fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 model demonstrated an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{9 4. 4 \%}$, outperforming the Bi-LSTM+FastText model trained using K-Fold Cross Validation, which achieved an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 9. 2 \%}$. This research serves as a valuable tool by contributing to a more reliable and balanced information ecosystem, this work aims to facilitate a better-informed decisionmaking process and a less polarized public discourse.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Automated Text Summarization
abstract: The purpose of this work is to investigate the use of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques in the field of automated textbook summarisation. As a result of the exponential growth of digital content, there is an urgent requirement for resources that are capable of providing accurate and efficient summarisation. The purpose of this study is to build algorithms that are capable of creating concise and coherent summaries from massive textbook corpora. The study analyses various natural language processing (NLP) strategies, including extractive and abstractive approaches. In addition to providing a comparative study based on performance parameters such as Cream and BLEU ratings, the investigation sheds insight into the benefits and difficulties that are linked with each approach. Additionally, the research explores the incorporation of advanced deep literacy models, such as Mills and BERT, to improve the process of summarization. The results of the experiments show that these models are effective in producing summaries of high quality, thereby greatly lowering the amount of time required for the birth of information. This paper contributes to the continuous development of automated summarisation tools by providing insight into the implicit operations of these tools in domains such as journalism, education, and content operation.

articleTitle: A novel approach for Identifying Age-Related Conditions
abstract: This research paper aims to address the critical demand for creating a model that can predict if one has any age-related condition or not. By applying Machine Learning, particularly Random Forest and AdaBoost algorithms the aim to develop a model that can enhance prediction for age related condition beyond the current state of the art. For this a dataset provided by InVitro Cell Research [10] was used which has anonymous health parameters that were useful for creating the model. The aim is to provide a substitute for conventional diagnostic techniques and lay a foundation for creating age related models. Additionally, Roc curve along with K-fold validation and confusion matrix were used to ensure the robustness and reliability of the predictive model.

articleTitle: Incremental Few-Shot Object Detection with High-Efficiency via Expandable-RCNN
abstract: In the dynamic field of computer vision, the challenge of Few-Shot Object Detection (FSOD) requires robust models that can efficiently learn from a limited number of examples. Our paper introduces the Expandable-RCNN, an innovative approach that integrates incremental learning with FSOD to address inefficiencies and scalability challenges in existing methodologies. This novel architecture avoids catastrophic forgetting by dynamically incorporating new knowledge while preserving previously learned information. We employ a unique incremental learning strategy, enabling the Expandable-RCNN to swiftly adapt to new object classes using minimal examples and maintain high detection accuracy across existing categories. Our evaluation on standard benchmarks demonstrates that Expandable-RCNN surpasses traditional FSOD techniques in detection performance and efficiency, achieving state-of-the-art results. The model’s adaptability and scalability make it exceptionally suitable for real-world applications where data availability frequently changes. Results indicate that Expandable-RCNN significantly improves precision, recall, and F 1 -score, evidencing its potential to reshape FSOD paradigms. These findings highlight the critical importance of incorporating incremental learning capabilities within object detection frameworks, paving the way for future advancements in adaptive, efficient, and scalable detection systems in various dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Prediction algorithm for SOC Estimation of New Energy Vehicles
abstract: As one of the important means of human transportation, the state of charge of new energy vehicles has also become one of the most important research objects of new energy vehicles. SOC estimation is difficult to accurately measure the state of charge of the battery because it is affected by factors such as external temperature, charge and discharge current, battery lifetime, and the rate of change of battery internal resistance. Therefore, this paper proposes a fuzzy prediction algorithm, and combines the simulation model of traditional econometrics for comparative analysis and obtains the final verification result, which improves the accuracy of SOC estimation, and the fuzzy prediction algorithm has a specific effect on the SOC of new energy vehicles under certain evaluation criteria The accuracy of the estimates is better than that of traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Exploring Data Protection with ISA-L: A Study on Erasure Coding
abstract: This research paper delves into the utilization of ISA-L (Intel Storage Acceleration Library) for implementing erasure coding, a pivotal technique in modern data protection and storage systems. The paper explores the fundamental features and algorithms embedded within the ISA-L library, emphasizing its significance in optimizing data storage and retrieval processes. The proposed methodology encompasses various functionalities crucial for efficient data management, including file upload, retrieval, listing, and deletion, all implemented using ISA-L. Additionally, the paper investigates the impact of different data chunk-to-parity chunk ratios on system performance, presenting findings through a comprehensive table analysis. Furthermore, the research evaluates the time required to process files of varying sizes using ISA-L, providing insights into the library’s efficiency in handling diverse workloads. Multi-node architectures are explored within the context of erasure coding, highlighting the distributed nature of the system and its implications for data resilience and availability. Integration with SQL databases adds another layer of sophistication to the project, enabling seamless data storage and retrieval operations within a structured relational database environment. The advantages of erasure coding over traditional data protection techniques are elucidated, emphasizing its ability to offer high levels of redundancy and fault tolerance while minimizing storage overhead. The paper also discusses the role of erasure coding in data migration scenarios, illustrating its efficacy in moving large volumes of data efficiently across storage systems. Through experimentation and analysis, this research aims to provide valuable insights into the practical implementation of erasure coding techniques using ISA-L. The results and discussions presented herein contribute to a deeper understanding of data protection strategies and their implications for modern data storage architectures.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Secure Access Algorithm for Railway Power Supply Big Data Based on Attribute Encryption
abstract: With the advancement of the digital transformation of railway power supply system, a large number of railway power supply operation data has been centrally managed, analyzed and utilized. How to better protect the security and privacy of relevant data has become one of the important problems to be solved in the current railway industry. This study proposes a multi-level secure access algorithm for railway power supply big data based on attribute encryption, which can achieve refined data control and privacy protection based on the application of various technical means, such as flexible access control strategy and user identity concealment. The final results show that the algorithm has excellent performance in data security, access efficiency, system reliability and other aspects, and can meet the data security management requirements in the field of railway power supply.

Author Keywords: Multi-level secure access algorithm for big data

articleTitle: Comparison of NCF and PMF using Movie Lens dataset
abstract: Two well-liked methods for creating movie recommendation systems are probabilistic matrix factorization (PMF) and neural collaborative filtering (NCF). PMF is a probabilistic method of matrix factorization, whereas NCF uses neural networks to learn user-item interactions. The performance of NCF and PMF on the MovieLens 100 K and 1M datasets, which comprise user-rated movies, is compared in this abstract. The main conclusions are as follows: PMF can be a good option for non-commercial implementations where novelty is not a requirement because it combines simplicity with accuracy. In terms of diversity, uniqueness, prediction accuracy, and recommendation accuracy (for both unordered and ordered lists), NCF performs better than PMF. When applied to the MovieLens datasets, NCF yields better overall quality results than PMF, but it is more sophisticated and requires more training data. In conclusion, NCF outperforms PMF in terms of accuracy and beyond-accuracy metrics like novelty and diversity, but at the expense of greater complexity. Both models are useful for suggesting movies. The recommendation system’s particular criteria will determine which option is best.

articleTitle: Power Engineering Cost Control and Management based on Internet of Things and Cloud Computing
abstract: The power industry is the basic industry of China’s development, with the rapid development of China’s industry and economy, the demand for power in all walks of life is also increasing, and some power companies have increased their efforts to control and manage power engineering costs in order to adapt to the market economic environment. However, the investment in power projects is large, the construction period is long, and a lot of manpower, material resources and other resources are required during the construction project, and there are problems such as irregular operation and low comprehensive literacy of personnel, resulting in a serious waste of resources. Based on the Internet of Things and cloud computing technology, this paper controls and manages the cost of power projects, accurately predicts the cost of power projects, clarifies the construction cycle of power projects, reduces construction costs, significantly improves the economic benefits of power projects, and promotes comprehensive social and economic development. Through optimizing the cost management measures of power projects, strengthening the management measures of bidding and bidding, paying attention to the management of construction materials, and achieving scientific and reasonable control of power engineering costs.

Author Keywords: Based on the Internet of Things and cloud computing
innovation and entrepreneurship of college students

articleTitle: Research on Visual Communication Optimization Method Based on Image Processing Technology
abstract: Visual communication optimization is an important aspect of modern marketing, advertising, and brand promotion. The use of image processing technology has completely changed the way businesses communicate visually. In recent years, research on visual communication optimization methods based on image processing technology has become increasingly important. The aim of this study is to develop techniques that can improve the image quality used in visual communication. Image processing technology allows for the processing of images to improve their quality and make them more visually appealing. This study involves analyzing various aspects such as color, contrast, brightness, and clarity to optimize images. The results of this study are of great significance in improving the effectiveness of visual communication activities. By using image processing technology to optimize images, companies can create more attractive and impactful visual effects to attract the attention of their target audience. In summary, the research on visual communication optimization methods based on image processing technology is crucial for enterprises hoping to maintain a leading position in today’s fiercely competitive market. With the advancement of technology, this field will continue to develop and play a crucial role in shaping our visual communication methods.

articleTitle: Real Time Image Processing for Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: Autonomous vehicles require real-time image processing to improve their capabilities by allowing them to understand and respond appropriately to their environment. This paper examines the present state of real-time image processing for self-driving vehicles, including the techniques employed, challenges, and advancements. This article investigates methods such as semantic segmentation, object recognition, categorization, and depth estimation, with an emphasis on enhancing vehicle perception, navigation, and decision-making. The article delves into the implementations of significant algorithms on embedded platforms, their computational efficiency, and their deployment in real-world scenarios. In conclusion, the report investigates prospective avenues for additional research to improve the reliability and efficiency of the real-time image processing systems of autonomous automobiles.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of a Class of Neutral Stochastic Neural Networks with Time-Varying Delays
abstract: Neural network analysis should conduct substantial independent analysis and make overall judgments and comparisons throughout the entire analysis process.By increasing the number of data and substantive nodes in the network, the effectiveness of the analysis results can be improved. By constructing the Lyapunov functional and using the analytical techniques of ITO stochastic equation theory, Cauchy criterion, linear matrix inequality, and calculus inequality, we obtained sufficient conditions for the stochastic stability of the trivial solution of the neural network model.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of GPS Technology in Hydrological Water Resources Monitoring
abstract: The rapid development of science and technology has made it applied to more and more industries, among which hydrological detection is one of them. Traditional detection methods can no longer monitor hydrological water resources more accurately, so that more and more high-tech technologies are used in monitoring technology. Therefore, this paper proposes a GPS technology for accurate hydrological monitoring and analysis. Firstly, artificial intelligence is used to analyze and optimize hydrological monitoring technology, and indicators are divided according to hydrological monitoring requirements to reduce hydrological monitoring in the interfering factor. Then, the optimization results of hydrological monitoring by artificial intelligence form a hydrological monitoring scheme and carry out hydrological monitoring results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, GPS technology has the accuracy of hydrological monitoring of hydrological water resources. The feasibility of hydrological monitoring is better than that of traditional detection methods.

articleTitle: Sobel Filtered Feature Extracted VGG Framework based Banana Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: Banana is the major agricultural crop production in India which was consumed by all the people irrespective of the age. However, a typical issue with this banana crop is that it has been impacted by many diseases, and pest indicators have been required to identify the infections for preventing the financial damage to the farmers. The country’s economy is directly impacted by this issue, which will have an impact on banana productivity. Traditionally, skilled agronomists have relied on visual inspection for the detection and classification of these illnesses, which can be labor-intensive, unreliable, and time-consuming. The Deep Learning technology could be used to categorize the banana leaf disease. This paper proposes Sobel Filtered Feature Extracted VGG (SF-VGG16) that categorizes six classes of banana leaf disease with high accuracy. The Banana Disease Recognition Dataset that includes 408 banana leaf images was used for implementation. The SF-VGG16 model initiates by performing segregation of banana leaf images, followed by image labeling. The labeled images are processed with data augmentation resulting with $\mathbf{8, 5 6 8}$ banana leaf images. The augmented images are applied to image enhancement methods to generate Gaussian threshold, Otsu threshold and Sobel filtered image. The pixel intensity for the Sobel filtered image was found to be effective. The Sobel filtered banana leaf images are applied with the existing CNN models to analyze the performance. The implementation shows that the proposed SF-VGG16 model outperforms with the high accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9 . 6 \%}$ in banana leaf disease classification.

articleTitle: Information Distribution Method and System Based on Blockchain Offline Payment and Digital Finance
abstract: In order to improve the rationality of information allocation and simplify the information allocation process, this paper proposes an information allocation method. Firstly, the blockchain offline payment processing information distribution data is used to deeply analyze the digital financial risk status, payment change data and other parameters to form an information distribution collection. Then, the information allocation is continuously adjusted with functions such as risk probability, offline situation, and risk prediction, and unreasonable payment schemes are identified. Finally, with reference to digital financial norms and digital payment status, the information allocation strategy is selected and the final strategy is output. The simulation results show that the information distribution method proposed in this paper can improve the accuracy of the information allocation strategy and shorten the strategy formulation time under the guidance of the information distribution method, which is significantly better than the online payment method. Therefore, the information allocation method can accurately formulate digital financial strategies and meet the risk requirements of information allocation.

articleTitle: Research on Decision Support System for Electrical Equipment Test Based on Data Analysis Platform
abstract: In the management of electrical equipment, how to better analyze equipment test data and provide decision support for it has always been an important research problem. The purpose of this paper is to explore a decision support system for electrical equipment testing based on data analysis platform, which should integrate multiple functional modules, such as data acquisition and modeling, decision support, etc., so as to provide a visual and efficient data analysis and decision support interface for testers. Therefore, based on theoretical analysis, qualitative analysis, experimental verification and other methods, this paper shows the design ideas, its advantages and characteristics, and practical application effects.

Author Keywords: Decision support system for electrical equipment test

articleTitle: Edge Filtered AlexNet Architecture based Skull Type Classification
abstract: To help with population identification and research, skull type categorization is an essential component of several disciplines, such as anthropological studies, forensic science, and medicine. Conventional techniques for classifying skulls primarily depend on subjective interpretation and physical measurements, which may be tedious and susceptible to human error. Recent developments in Deep Learning (DL) provide a viable substitute by improving and automating the classification of skull types. This paper proposes Edge Filtered AlexNet (EF-AlexNet) that categorizes three classes of skull types with high accuracy. The Skull Image Dataset that includes 936 skul images was used for execution. The EF-AlexNet model begins by classifying skull images into three categories as human skull, horse skull and lion skull. Image labeling is applied to the separated images during pre-processing. After data augmentation on the labeled skull images, 19,656 skull images have been generated. Edge filtered skull images are created by applying the enhanced skull images to the edge filtering technique. To examine the performance, the Edge-filtered skull images are applied to the existing CNN architectures and the proposed EF-AlexNet model. The implementation demonstrates that the proposed EF-AlexNet model works better in the skull type classification task, achieving a high accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 8 \%}$.

articleTitle: Exploration on Agenda Setting of Short Video Dissemination under Distributed Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm
abstract: With the advent of the era of intelligent media, the status of traditional media agenda setting has been affected, and the core of short video communication lies in innovating narrative content and communication methods, starting from personalized content demand and the overall content demand market, focusing on the effect of short video communication, and constructing the media agenda framework. Traditional video selection topic planning and editing content investment cost is high, you development efficiency is low, for this reason the introduction of distributed hybrid recommendation algorithm, the use of this algorithm can speed up filtering, screening, matching and optimization speed, to achieve the production and distribution of short video content, combined with short video dissemination agenda setting method and mixing algorithm, can significantly improve the efficiency of agenda mixing. The essence of short video agenda setting is to integrate platform resources and media resources through reorganization, set new topics, and cooperate with each other to achieve agenda setting and dissemination, comprehensively improve the accuracy of topic review, and improve the efficiency of agenda mixing.

articleTitle: Effective Compound Character OCR for Printed Devanagari Script
abstract: Devanagari script serves as the foundation for three prominent languages: Hindi, spoken by over 520 million, Marathi by over 83 million, and Nepali by over 14 million individuals. It holds the distinction of being the most widely used Brahmic script globally, employed by countless people for reading and writing in their daily lives. Devanagari has a separate class of characters called compound characters which are the conjunction of two consonants. Recognition of printed OCR has been widely explored, however, the use of compound characters in Devanagari makes the problem significantly challenging. This paper focuses on optical character recognition of these compound characters. The task is quite challenging since several of these compound characters are very similar and hence difficult to distinguish. There are a total of 955 such unique characters in Devanagari. We prepared a dataset of these characters, preprocessed them and trained on a linear SVM model. An independent set of test instances was developed as part of the work. A dictionary was also prepared for these characters and complete OCR was performed on these compound characters. The proposed model was tested extensively on the test instances, and obtained an average accuracy of about $84.5 \%$.

articleTitle: Analysis and Accuracy Improvement Method of Quasi-Synchronous Sampling Algorithm In Electrical Parameter Measurement
abstract: With the rapid development of computer digital technology, digital measurement is widely used in power system, which makes the degree of automation of power system increase rapidly. Synchronous sampling plays an important role in electrical parametric measurements to better detect circuits and track grid frequencies. The role of electrical parametric measurements in power systems is very important. Traditional synchronous sampling cannot solve the problem of accurate measurement of electrical parameters in power systems. Therefore, a quasi-synchronous sampling is proposed for electrical parameter measurement and analysis. Firstly, computer technology is used to measure the electrical parameters, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the electrical parameter measurement to reduce the interference factors in the measurement of electrical parameters. Then, computer technology measures the electrical parameters of the power system to form an electrical parameter measurement scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the electrical parameter measurement results. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy of quasi-synchronous sampling for electrical parameter measurement and calculation accuracy of electrical parameter measurement of power system is better than that of traditional synchronous sampling.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Ternary Decoder based on FinFET models
abstract: The escalating intricacy of binary logic-centric digital circuitry is driving an increasing requisition for multivalued logics. Ternary logic is one of the innovative multivalue logic techniques with its ability to handle uncertainty, enhanced information representation, and potential for energy efficiency. This article compares the performance of a ternary decoder designed using different FinFET models. The simulation results were obtained by implementing 18nm FinFET technology, reveals the power consumption of 8.94, 6.13 and $11.37(\mu \mathrm{~W})$ along with transient delay of 3.38, 3.39 and 3.38 (ns), for SVT, HVT and LVT models respectively. Furthermore, the power delay product for the SVT, HVT and LVT versions is calculated to be 30.21, 20.78 and $38.43\left(x 0^{-15} \mathrm{~J}\right)$, respectively. The designed ternary decoder design has numerous advantages in applications such as error correction, quantum computing, and pattern recognition systems.

articleTitle: Performance Metrics Analysis for Container Scheduling in Cloud Environment
abstract: Lightweight virtualization is enabled by containers, which enhances the scalability of applications and simplifies resource optimization. Considering the increasing prevalence of containers, it has become imperative to assess the efficacy of containerized applications. Through the implementation of container technology, the term “containerization” denotes the process of developing, deploying, and managing applications in cloud environments. This study scrutinizes the performance metrics of containers, providing a wide range of parameters for the assessment and enhancement of container scheduling. This article identifies critical performance metrics and discusses their significance in evaluating container performance, based on a thorough literature review and empirical investigation. In addition, the research examines the impact of infrastructure configurations and orchestration platforms on these metrics. Professionals can apply the practical insights provided by this research to improve the efficacy of their cloud-based container applications.

articleTitle: Neural Networks for Fault diagnosis in Electrical Machine
abstract: Finding electrical equipment problems quickly is essential for minimising downtime and ensuring ongoing functioning. When it comes to early defect identification, traditional methods like human inspection or sensor-based surveillance might not cut it. Another alternative to employing machine learning algorithms to analyse complex patterns in sensor data is neural networks. With an emphasis on motor drives, this article lays forth a method for identifying electrical equipment issues using neural networks. The network has been trained to identify various issues, such as imbalanced rotors, broken stator windings, and failing bearings, by examining historical data. The trial findings prove that the suggested method may effectively find issues, make things more reliable, and cut down on maintenance expenses.

articleTitle: Enhancing Intrusion Detection Systems with Deep Learning and Machine Learning Algorithms for Real-Time Threat Classification
abstract: Computer network intrusion has surged dramatically over the past decade, fueled by a lucrative underground cybercrime economy and the proliferation of sophisticated tools for executing such attacks. For over forty years, researchers from both industry and academia have been developing methods and systems to detect and prevent these security breaches. Machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as a powerful tool among the various methods used to classify normal and abnormal behaviour. This study presents an advanced preprocessing strategy combined with a comprehensive evaluation of traditional machine learning models and a deep neural network (DNN) for real-time network intrusion detection.
