Preprocessing includes univariate analysis, feature selection, outlier handling, data normalization, and PCA-based dimensionality reduction. Further, the dataset was divided into train and test sets in the ratio 80:20. Traditional models GB, DT, and ET have been tested; however, ET performs better than all concerning accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and kappa. The proposed DNN model further enhanced detection capabilities, achieving the highest metrics across all evaluation parameters, including an AUC of 1.00, an accuracy of $99.50 \%$ and the lowest misclassification rate. The performance of both traditional and deep learning models was assessed using precision, recall, kappa, accuracy, F1 score, ROC curve analysis, and confusion matrices. The results indicate that the proposed approach is efficient for real-time network intrusion detection and threat analysis.

articleTitle: Automatic Analysis of Disasters and infer Damage Response using Deep Learning
abstract: Effective disaster management techniques are necessary because natural calamities represent serious dangers to both infrastructure and human life. In this study, we address the problem of improving disaster response and recovery by using cutting-edge deep learning methods. The main goals are to categorize damaged infrastructure using cutting-edge techniques and automate the identification of disasters and disaster victims. The methodology used for calamity assessment is described in detail in the paper, which also includes a thorough evaluation of the literature and the integration of deep learning algorithms with disaster photos. The study’s findings support the effectiveness of our suggested strategy for quick disaster response. Notably, the CNN model scored 81.02% accuracy, ResNet50 achieved 90.26%, and VGG16 outperformed with 94.64% accuracy. In summary, by offering creative approaches to lessen the effects of natural emergencies and speed up recovery efforts, our research advances the field of disaster management.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application of Small Vector Algorithm in the Protection of Relay of Generator
abstract: This paper introduces a new generator differential protection strategy using small vector method. When a generator is wrong, the temporary current contains multiple frequencies. Given the effect of the small vector algorithm on increasing these fluctuating currents, it helps to stimulate the response of the protection mechanism when the harmonic components at both ends of the currents differ significantly. The split phase difference disassembly and guard and part of the differential maintenance are respectively composed of their respective branches. Due to the different degrees of fault action, the current harmonic components at both ends are also different, so the microvector technology can be used to enhance the protection effect. The extreme short-circuit current caused by the intrinsic defects of the huge power generation device may have saturated the current transformer, which interferes with the response efficiency of the security device. In contrast, the differential maintenance mechanism with small vector algorithm significantly improves the saturation resistance of the current transformer.

articleTitle: SWIFT: Tailored Autoregression using Semantic Word Insight for Transformers
abstract: In the current era of online publication, the publication rate of online news articles has grown exponentially. The classification of news articles is crucial for easier comprehension of online content. Without proper categorization, readers often struggle to navigate through the vast amounts of news available to them. This paper is devoted to the single-label semantic classification on the combined dataset of BBC All Time and Reuters News. The paper conducted comparative analyses between SWIFT and established classifiers like BERT, alBERT, and DistilBERT. The experiments demonstrate that SWIFT surpasses these generic models on the English News Dataset, yielding superior classification performance, particularly in the categorization of news titles. Comparison with state-of-the-art research shows that SWIFT can be considered as the basis for future predictions and explorations of news dataset analysis.

articleTitle: Gender Classification Using K-Nearest Neighbors and Logistic Regression Models
abstract: This work provides a hybrid model for gender identification integrating face features with logistic regression with K-Nearest Neighbors. The model reached an amazing accuracy of 96% with a balanced loss and good performance throughout multiple classes. Especially in hyperparameter tuning, overfitting, and resolution changes were seen during the development. The first training phase concentrated on problems achieving optimal convergence, which led to necessary modifications in the training calendar. Using architectural and training approaches creation of the model, these issues were solved, so producing a model consistent and accurate for gender classification tasks. The excellent low loss of the earlier model reveals its resistance and longevity by outstanding precision.

articleTitle: Optimizing Gender Identification with MFCC Feature Engineering and Enhanced Gradient Boosting
abstract: Voice-based gender classification has potential significance in the areas of forensic, security and surveillance applications. Biometrics and computer vision [1] are the two areas where gender classification plays vital role. If the audio or the speech sample is noise free, then the recognition accuracy will be high. But, in the case of noisy audio samples and real-time data, existing algorithms failed to achieve greater accuracy. To improve the real-time gender identification, this paper introduces a novel approach that uses feature engineering with optimized Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) Features. VoxCeleb2 dataset was used for experimentation which has $\mathbf{6 0 0 0}$ data samples. The features are extracted from the audio samples and optimized with polynomial features and logarithmic transformation. In addition, Optuna is used for hyperparameter optimization to improve the model’s performance. The proposed methodology was tested with multiple classifiers. An increase of 7.15% was observed on incorporating feature engineering.

articleTitle: High Dynamic Range Edge Filtered LeNet based Gemstone Classification
abstract: The precise detection of subtle characteristics and textures in gemstone photographs is necessary for the hard process of effective gemstone categorization. This research provides a unique method of classifying gemstones using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) based on LeNet and edge-filtered images. By highlighting the edges and contrasts in gemstone images, edge filtering improves the visibility of important characteristics including cuts, facets, and defects. The HDR function reveals subtle color and texture changes that are essential for differentiating between different types of gemstones by capturing a wider range of light intensities. This paper proposes High Dynamic Range Edge Filtered LeNet (HDEF-LeNet) that categorizes the Gemstone types with high accuracy. The Gemstone Dataset that includes 800 images was used for this execution. The HDR edge filtered images are extracted from the original images. After that, a customized HDEF-LeNet architecture designed to take into account the special qualities of gemstone images that is fed with this preprocessed data. Our strategy seeks to outperform conventional approaches based on conventional imaging techniques in terms of gemstone classification and accuracy. The findings of the experiments show that combining edge filtering and HDR with LeNet improves performance in classification tasks for gemstones, providing a viable approach to more accurate and consistent gemstone identification. The experiment demonstrates that the suggested HDEF-LeNet model works better in the categorization of gemstone types, with a high accuracy of $\mathbf{99.68 \%}$.

articleTitle: PV Maximum Power Tracking Point Based on Adaptive PSO Algorithm
abstract: The study of adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (APSO) algorithms for Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) in photovoltaic (PV) systems is essential due to the fluctuating nature of environmental conditions such as shading and varying light intensity. Traditional MPPT methods like Perturb and Observe (P&O) and Incremental Conductance (IncCond) often struggle with dynamic changes, particularly under partial shading conditions, which result in multiple local maxima on the power-voltage characteristic curve of PV arrays. This research focuses on developing an APSO algorithm that dynamically adjusts its parameters to efficiently track the global maximum power point (GMPP), thereby enhancing the overall efficiency and reliability of PV systems. APSO improves upon the conventional PSO by incorporating adaptive mechanisms for the algorithm’s key parameters, including inertia weight and learning factors. These parameters are crucial as they influence the balance between exploration and exploitation during the optimization process. The inertia weight is adjusted dynamically from a higher value at the beginning of the iterations to a lower value towards the end, facilitating broader search capabilities initially and finer convergence later on. Similarly, the cognitive (c1) and social (c2) learning factors are adaptively tuned to maintain an optimal balance between individual particle experiences and the swarm’s collective knowledge, thus avoiding premature convergence to local optima and ensuring robust tracking of the GMPP. To validate the effectiveness of the APSO algorithm, we implemented a simulation using Matlab/Simulink. The PV system model included a solar array connected to a DC-DC converter, managed by an MPPT controller utilizing the APSO algorithm. Initial positions and velocities of the particles were randomly set within a defined range, and the fitness function, representing the power output of the PV system, guided the iterative adjustment of particle positions. The APSO algorithm demonstrated superior performance by consistently converging to the GMPP under various shading patterns and rapidly changing light conditions, outperforming traditional MPPT methods in both tracking speed and accuracy. The experimental results highlighted the APSO algorithm’s capability to enhance the energy conversion efficiency of PV systems significantly. Its adaptive nature allows for real-time adjustments, making it highly responsive to environmental fluctuations and reducing the likelihood of the system being trapped in local maxima. Furthermore, the simulation studies indicated a notable improvement in stability and robustness, critical factors for the practical deployment of PV systems in diverse climatic conditions. In conclusion, the APSO algorithm represents a significant advancement in MPPT technology, offering a sophisticated and adaptive approach to maximizing the efficiency of PV systems. Future research will focus on optimizing the computational aspects of the APSO algorithm to further reduce its implementation cost and exploring its application in distributed PV systems and microgrid environments. Through continuous innovation, APSO has the potential to play a pivotal role in advancing renewable energy technologies, contributing to the global pursuit of sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Piano Automatic Accompaniment System based on Sound Type Database
abstract: In today’s society, artificial intelligence technology is developing rapidly, and algorithm composition is one of the research directions. It is no longer possible to keep up with the demand for piano accompaniment, and the use of artificial intelligence methods for piano accompaniment has become a trend. Therefore, this paper proposes a piano automatic accompaniment system for piano accompaniment analysis. Firstly, the HMM model is used to simulate the composition accompaniment, and the indicators are divided according to the piano accompaniment requirements to reduce them Disturbing factors in piano accompaniment. Then, the HMM model simulates the results of piano accompaniment of melodic compositions to form a piano accompaniment scheme and accompaniment results to the piano Conduct a comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition of certain evaluation criteria, the piano automatic accompaniment system is feasible for piano accompaniment of melodic music. Piano accompaniment is more flexible than traditional accompaniment methods.

articleTitle: Maize Seed Quality detection using ResNet V2 Deep Learning Technique
abstract: Recent advancements in agricultural technology have seen the application of computational methods for seed quality detection. A range of studies have explored the use of deep learning in seed quality detection in agriculture. For the agricultural sector to achieve maximum crop yields and food security, the quality of the maize seeds must be guaranteed. The conventional techniques for evaluating the quality of seeds, which depend on visual inspection and biochemical analyses, are labor-intensive, time-consuming, and frequently prone to human error. We suggest using the ResNet $\mathbf{v} 2$ deep learning architecture in an automated maize seed quality detection system to overcome these issues. In the proposed work, we assembled an extensive dataset of photos of maize seeds. To assess the performance of the model, the dataset was divided into subsets for training, validation, and testing. To improve the model’s capacity for generalization, data augmentation methods including rotation, zooming, and flipping were used during training. Starting with pre-trained weights on ImageNet, the ResNet v2 model was refined via transfer learning. Stochastic gradient descent with a learning rate scheduler was then used to further optimize the model. This research employs images of maize seeds for the purpose of classification. The process of classification is facilitated through the utilization of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that operates on the ResNet152 v2 architecture. The chosen hyperparameters include a learning rate set at 0.001, a batch size of 512, and an epoch of 150. The optimization technique employed is Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam). The distribution between training and validation data is maintained at a ratio of $80: 20$. Analysis of the validation outcomes reveals an accuracy rate of $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$ compared to other traditional models.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Ternary Full Subtractor Implemented Using FinFET models
abstract: Multivalue logics have proved to be advantageous in the field of digital system design because they offer lower circuit complexity and enhanced energy efficiency. Ternary logic is usually seen as an innovative approach in the realm of multivalue logic. The design of a ternary full subtractor utilizing 18 nm FinFET technology is reported in this article by means of Cadence’s Virtuoso tool. Further, by comparing the outcomes obtained from the SVT and HVT FinFET models, the performance of the ternary full subtractor is examined. The simulation results obtained for the SVT and HVT FinFET models show power consumption values of 156.1 and $94.9 \mu \mathrm{~W}$, transient delay values of 33.04 and 32.87 ns, and power delay product values of 5.15 and $3.11\left(x \quad 10^{-12} \mathrm{~J}\right)$, respectively. The suggested ternary full subtractor architecture has applications in ternary signal processing, data compression, encoding and decoding of data, and error correction codes that employ ternary digits.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Two-stage CMOS Operational Amplifier using Chaotic PSO
abstract: In this paper a two-stage CMOS opamp is designed using a novel evolutionary algorithm called as Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization (CPSO). The CPSO algorithm is an improved version of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). PSO offers a robust and flexible approach to VLSI circuit optimization, leveraging the collective behavior of particles to explore the search space and find optimal solutions. Its simplicity and global search capability make it a valuable tool for tackling complex optimization problems in VLSI design. CPSO integrates chaotic dynamics into the standard PSO process. The primary objective of CPSO is to enhance the global search capability and convergence speed of the traditional PSO by introducing chaos theory principles. CPSO is used here to obtain the optimal aspect ratio of each transistor to decrease the total transistor area while meeting design limitations. The results achieved using the CPSO are validated in the SPICE. SPICE-based results show that CPSO is a considerably better algorithm than previously reported techniques for designing op-amp.

articleTitle: Transforming Sign Language Recognition with VGG16 and ResNet50 Deep Learning Models
abstract: Sign language recognition (SLR) is essential for facilitating communication for individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing. This study examines the effectiveness of two popular deep learning models, VGG16 and ResNet50, in SLR applications. By employing the VGG16 and ResNet50 frameworks, we achieved high accuracy rates of 99.92% and 99.95%, respectively, in recognizing sign language gestures. Our findings demonstrate that these models are highly effective in interpreting hand movements and gestures, thus enhancing communication for sign language users. This research leverages advanced deep learning techniques to advance SLR systems, offering significant potential for improving inclusive communication and accessibility.

articleTitle: Coulomb Counting Method for Battery Management System
abstract: Lithium ion batteries are becoming more and more common in electrical vehicles and many household applications due to their high efficiency, low self-discharge rate, and higher gravimetric and volumetric energy density.These batteries requires precise monitoring to ensure operation within set safe operating limits because, due to their high energy-carrying capacity, they are considered to be more hazardous than other any other batteries. Failing to do so may lead to threats and outbreaks of flames.This necessitates the adoption of a sophisticated BMS that will maximize battery power tension while maintaining safe operating parameters to keep users safe.This paper looks at the critical elements that lead to the development of an efficient intelligent BMS and models batteries utilizing passive components. Additionally, it provides simulation, which makes it possible to comprehend how a BMS functions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction: Integrated VGG19 Model Ensemble With SVM Classifier
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease is the most prevalent disease around the world, it is a very common type of dementia. It happens mostly in old people whose age is above 60 years. After doing research, researchers found that by using the Deep Learning (DL) models it becomes easier for doctors to diagnose the disease at the early stages, and the death rate could be decreased by using such models of DL. The paper worked on DL models for the early classification of Alzheimer’s disease. VGG19 and Support Vector Machine (SVM) models are used to classify Alzheimer’s. VGG19 model is used for the feature extraction and SVM will classify the dementia. For the classification of the results, $\mathbf{3}$-fold Cross-Validation is applied to the model for the enhancement of the model’s accuracy after applying cross-validation accuracy increases from 60% to 78%, SVM classifier works better on the data set Alzheimer’s disease.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning Hierarchical Perception Technology in 3D Clothing Design
abstract: The main drawbacks of the previous tailor-made clothing method in the garment manufacturing industry are long production cycle, large measurement error and low output, which can no longer meet the needs of consumers for tailor-made large-scale clothing. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, computer graphics, and virtual reality technology, the trend of digital clothing technology is idle 3D. In this paper, deep learning hierarchical perception technology is used to design 3D clothing, establish human feature recognition and 3D clothing digital modeling, use deep learning neural network model to identify 3D human body shape features, judge feature lines according to the set threshold, and obtain feature points according to the identified feature lines to fit the human dimension curve, so as to measure human body size. Realize 3D clothing design. By applying deep learning hierarchical perception technology, it can effectively improve the measurement accuracy of clothing size, reduce measurement errors, and achieve mass production.

articleTitle: Developing an Application for Managing and Creating Private Keys for Cryptographic Communication
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive study on the development of an application for secure certificate generation and management utilizing OpenSSL with Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) encryption. In response to the escalating demand for robust security measures in digital environments, the proposed application aims to enhance the integrity and trustworthiness of certificate issuance processes. Leveraging OpenSSL for private key generation, Certificate Signing Request (CSR) signing, and certificate management, coupled with AES encryption for secure key storage, the application offers a systematic approach to mitigate vulnerabilities associated with traditional certificate management practices. The research encompasses a detailed exploration of methodologies, validation procedures, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability and security of the implemented solutions. Furthermore, the paper discusses future prospects for the integration of transient signing keys and the continual refinement of certificate management practices to meet evolving security challenges.

articleTitle: QICCNN: Quantum-inspired Complex Convolutional Neural Network based brain tumor detection from MRI images
abstract: the autonomous identification and categorization of brain malignancies by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) may pose difficulties and the possibility of inaccuracies due to the procedure's complex and time-intensive nature. The complexity of the brain tumor detection procedure is primarily due to the need for a thorough assessment that includes numerous modules. The progress of deep learning (DL) has enabled the development of automated systems for medical image processing and diagnostics, providing a possible answer to this problem. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are a widely used approach in the fields of visual learning and image categorization. The present work provides a new approach that combines image improvement approaches, namely, the elimination of noise using adaptive filters and the augmentation of contrast. Furthermore, we develop a quantum-inspired complex convolutional neural network classifier. This classifier includes a convolution layer that performs feature mapping using a parameterized quantum circuit. The remaining layers utilize classical operations and ultimately accomplish the task of classifying brain tumors into four categories. The experiments in this study use the publicly available Kaggle brain tumor magnetic resonance imaging dataset. We evaluated the proposed approach, QICCNN, using several parameters. The results showed an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9 . 8 9 \%}$, precision of $\mathbf{9 8 . 7 8 \%}$, recall of $\mathbf{9 6 . 8 7 \%}$, and an f1-score of $\mathbf{9 7 . 5 6 \%}$.

articleTitle: IoT based Truck Wheel Temperature Monitoring System
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to design an IoT based truck wheel temperature monitoring system using Arduino board with the aim to overcome endanger and raise the safety measures for truck and goods. By designing and implementing a temperature-detecting system, we can detect the temperature of the wheels trucks. By the use of such detecting device we can prevent the major problem associated with wheel’s temperature and may avoid the major accidents. This monitoring system senses the temperature data of the wheel and transmits through the Wi-Fi module. In addition, it upgrades Thingspeak channel that can collect the data and it can easily be accessed by the transport agency and the truck driver. This can further be analysed using any computer system or mobile with internet connectivity anywhere across the globe to take real-time decision. The core function of the proposed detecting system is to monitor the real- time value of truck wheel temperature and to inform the concerned people.

articleTitle: Research on Car Access Control System based on Improved AES algorithm
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the automotive field is also constantly using high technology to meet people’s requirements for automotive intelligence, and the car access control system is a good embodiment. At the beginning, when intelligent technology was not popularized, it was necessary to use mechanical methods to open or close the car door, and with the use of intelligent technology, the car access control system was born. The access control system of the car in the car intelligence and safety makes a very important part, the owner uses the smart key to get close to the car, you can realize the door opening and closing, can also achieve a key start. Ordinary access control systems cannot better solve the problem of car access control systems in automotive intelligence and security. During the analysis of the car access control system, it was found that the method proposed in this article can effectively manage cars and vehicles, improve vehicle safety, and ensure the stability of the entire system operation. Moreover, in the comprehensive judgment and analysis process of the entire system, it can identify one piece of paper to ensure the qualification of car transportation. access control systems and encryption of automotive access control systems in the field of automotive intelligence and security.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Watchdog timer’s Microarchitecture and design for a RISC-V-based SoC using 45nm Technology
abstract: WDT in safety-critical Embedded systems, such as the one used for airborne application requires that it be highly dependable and take care of operation time-related failures automatically and transparently to ensure high dependability can be achieved with their use. In developing such a WDT, one challenge is taking an existing off-the-shelf capable device, which is typically highly specialized for singlepurpose end-doing approaches. This work helps to resolve this challenge by developing a next-generation programmable WDT and using it in various applications. The WDT that will be proposed is a processor-based real-time system where the capabilities and activities in the processor are significantly more common. The effectiveness of the proposed WDT is assessed using simulation results to determine its capability to identify the kind of defects and to take pertinent actions. Test benches have been integrated to create errors in the design and track a system’s operation, which is necessary for the WDT to function properly. Verilog HDL, a hardware description language widely used in digital circuit design, is utilized to create WDT. The goal of this work is to provide generalizable WDT that may be used in a variety of contexts, including ones that are safety focused. To ensure that the WDT is operating as intended and that it can be depended upon for handling the process duration during failure, simulation, and test benches are employed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Teeth Detection and Numbering System using YOLO
abstract: In the field of Dental Medicine, the proper understanding and analysis of OPGs (Dental Orthopantomogramme) play a significant role in the diagnostic process. Accurate detection and numbering of teeth are crucial for applications such as enhancing dental diagnosis, treatment planning, and oral health assessment. This research incorporates a YOLOv8 algorithm with a custom curated dataset of $\mathrm{4 5 5 0}$ images to tackle this pivotal task. The dataset includes a wide variety of dental images with 32 classes based on the FDI numbering system. To ensure privacy protection, details like names, genders, ages, medical records, or timestamps are omitted. The evaluation metrics include precision, recall, and mean Average Precision (mAP). The results have provided valuable insights, with YOLOv8 exhibiting an impressive precision of 0.98, a recall of 0.97, and an mAP50 of 0.98, showcasing its robustness in teeth detection. These results demonstrate its potential for practical implementation, streamlining clinician tasks, saving time, and enhancing diagnostic accuracy. The potential to complement or even replace human assessment supports its role in the decision-making process in dental diagnostics.

articleTitle: Motion Control of Railway Machinery Room Inspection Robot Based on Deep Learning
abstract: In this study, the motion control process of the inspection robot in the railway machinery room is described, and the effective training and deployment of the deep learning model are used to achieve the ultimate goal. Firstly, after repeated comparative experiments, CNN was determined to be the core model of this study, and the advantages of the model in time series data and image data processing were used to develop the research objectives. In this paper, the cross-validation method is used to continuously optimize the network structure and hyperparameters and improve the generalization ability of the model under complex environmental conditions. In addition, mature attention mechanism and data augmentation technology are introduced to enhance the accuracy and robustness of the model’s prediction. Finally, the optimized CNN model is directly deployed to the embedded computing unit of the inspection robot system in the railway machinery room, so that it can collect equipment data in real time and realize important decisions such as effective fault prediction and remaining service life estimation. In order to ensure the reliability of decision-making, a special fault diagnosis module is designed in this paper, which can confirm the model output twice. It can be seen in practice that this method can significantly improve the maintenance efficiency and prolong the service life of the equipment.

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing Applications in Real-Time Financial Risk Management
abstract: The incorporation of cognitive computing into realtime financial threat operations, to highlight the revolutionary potential of this technology for the financial sector. Cognitive computing, which is a combination of artificial intelligence, machine literacy, and natural language processing, improves the capability to reuse enormous quantities of financial data quickly and directly. The purpose of this study is to investigate how cognitive systems can recognise, evaluate, and mitigate financial risks in real-time. These systems offer greater prophetic analytics and decision-making support in comparison to traditional methods. Cognitive computing makes it possible to conduct more accurate threat assessments, detect implicit dangers earlier, and improve nonsupervisory compliance. This is accomplished through the use of sophisticated algorithms and data analytics. Case studies illustrate the practical applications of these technologies through the use of colourful financial scripts, demonstrating how beneficial they are in improving threat operating methods. In the final section of the study, the author discusses the counterarguments that cognitive computing poses for the future of fiscal threat operation, as well as the implicit issues that are associated with its widespread abandonment.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Synchronous Full Adder with Clock Gating Technique for ALU Design in 22nm Technology
abstract: Clock gating is a prominent method for reducing the dynamic power dissipation in synchronous circuits, effectively reducing overall power consumption. It focuses on the clock signal of the system, which is a significant source of power consumption in electronic circuits. The integration of the clock-gating technique into the design of Arithmetic Logic Units (ALUs) can significantly lower power dissipation by eliminating redundant clock signals in idle states. Although clock gating is not a novel idea, it is widely used in contemporary chip designs. This guarantees a thorough approach to power reduction for every chip unit. A complete adder circuit has been developed and simulated using clock gating techniques using a 22 nm standard technology. This optimized design is especially useful for low-power applications because it maintains a moderate area efficiency while drastically reducing power demands.

articleTitle: Electrical Load Forecasting by using CANFIS Controller with Gaussian Function
abstract: The significant significance of load forecasting models is necessary for electrical utilities to manage power intelligently. Power generation is backed by a multitude of resources due to the digitalization of the sectors. As a result, different models have differing forecasting accuracy. When projecting future electrical consumption, power utilities with multiple generation modalities have difficulties and a sizable degree of error. A utility must use forecasting technologies to estimate future electricity demand with the least amount of inaccuracy in order to control the power flow with minimal power outages. In paper this we highlighted and more focus on Momentum learning rule, Bell membership function and Gaussian membership functions are used to enable the Co-Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (CANFIS) architecture’s adaptation to a variety of data patterns and complexities. The membership functions hold significant importance in facilitating the model’s ability to precisely represent the innate uncertainties and nonlinearities found in real-world datasets. This research thoroughly examines the effects of various CANFIS framework configurations on important performance parameters, including learning efficiency, prediction accuracy, and generalisation capacity.

articleTitle: Generative AI: A Pix2pix-GAN-Based Machine Learning Approach for Robust and Efficient Lung Segmentation
abstract: Chest radiography is climacteric in identifying different pulmonary diseases, yet radiologist workload and inefficiency can lead to misdiagnoses. Automatic, accurate, and efficient lung segmentation from chest X-ray (CXR) images is paramount for early disease detection. This study develops a deep learning framework using a Pix2pix Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to segment pulmonary abnormalities from CXR images. This framework’s image preprocessing and augmentation techniques were properly incorporated with a U-Net-inspired generator-discriminator architecture. Initially, it loaded the CXR images and manual masks from the Montgomery and Shenzhen datasets, after which preprocessing and resizing were performed. A U-Net generator is applied to the processed CXR images that yield segmented masks; then, a Discriminator Network differentiates between the generated and real masks. The model was trained on the Montgomery dataset in the study, and the Shenzhen dataset was used to test its robustness, which was used here for the first time. An adversarial loss and an L1 distance were used to optimize the model in training. All metrics, which assess precision, recall, F1 score, and Dice coefficient, prove the effectiveness of this framework in pulmonary abnormality segmentation. It, therefore, sets the basis for future studies to be performed shortly using diverse datasets that could further confirm its clinical applicability in medical imaging.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning for Heart Disease Prediction: Fourier Transformation meets CNN on MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Dataset
abstract: heart disease continues to cause major morbidity and death globally. Heart disease prognosis and prevention remain difficult despite medical breakthroughs. Coronary artery disease, heart failure, arrhythmias, and congenital heart abnormalities are all types of heart disease. These illnesses strain people, healthcare systems, and economies worldwide. Age, gender, genetics, hypertension, diabetes, obesity, smoking, and inactivity are heart disease risk factors. Machine learning algorithms may improve illness prediction and risk stratification using vast medical data. ML models may find complicated patterns and interactions in electronic health records, medical imaging, genetic data, and lifestyle variables. Hybrid ML models increase predicted accuracy and generalizability by combining decision trees, support vector machines, neural networks, and ensemble approaches. Innovative prediction and preventative methods are needed to combat heart disease. Machine learning hybrid models may improve heart disease risk prediction by integrating varied data sources, using complicated algorithms, and boosting forecast accuracy.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement of Symbols used by Sensory Impaired Using LOG Transformation
abstract: It is broadly accepted that the intensity gradient of an object rapidly varies around its key features and at its edges. So while locating objects in an image, it is important to detect image edegs first but it is not as easy as over the noisy images. In this paper, to achieve the required results, an efficient edge detection hybrid approach is being presented. The noisy image is being smoothened by using Gaussian filter and then subsequently log filter is emplioyed for edge detection. A log approach is one of the type of gray level image transformation. A logarithm transformation of an image means that all of the image’s pixel values are replaced with logarithmic values. Because it boosts the image’s dark pixels when compared to higher pixel values, log transformation is employed for image enhancement.

articleTitle: Impact of Misinformation on Reddit User Behavior: A Multimodal Transformer-Based Detection Model
abstract: The proliferation of misinformation poses significant challenges to information integrity in the digital age. This research work presents a detailed analysis of how misinformation affects user behaviour on social networking sites like Reddit, and proposes a unified multimodal approach for detecting misinformation using both fake news texts and tampered images, by combining state-of-the-art deep learning models such as DistilBERT for text classification and Vision Transformer (ViT) for image classification. The analysis suggested that posts containing fake news encourage users to engage superficially, without promoting critical thinking. The proposed method integrates the transformer-based models to create a robust system capable of addressing the dual challenges of content verification. The models were trained and evaluated on a comprehensive dataset containing paired news articles and images, achieving an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 5 \%}$ in detecting fake news texts and 88.1% in identifying tampered images. The proposed unified model serves as a scalable solution for mitigating the spread of misinformation and manipulated visuals, contributing to the broader effort of maintaining the integrity of online information.

articleTitle: Mechanism of Virtual Power Plant with Emphasis on Distributed Generation Integration
abstract: Energy is the basis of all the development as far as human civilization is considered. During the last few decades, energy crisis, pollution and global warming has attracted much attention. The increasing consciousness on climatic variation in the past decades and influence of usage of conventional fossil fuels as fast depleting sources of energy has created an urgent need to use alternate sources to meet this ever-growing energy demand. The mandate for transforming conventional monopolistic and low efficiency power system has become a fundamental topic around the world research scenario. The latest phase of energy revolution emphasizes on information integration and use of internet and latest technologies along with new energy strategies and policies to take care of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) penetration into the electrical power systems. The concept of virtual power plant (VPP) ascended to take care of integration of distributed generation (DG). VPP can be suggested as a sustainable solution for renewable energy integration. It is basically an integration of distributed resources in a united frame. This is an energy efficient, consumer beneficial system which has benefits to energy creators in the electricity markets. This paper gives an introduction of the types, working, components, advantages and limitations of Virtual Power Plant.

articleTitle: Enhanced Signal Processing through Frequency Normalization using Fourier Transform Techniques
abstract: In the realm of signal processing, achieving accurate frequency normalization is pivotal for the effective analysis and interpretation of signals across various applications. This paper presents a novel approach to frequency normalization utilizing Fourier Transform techniques to enhance signal processing capabilities. By leveraging the mathematical robustness of the Fourier Transform, the proposed method systematically adjusts and normalizes frequency components, thereby improving the clarity and precision of signal analysis. Author addresses common challenges such as signal distortion and noise interference, providing a more reliable framework for applications in communications, biomedical engineering, and audio signal processing. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our method in maintaining signal integrity and enhancing processing performance, particularly in complex and noisy environments. This research offers significant advancements in the field of signal processing, paving the way for more accurate and efficient frequency normalization techniques.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Algorithms in Earthquake Multi-Attribute Analysis
abstract: The correspondence between seismic attributes and reservoir characteristics is the correspondence, and if a single seismic attribute prediction reservoir is used for multi-attribute analysis, multi-solution will occur, and the classification and quantity of seismic attributes are also more detailed, and the multi-attribute analysis of earthquake attributes through combination optimization and comprehensive analysis has become the future development trend. In recent years, artificial intelligence, big waves technology has developed rapidly, shock waves and acoustic waves based on their own advantages have been applied in various fields, this paper uses shock waves and acoustic waves for earthquake multi-attribute analysis, can accurately obtain seismic attribute information, attribute analysis can maximize the effective information on the profile in-depth mining, based on the multi-attribute analysis results of the detection area structural distribution state comprehensive interpretation, reduce the error caused by human measurement, but different seismic attributes on various structural sensitivity is different, to combine geological conditions, Stratigraphic conditions use shock waves and acoustic waves to select multiple seismic attributes from the best, which can effectively improve the recognition of seismic attributes and reduce the interpretation error.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of FinFET models based Quaternary Multiplexer
abstract: Multivalue logic systems are gaining popularity in recent years since they have the potential to compensate the drawbacks of conventional binary logic by enhancing computational efficiency and data replication. Quaternary logic is an emerging perspective in the field of multivalue logic, which presents a solution to the limitations of traditional binary logic by allowing four states instead of two states. In this paper, a quaternary $4: 1$ multiplexer using three different models of 18 nm FinFET technology is designed. Simulations were performed on the simulation tool cadence virtuoso and comparative analysis was done by using LVT, SVT, and HVT FinFET models. The designed quaternary $4: 1$ multiplexer find applications in various digital systems including microprocessors, digital signal processing, communication systems, and arithmetic units. They are used for selecting between multiple input sources, routing data, implementing logic functions, and reducing the complexity of circuit designs.

articleTitle: A systematic Study on the Usage of Various Attention Mechanisms for Plant Leaf Disease Detection
abstract: Plant diseases significantly impact the agriculture sector, resulting in substantial productivity and economic losses. Effective plant health monitoring systems are crucial for sustainable agriculture, and predicting various diseases is a critical task. This work aims to provide accessible and informative visual data to farmers, enabling proactive decision-making and timely action. Deep learning models, particularly vision transformers with attention mechanisms, have performed well in numerous computer vision tasks. This comprehensive review provides an in-depth exploration of attention mechanisms in vision transformers, examining their role in enhancing image recognition, object detection, and other computer vision tasks. In this work, customized vision transfer with MobileNet as a classifier is proposed. Furthermore, it discusses future research directions and presents findings from extensive training and evaluation on diverse datasets, revealing that multi-head attention blocks significantly improve accuracy, outperforming other attention mechanisms.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of CNN-based Deep Learning Models for Landslide Detection
abstract: Landslides inflict substantial societal and economic damage, underscoring their global significance as recurrent and destructive natural disasters. Recent landslides in northern parts of India and Nepal have caused significant disruption, damaging infrastructure and posing threats to local communities. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), a type of deep learning technique, have shown remarkable success in image processing. Because of their sophisticated architectures, advanced CNN-based models perform better in landslide detection than conventional algorithms. The purpose of this work is to investigate CNNs’ potential in more detail, with an emphasis on comparison of CNN based models for better landslide detection. We compared four traditional semantic segmentation models (U-Net, LinkNet, PSPNet, and FPN) and utilized the ResNet50 backbone encoder to implement them. Moreover, we have experimented with the hyperparameters such as learning rates, batch sizes, and regularization techniques to fine-tune the models. We have computed the confusion matrix for each model and used performance metrics including precision, recall and f1-score to evaluate and compare the deep learning models. According to the experimental results, LinkNet gave the best results among the four models having an Accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 4 9 \%}$ and a F1-score of $\mathbf{8 5. 7 \%}$ (with $\mathbf{8 4. 4 9 \%}$ precision, 87.07% recall). We have also presented a comprehensive comparison of all pixel-wise confusion matrix results and the time taken to train each model.

articleTitle: Robust Image Classification: Defensive Strategies against FGSM and PGD Adversarial Attacks
abstract: Adversarial attacks, particularly the Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) pose significant threats to the robustness of deep learning models in image classification. This paper explores and refines defense mechanisms against these attacks to enhance the resilience of neural networks. We employ a combination of adversarial training and innovative preprocessing techniques, aiming to mitigate the impact of adversarial perturbations. Our methodology involves modifying input data before classification and investigating different model architectures and training strategies. Through rigorous evaluation of benchmark datasets, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in defending against FGSM and PGD attacks. Our results show substantial improvements in model robustness compared to baseline methods, highlighting the potential of our defense strategies in real-world applications. This study contributes to the ongoing efforts to develop secure and reliable machine learning systems, offering practical insights and paving the way for future research in adversarial defense. By bridging theoretical advancements and practical implementation, we aim to enhance the trustworthiness of AI applications in safety-critical domains.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning for Identification and Analysis of Cotton Crop Pathologies
abstract: India is an agrarian economy, Agriculture impacts everyone, right from the living standard, support of the economy through business and trade.Agricultural practice constitutes the backbone for close to $58 \%$ of the Indian populace; the occupation asserts many rural society.Agriculture also plays a vital role in the GDP in the country contributing about $15-18 \%$.There are various commercial crops but in this context, cotton crop has been addressed.Being the versatile crop in textile industry, medical products, Agriculture and many more, remains one of the most useful broadly grown valuable crop. That is why it is essential to deal with the health of cotton as it faces challenges from diseases by particulates such as fungi, bacteria, virus and nematodes impact on health and yield. Overcoming all these challenges is crucial in preventing the crop from contracting these diseases. To address the diseases, deep learning models has been applied in this study.Tradition methods can be of low efficient while working with high-dimensional data, also require more intervention from humans. Deep learning as a part of machine learning applies the number of dense layers, which behave similar to human brain;deep learning is more effective and precise than traditional algorithms.In this study, predictive models in the deep learning such as convolutional neural networks (CNN), Inception V3, and ResNet-50 have been employed.These algorithms has been shown to be competent in image identification and categorization, it is hence suitable for recording of numerous diseases. With these models, this study aims to come up with model used to detect and diagnose diseases, this model can give promising solution to farmers by joining agriculture agencies online.Applying this technology can enhances the yields, as well as increase the extent of input that the agricultural is capable of making to the economies.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Deep Q-Network for Reinforcement Learning in Wireless IoT Routing Protocols
abstract: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices necessitates robust and energy-efficient routing protocols for sustainable operations. Traditional approaches often fall short in dynamic, resource-constrained IoT environments. This study introduces a novel framework that integrates a Deep Q-Network (DQN), a deep reinforcement learning model, into IoT routing protocols to enhance energy efficiency. Each IoT device acts as an independent agent, making routing decisions based on local observations such as signal strength, battery levels, and traffic conditions. The DQN architecture comprises input layers reflecting the state space, hidden layers for complex relational modeling, and an output layer suggesting routing actions by estimating rewards. Simulations conducted in NS3, reflecting real-world IoT conditions, demonstrate the framework’s effectiveness. Key performance metrics show significant improvements: energy consumption per packet is reduced to $2.1 \mathrm{~J} /$ packet compared to $3.5 \mathrm{~J} /$ packet with AODV and $3.3 \mathrm{~J} /$ packet with DSR; network lifetime is extended to $\mathbf{7 5}$ days versus 50 days with AODV and 53 days with DSR; packet delivery ratio is increased to $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$ from 88% with AODV and 85% with DSR; and end-to-end delay is reduced to 0.7 seconds. These results indicate that the DQN-based protocol substantially outperforms traditional methods in energy efficiency and operational sustainability. This study demonstrates the feasibility of integrating deep learning with IoT communications, promoting greener and more efficient IoT solutions and opening new avenues for intelligent and sustainable network management.

articleTitle: Wildfire Area prediction using Federated Learning
abstract: This research investigates the application of centralized learning and federated learning methodologies in the context of wildfire prediction across the United States. Centralized learning, a conventional approach, involves consolidating diverse datasets encompassing historical fire data, weather patterns, vegetation density, and geographical information into a centralized repository for model training. However, this approach is fraught with challenges, including concerns over data privacy, security vulnerabilities during data aggregation and transfer, and limitations in scalability when dealing with large volumes of data. Conversely, federated learning presents a decentralized alternative, enabling model training to occur locally on client devices while preserving data privacy and security. By distributing the model training process across multiple edge devices or local servers, federated learning offers real-time updates and scalability, making it well-suited for large-scale deployment in heterogeneous geographical areas. This study aims to comprehensively evaluate the efficacy of centralized and federated learning methodologies in wildfire prediction and management, considering factors such as data privacy, security, scalability, and predictive accuracy. Through rigorous analysis and experimentation, the research endeavors to provide insights into the optimal approach for enhancing wildfire prediction models and mitigating the adverse impacts of wildfires across the United States.

articleTitle: Investigation of AI Driven Security Enhancement in 5G and 6G Sensor Networks via Intelligent Routing and Energy prediction
abstract: The rapid expansion of wireless networks from 1G to 5G has transformed the way the world connects, opening up revolutionary possibilities across various industries. The pressing requirement to address the complex issues posed by these advanced technologies, especially in the areas of energy efficiency and security, has been intensified by the upcoming implementation of 6 G networks. This paper will explore the advancements made by AI in enhancing 5 G and 6 G sensor networks, with a focus on intelligent routing and energy prediction. Intelligent routing enhances data transmission routes by employing reinforcement learning techniques like deep Q-networks and Q-learning to dynamically adjust to changing network conditions. Energy prediction is an advanced energy management solution that utilizes cutting-edge neural network architectures, such as LSTM, to anticipate consumption trends. It discusses various technologies that aim to enhance network scalability, security, and efficiency. These technologies achieve this by implementing a comprehensive system integration approach that incorporates SDN principles, virtualization, and interoperable protocols. AI has reduced the latency by about $20 \%$ to $\mathbf{3 0 \%}$ compared to normal techniques. The findings shows that AI is important in shaping the future of wireless networks. It will empower networks to not only adjust to but also take advantage of emerging environments.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Framework for Intrusion Detection in Cloud Computing Based on HLA-CNN-BiLSTM-SVM Model
abstract: In addition to describing a way to make better use of preexisting computer infrastructures, the phrase “cloud computing” describes a technology that facilitates the sale of access to shared computer resources and services. The flip side is that these dispersed and convoluted infrastructures are attractive targets for attackers. Because cyberattacks can reduce the quality of service offered to clients, the system constitute a substantial risk. This proposed method consists of three steps like preprocessing, feature selection, and model training. Data preprocessing, which includes both feature discretization and feature normalization, is a critical step in any knowledge discovery process. In this proposed to evaluate the impact of feature selection on improving classifier algorithm accuracy by comparing two feature selection methods: one that takes linear correlation into account, and another that takes mutual information into account. When training the model, an HLA-CNN-BiLSTM-SVM was utilized. With a 92.35 percent average accuracy, the suggested method surpasses CNN-SVM and BiLSTM.

articleTitle: Image Captioning using Domain Ontology based Semantic Attention Approaches
abstract: Deep Learning has spawned rich interest in a wide range of research areas involving text, image, and video formats. Traditional neural networks have limitations to handling such data types that were overcome with innovative research in deep net architectures. Image Captioning is one such application that has progressed leaps and bounds making a huge impact in fields like medical diagnosis, assistive technologies, and its likes. The task here is to precisely and accurately describe the image that is being presented. Researchers have built various models to handle this adopting advanced deep learning techniques. However, the key challenge to be noted is that practically all applications of image captioning are applied to a particular domain of interest, generation of naïve or generic captions will not suit much to make an impact. This gap is bridged by proposing a novel architecture called Onto-IC that factors semantic attention by modeling the domain specific ontology that is in consideration. The Onto-IC architecture is a two-stage design wherein the first stage focuses on extraction of image features from datasets containing images and ground truth captions. In the second stage, the captions are generated from images by incorporating domain ontology induced attention mechanisms using LSTM network. The captions used for training include both original and domain specific semantic ontology injected captions. This addresses the concern of generating captions that are more aligned towards the domain under purview. To validate the hypothesis, Flickr8k dataset was utilized for training and the generated model is used to compute and evaluate the image caption metrics. An ablation study conducted on Onto-IC has shown BLEU-1 scores greater than $\mathbf{8 0 \%}$ and the presence of domain specific elements in captions significantly enhances the usage in real life applications. In the concluding section of this paper prospective ideas to further extend the work are discussed.

articleTitle: Transforming Text to Video: Leveraging Advanced Generative AI Techniques
abstract: This comprehensive evaluation paper delves into the realm of textual content-to-video generation using artificial intelligence. The authors present an inclusive analysis of key reference papers: VGEN - Text to Video Generation Using AI, MAGVIT, STF, DirecT2V, Text2Video-Zero, Tune-A-Video, and four supplementary papers. These manuscripts collectively address various challenges and propose groundbreaking methodologies for producing high-quality videos from textual prompts. VGEN aims to synthesize videos from textual descriptions using pioneering approaches inspired by the strategic tokenization and embedding techniques employed in MAGVIT. STF introduces a cutting-edge 3D generative model specifically designed for text-to-video generation, while DirecT2V focuses on developing lightweight video diffusion models that operate within a low-dimensional latent space. Text2Video-Zero explores zero-shot video generation using diffusion models, and Tune-A-Video introduces a one-shot tuning method that leverages image diffusion models to generate videos. The additional papers contribute to advancements in latent diffusion models, video LDMs, and spatio-temporal attention mechanisms. By incorporating these techniques, the project aims to generate high-fidelity, long-duration videos with content consistency and motion coherence. Code and models are provided for reproducibility, encouraging collaboration in the field. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of the approaches in producing realistic and diverse videos aligned with textual descriptions. This comprehensive review paper serves as a guide to current strategies in text-to-video technology, offering insights and directions for future research in this exciting field.

articleTitle: Smart Fire Barrier Solutions using IoT and Long Short-Term Memory Networks for Dynamic Fire Containment
abstract: This paper proposes a new fire containment method using IoT (Internet of Things) technology and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM. Traditional fire containment uses static barriers and cannot adjust to fire propagation patterns. However, the suggested method uses IoT sensors to monitor temperature, humidity, and smoke levels in real time. These sensors are connected to LSTM networks, which can learn and forecast fire spread patterns using previous data and present sensor readings. The smart fire barrier system uses dynamically deployable barriers with LSTM-controlled actuators. The LSTM network predicts firing direction and speed using sensor data. The device automatically installs barriers in appropriate spots to confine the fire based on these forecasts. To maximize containment efficiency, the system adapts barrier placements to changing ambient variables and fire dynamics. The proposed smart fire barrier system may communicate with other IoT devices, emergency response teams, and building management systems via enhanced communication. This coordinates fire control and evacuation, improving safety and reducing property loss. Simulations and real-world testing reveal the smart fire barrier technology improves fire containment efficiency over standard techniques. This new technique uses IoT and LSTM networks to provide scalable and adaptable dynamic fire containment for residential, commercial, and industrial safety.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network-Based Techniques and Error Level Analysis for Image Tamper Detection
abstract: The rapid evolution of digital image editing tools has made detecting tampered images increasingly crucial, especially in law enforcement, media integrity, and scientific publications. This study introduces a robust method leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) combined with Error Level Analysis (ELA) to effectively detect and localize tampered areas in digital images. CNNs, known for their prowess in image recognition tasks, are trained on a diverse dataset of tampered and untampered images, enabling them to learn and detect subtle and complex tampering patterns. Following the CNN analysis, ELA is employed as a secondary verification step, scrutinizing the areas flagged by the CNN for inconsistencies in compression levels indicative of tampering. This integration enhances detection accuracy and reduces false positives. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing methods, with high accuracy, precision, and recall in detecting various tampering artifacts. The findings confirm the system’s enhanced reliability and accuracy, making it a valuable tool for maintaining the integrity of digital images. This study not only fortifies the technological arsenal against image forgery but also sets a benchmark for future research in digital image forensics, offering a more reliable and accurate detection tool for practical applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Quantum Resistance: Entanglement Swapping in Quantum key distribution and blockchain infrastructure
abstract: Key negotiation plays an important role in ensuring secure communication channel, and establishes confidentiality between parties. Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) represents an advanced and highly secure method for distributing cryptographic keys between involved parties. Multiple QKD implementation possibilities have led to the upgrading of various QKD protocols. Quantum key distribution involves two types of protocols approaches prepare-and-measure and entanglement based, this paper focuses entanglement-based protocol. Prepare-and-measure protocols are vulnerable to certain attacks and have lower key generation rate as compared to entanglement based protocol. Entanglement is certified as a key element in the arena of quantum information processing, contributing in applications like quantum cryptography, quantum computation and quantum communication. Entanglement leads to the phenomenon known as entanglement swapping, entanglement swapping phenomenon involves parties getting entangled without interacting with each other. This research focuses on the advantages and the security provided by entanglement swapping in quantum key distribution. Blockchain also utilizes key distribution process with the involvement of classical cryptography. Classical cryptography blockchain are not quantum-resistant, blockchain with quantum computing infrastructure are more advance and secure. Implementing entanglement swapping in the infrastructure of blockchain can make the blockchain quantum-resistant to secure communication and transactions. Within this manuscript, we theoretically study the entanglement swapping of Bell states in quantum key distribution and propose an idea of blockchain with entanglement swapping to enhance quantum resistance. This study also explores the employing of entanglement swapping in cloud infrastructure.

articleTitle: Video Encryption and Decryption System Implemented on FPGA for Secure Communication
abstract: This research paper introduces an innovative method for ensuring the security of video communication by implementing a video encryption and decryption system based on FPGA technology. The suggested system effectively employs programmable logic and fast processing capabilities of FPGAs to encrypt and decrypt video data, thereby safeguarding its integrity and confidentiality throughout transmission. Critical components include the video input preprocessing, video output interface, and encryption/decryption engines. By means of rigorous experimental evaluation and testing, this establishes the system’s capability to deliver real-time performance and its resilience against security threats. Compared to software-based alternatives, this FPGA-based solution is ideal for a variety of applications requiring secure multimedia transmission due to its superior speed, efficiency, and security.

articleTitle: Ensuring QoS Requirements in IoT Resource Allocation Using ACO Integrated VNS and TS Algorithms
abstract: In the growing landscape of the Internet of Things (IoT), ensuring that resource allocation strategies meet specific Quality of Service (QoS) requirements is paramount. Numerous fields, such as industry, academic, healthcare, agriculture, military etc., where there are a variety of resource requirements have found use for IoT. This study investigates how to integrate the algorithms of Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) and Tabu Search (TS) with Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) to maximize resource allocation, reduce energy usage, cut down on delay in communications and improve system performance overall. Our methodology has been shown to be efficient and successful based on experimental results, which demonstrate considerable improvements in QoS metrics over conventional methods. These metrics are critical for various IoT applications. Through the proposed hybrid approach, our work advances the Internet of Things by enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of allocation of resources in IoT networks.

Author Keywords: Variable Neighborhood Search and Tabu Search

articleTitle: A Rapid GBDT-BiLSTM Based Damage Detection Technique in Bridges using Accurate Parameters
abstract: Conventional methods for diagnosing bridge damage have centred on tracking changes in modal-based Damage Sensitive Features (DSFs), which are strongly related to structural stiffness. Environmental and operational variations, inefficient use of machine learning approaches for damage detection, and an overall reliance on modal-based DSFs are some of the limits and hurdles that the system still faces, despite substantial progress towards practical deployment. According to the proposed method, the initial three steps are data preparation, feature extraction, and model training. In order to identify damage during the preprocessing step, the suggested approach utilises anomaly scores. Features in the timefrequency domain allow for parallel processing of signals in the signal-to-feature extraction pipeline. After the features have been extracted, the data is used to train GBDT-BiLSTM models. The proposed approach achieves better results than the wellknown alternatives, GBDT and BiLSTM.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition using CLBP and DWT features with KPCA-based Feature Reduction Approach
abstract: Sign language recognition (SLR) is an active area of research in the field of Computer Vision. Sign languages are visual languages that communicate using the hands, facial emotion and the body movements. Sign Language serves as a bridge between us and the individuals with impaired hearing or linguistic activities. It allows individuals to understand the world around them through visual descriptions, and hence contribute to society. The present work aims at developing an efficient SLR model that can be classified multi-class sign languages effectively. First, a combined feature extractor strategy is suggested by employing Discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and Circular local binary pattern(CLBP) to extract the directional and texture features to construct a robust feature descriptor. Subsequently, Kernel Principal Component (KPCA) analysis is utilised for the purpose of feature reduction. For classification, three different classifiers namely SVM, KNN and Logistic Regression are suggested as the combination of DWT and LBP features, KPCA based feature reduction and classification. Out of these combination DWT+CLBP+KPCA+SVM attains a maximum accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 7 \%}$ for American Sign Language(ASL) and $\mathbf{9 6. 4 \%}$ for Indian Sign Language dataset. From experimental results and analysis it has been observed that the proposed SLR model shows superior performance as compared to other benchmark schemes.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Adaptive Beamforming System for Improved Wireless Communication Performance
abstract: The study describes an innovative adaptive beamforming system that improves wireless communication performance through the utilization of field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) technology is utilized by the system to implement adaptive beamforming algorithms. The antenna weights are dynamically adjusted by these algorithms to optimize signal reception and reduce interference in real-time. Signal quality, spectrum efficiency, and overall system performance are significantly improved, as indicated by simulations and FPGA prototypes. The system’s adaptive design facilitates dependable functionality in ever-changing environments, as opposed to conventional fixed beamforming methodologies. The proposed system is suitable for implementation in real-time scenarios owing to its minimal latency and effective utilization of resources. This research adds to the growing body of knowledge on wireless communication systems by presenting a versatile and effective approach to enhancing signal quality and reception.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Framework to Enhance the Location Privacy for Geospatial Query Resolution
abstract: The rapid expansion of geospatial data analysis has led to an increasing need for systems that can respond quickly. Storing and analyzing extensive spatiotemporal datasets is crucial for extracting valuable information for location-aware applications like route planning and weather forecasts. Efficiently coordinating data sources and internet services is crucial for extracting results within time constraints, given the current surge in processing geographic searches. Privacy models that incorporate fog computing provide a significant advantage in terms of cost reduction and low latency. However, in order to address consumers' concerns about data exposure, recent efforts have been made to integrate fog computing for enhanced privacy. Through the use of simulated outcomes, it has been shown that the privacy protection offered by the Geo-Fog framework for localization services is highly effective. The system demonstrated average latency values as low as 23 ms for query loads of 200. Furthermore, the CPU usage remained below $37 \%$ even under the maximum query load of $\mathbf{5 0 0}$. Fog computing plays a crucial role in the advancement of location-based applications that prioritize efficiency and privacy. By enabling fog devices or servers to handle geospatial queries within the geographic environment, it ensures optimal management.

articleTitle: Multilingual Facial Emotion Decoding and Posture Recognition using Random Forest Classifier
abstract: Effective communication is crucial for success in various interactions, including personal and online interviews. The work proposed is to refine the communication effectiveness and extend the understanding of interactions by incorporating new system functions of real-time emotion and body language capture. Facial and body landmarks are analyzed using Google’s Mediapipe to ensure accurate identification of the frequently performed emotions and frequently posed postures. The proposed system uses three classifiers, namely Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Ridge Classifier, all integrated in one pipeline; this makes our work distinct. In the testing phase the classifiers are checked to avoid misidentification of emotions or incorrect posture in different situations. One of the major novelties of this work is its ability to address users of different languages, thus it is relevant anywhere in the world. This dynamic and robust system provides accurate emotion analysis achieving the accuracy of 92%, enhancing understanding in various communication contexts and setting a new standard for interview and interaction analysis.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning of Graph Embeddings for Object-agnostic Affordance Categorization
abstract: In the dynamic field of artificial intelligence, the unsupervised learning of graph embeddings introduces a transformative approach to object-agnostic affordance categorization, enabling machines to understand and categorize object functionalities without relying on predefined categories. This paper outlines a novel methodology that integrates graph theory and deep learning to autonomously identify and categorize affordances by leveraging the intrinsic structural patterns of data. Through meticulous preprocessing of diverse datasets and construction of graphs based on feature similarity, our approach employs the Node2Vec algorithm to generate dense vector space embeddings that preserve essential topological structures. We further enhance affordance categorization by applying the K-means clustering algorithm, organizing objects into distinct clusters based on their affordances without the need for labeled data. Our extensive experimental results demonstrate marked improvements in precision (0.92), recall (0.89), and F1-score (0.90) over conventional models, highlighting the scalability and adaptability of our model. This research not only advances the understanding of affordance perception in a label-free framework but also showcases the potential of graph embeddings in revolutionizing autonomous systems and robotics, setting a new benchmark for future developments in unsupervised learning strategies.

articleTitle: Use of the Internet of Things as Increase in the Productivity of a Library System
abstract: This study explores the potential of the Internet of Things (IoT) to enhance the efficiency and productivity of university library systems. It discusses how the rapid advancements in IoT, characterized by the interconnectedness of everyday objects, enable organizations to collect and analyze data to make informed decisions, thus offering a competitive edge. By conducting a case study at University, this research identifies priority sectors for IoT implementation within libraries, detailing applicable technologies such as RFID, IPv6, and Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), and their integration to create smart library infrastructures. The findings suggest that IoT can significantly improve inventory management, resource allocation, and user experience by automating processes, enhancing real-time data collection, and providing actionable insights. This paper concludes that adopting IoT technologies in libraries can transform them into dynamic, efficient, and userfriendly spaces, emphasizing the necessity for continual adaptation and innovation in the face of technological advancements.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Image Recognition in IoT-Enabled Surveillance Systems
abstract: This paper proposed an improved method that can be used in the identification of images within IoT based surveillance systems through the use of deep learning techniques especially the CNNs. The growth of concern and complexity therefore entails massive feeding from bursts of data from surveillance cameras, hence the need for reliable algorithms for processing the data in real-time with reasonable accuracy. The described system can be described as inclusive of IoT devices communicating with edge computing and cloud services for the purpose of scalability and performance enhancement. In this study, a very sophisticated experimental setup was employed; the authors used a number of datasets for surveillance purposes to evaluate the model. The results revealed that the segments of the method achieve a high accuracy and are continuously running through data in diverse surveillance scenarios while also being scalable. In the results section, we realized that CNN model was able to handle various environmental conditions such as; extreme lightening and occlusion. On the basis of the above mentioned data, it will be possible to suggest that this approach is rather superior compared to the other conventional approaches and therefore can be suggested as the possible solution of the modern conditions of surveillance. It thus provides platform for the advancement of intelligent surveillance system for use in smart city, security and safety application.

articleTitle: Improving the 8T SRAM Cell Design for Fault Tolerance and Power Efficiency
abstract: We have designed an 8T SRAM model in this work where we have worked on the issues of read/write efficiency, leakage current and also fault tolerance.
