The design used in this work consists of 8 transistors, 2 PMOS and 6 NMOS. Here the two transistors make a 2-NOT gate structure. The objective of this work is to design a SRAM which can work in challenging conditions very efficiently. This work has concentrated on lowering the value of leakage current, which is key in read/write operations. The design shows promising results for the above-mentioned issues. We have used Tanner EDA tool to simulate the model. As seen in the results section of this work, the model is resistant to faults. The leakage current is reduced and is very less compared to traditional SRAM cells. The leakage power obtained with this model is $0.599 \mu \mathrm{~W}$ which is very less compared to the traditional methods. This model which we have proposed in this work, seems to be very much apt to density packed operations and also when power efficient operativity is required. This work tackled the basic issues of the traditional SRAM design, where R/W efficiency, leakage current and fault tolerance were taken into consideration. We were successful in achieving a system which provided solution to the above problems along with the issues of elevated temperatures, radiation, or EMI.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation on Image Classification Methods for CIFAR-10
abstract: This study investigates the performance of different methods for image classification tasks using the CIFAR-10 dataset. Four neural networks, namely Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, were compared based on their precision, recall, training epochs, and memory utilization. Results were analyzed and presented comprehensively. The findings reveal that CNNs outperform the other networks, demonstrating superior memory efficiency, requiring fewer training epochs, and achieving a balanced precision-recall trade-off. While DNNs exhibit high precision, they demand more memory and display lower recall rates. Conversely, LSTM networks show comparable precision and recall scores to CNNs but require more training epochs and memory. The study concludes that CNNs offer the most efficient approach for image classification tasks on the CIFAR-10 dataset, providing valuable insight into selecting methods for similar applications.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Network Management for Dynamic Resource Allocation & Energy Boosting Techniques in Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: Traditional Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) frequently experience inefficiencies in their dynamic resource allocation and energy management because of fixed, static techniques, which lowers network performance and lifespan. Typical methods such as duty cycling and clustering don’t adjust to changing and unpredictably dynamic real-world situations, which results in energy consumption that isn’t optimal and a decrease in network dependability. To achieve dynamic resource allocation and energy optimization, the study suggests an AI-driven network management system that makes use of cutting-edge machine learning (ML) techniques. Regression analysis, reinforcement learning, and neural networks are used by the proposed system to proactively alter network parameters and forecast future states based on historical and real-time data. Ultimately, the experimental results show considerable advantages over the existing systems: the proposed system achieves an extended node lifespan (400 days), reduced average energy consumption (130 Joules), and greater average throughput (85 kbps). These results highlight how, via ongoing learning and adaptation, the proposed system may improve WSN sustainability, dependability, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimizing IoT Security:Advanced Intrusion Detection for IoT Networks Using Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: The advancement of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has ushered in a new era of connectivity and convenience. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) are vital for protecting IoT networks by identifying abnormal activities indicative of malicious intent. Network systems face Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS), Denial of Service (DoS), and service scans, requiring sophisticated IDS that can quickly detect and neutralize these threats. Current IDS solutions need accuracy, efficiency, flexibility, and scalability improvements to detect attack traffic across various IoT networks effectively. The evolving nature of these attacks necessitates the use of up-to-date datasets. This paper contributes to IoT security by developing and assessing an IDS using the BoTNeTIoT-L01 dataset under Mirai and Gafgyt botnet attacks and different sub-type attacks. We evaluate several machine learning models: Decision Trees (DT), Random Forests (RF), LightGBM, and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). Our results show that MLP outperforms other models, achieving a precision of $\mathbf{9 6. 4 8 \%}$, recall of $\mathbf{9 6. 2 4 \%}$, $\mathbf{F}$-score of $\mathbf{9 6. 7 2 \%}$, and accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6. 6 5 \%}$. This approach ensures our defence strategies remain effective and responsive to the latest attack vectors.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Electrocardiogram Signals using Autoencoders
abstract: One potential use of autoencoders in healthcare is the identification of anomalies in electrocardiogram (ECG) readings. The primary objective of this research is to design a reliable system that can detect irregularities in electrocardiogram data automatically. The goal is to improve the efficiency and accuracy of anomaly detection using autoencoders so that cardiovascular problems may be diagnosed and treated early. The objective is to prove that the suggested approach can correctly detect a variety of abnormalities, such as arrhythmias and other cardiac abnormalities, using electrocardiogram (ECG) data by conducting extensive experiments and validations. This study aims to provide a dependable tool for healthcare practitioners to evaluate ECG data effectively and quickly detect possible health issues, therefore contributing to the improvement of medical diagnostics. The goal of our effort is to make clinical decision-making in cardiac care settings more effective and to improve patient outcomes. The PTB Diagnostic ECG Database yielded five results, ranging from 0.57 to 0.92, for each of the five patients in the sample.

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition Method of Power Financial Voucher Based on Feature Extraction
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional linear search algorithm in the research of power financial voucher image recognition method, a research scheme of financial voucher image recognition method based on feature extraction was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the conditionality reduction theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the feature extraction is used to construct a research scheme for the image recognition method of financial vouchers. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional linear search algorithm in terms of research accuracy and processing time of influencing factors of financial voucher image recognition method, and has obvious advantages. The research on image recognition method of financial voucher plays an extremely important role in power finance, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of power finance. However, the traditional linear search algorithm has certain limitations in solving the image recognition simulation problem, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research scheme on the image recognition method of financial vouchers based on feature extraction to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors is accurately located through the conditionality reduction theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the scheme is constructed by feature extraction. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on feature extraction can better solve the limitations of the traditional linear search algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the research of image recognition method of power financial vouchers.

articleTitle: Harnessing Meta-Heuristic Algorithms for Molecular Optimization in Drug Discovery
abstract: Drug discovery is the process of identifying and developing novel drugs to address illnesses and enhancing human well-being. It involves distinct stages, from initial target recognition to clinical trials and eventual regulatory approval. Quantum computing harnesses principles from quantum mechanics to process information differently than classical computers, using quantum bits (qubits) instead of classical bits. It has the ability to solve complex issues efficiently than conventional computers especially in terms of simulating quantum systems cryptography, and optimization. Meta-heuristic algorithms are iterative optimization strategies that efficiently explore solution spaces to find approximate solutions for complex problems, often outperforming traditional methods in terms of speed and scalability as traditional drug discovery processes are often time-consuming, expensive, and sometimes yield limited results. However, the emergence of quantum machine learning offers a promising avenue for overcoming these challenges. This research paper presents meta heuristic techniques such as Genetic Algorithm, Quantum Inspired Genetic Algorithm in molecular optimization of drug discovery. It also provides a summary of each algorithm, including its pros and cons as well as its effectiveness in specific search space scenarios. The research also examines the effects of different hyper-parameters on the performance of each method. The results show that these parameters have a substantial impact on how well the algorithm performs, and that a parameter-tuning approach may be used to get the optimal values. It also covers challenges and potential avenues for future research in this field. Moreover, for researchers and practitioners interested in applying meta-heuristics to tackle molecular optimization challenges in drug discovery.

articleTitle: Predictive Water Management for Precision Farming Using IOT & Bi-LSTM Networks
abstract: Conventional irrigation systems frequently do not have the ability to predict future conditions, resulting in inefficient water utilization. This study presents an innovative water management system that combines Internet of Things (IoT) devices with a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) network. The system utilizes IoT sensors to collect real-time environmental data and employs Bi-LSTM to anticipate the most efficient watering schedules, hence improving water usage efficiency. The Bi-LSTM model surpasses conventional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, attaining a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.18, Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of $\mathbf{0. 1 9 5}$, Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of $\mathbf{1. 4 2 6 \%}$, and an R-squared ($\mathrm{R}^{2}$) value of $\mathbf{0. 9 9 2 5}$, with a Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.038. By comparison, the typical LSTM model achieved an MAE (Mean Absolute Error) of 0.5, RMSE (Root Mean Square Error) of 0.557, MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) of 3.8%, $\mathbf{R}^{2}$ (Coefficient of Determination) of 0.9385, and MSE (Mean Squared Error) of $\mathbf{0. 3 1}$. The results indicate that the proposed Bi-LSTM-based system is more accurate and efficient than existing LSTM models. This suggests that it has the potential to significantly improve water management techniques in precision farming.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Drug Discovery Accelerating the Identification of Potential Therapeutic Compounds
abstract: This paper aims to propose the Enhanced Artificial Intelligence (EAI) approach to improve the speed of the identification of possible therapeutic agents in the process of drug discovery. Pharmacophore based methods are proven to have certain drawbacks like very high cost, huge time consumption and low hit rates. To overcome with these challenges the proposed system employs the sophisticated technologies of machine learning and deep learning. The general approach entails vast data gathering, preprocessing, and efficient feature extraction techniques and the use of various machine learning models such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The main advantage of the presented approach is the ability to compare it with traditional ones and highlight the advantages in terms of data processing, higher accuracy and less time consumption, as well as predictive accuracy. The experimental results presented also establish CNN with an accuracy of $92 \%$, the effectiveness of computational methods and blowing superiority in the experimental verifications. Such study also implies that the proposed approach with EAI integration has a huge potential of cutting on the cost and time taken in the overall process of drug discovery. This paper also discusses the possibilities for application of improved AI methods and enlargement of the existing data sets to improve the functionality of the system in the future.

articleTitle: Dynamic Hybrid Approaches for Decomposition-Based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with a Taxonomy and Analytical Framework
abstract: In the dynamic field of Reinforcement Learning (RL), optimizing multiple objectives simultaneously poses a significant challenge, addressed by Decomposition-Based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (DB-MORL). This paper introduces a comprehensive taxonomy and analytical framework for DB-MORL, emphasizing a novel algorithmDynamic Hybrid DB-MORL (DH-DB-MORL)-that innovatively adapts between scalarization and Pareto-front methods based on real-time assessments. This approach enhances the efficiency and quality of solutions by dynamically exploring the trade-offs between conflicting objectives, thereby improving both solution diversity on the Pareto front and computational efficiency. Through extensive empirical testing across various synthetic and real-world scenarios, the DH-DBMORL algorithm demonstrated notable enhancements in computational time, solution quality, and scalability compared to baseline models such as NSGA-II, MOEA/D, and SPEA2. Our findings reveal that the DH-DB-MORL algorithm significantly reduces computational time, produces a higher number of Pareto-optimal solutions, and achieves superior solution quality as evidenced by higher hypervolume scores. Additionally, the algorithm’s adaptability enables it to maintain high performance even as the complexity of the problem space increases. This study not only refines our understanding of DBMORL strategies but also sets a new benchmark for future research and applications in fields requiring nuanced Multi-Objective optimization, such as autonomous systems and resource management. The dynamic adaptability and comprehensive taxonomy provided by DH-DB-MORL offer a more effective approach to handling the complexities of high-dimensional, multi-objective problems, advancing both theoretical and practical aspects of multi-objective optimization in RL.

articleTitle: Enhancing Email Spam Detection through Ensemble Learning : A Combined Approach of LSTM and Neural Network
abstract: A powerful method for spotting spam messages, using neural networks with a focus on Long Short Term Memory(LSTM) technology is introduced. With the persistent problem of unwanted messages in digital communication, a dependable spam detection system is crucial. Traditional methods often struggle to keep up with evolving spamming tactics, calling for a flexible and adaptive solution. The suggested model employs a layered neural network design, incorporating LSTM cells to grasp time-based patterns in text data. This enables the model to recognize subtle clues in message content, leading to better accuracy in identifying spam. Extensive testing was carried out on a varied dataset containing both regular and spam messages, showing improved performance compared to standard methods. Moreover, the model shows strong adaptability, performing well across different message lengths and styles. By using embeddings and attention mechanisms, the model becomes even better at picking up on language cues that indicate spam. Empirical results demonstrate a noticeable increase in precision, recall, and F1score, indicating the model’s effectiveness in distinguishing spam from legitimate messages. This approach represents a significant step forward in the field of spam detection, offering a reliable solution to tackle the ever-changing world of unwanted digital communication.

articleTitle: The Impact of AI Personalized Recommendation Scale on Consumer Purchase Decisions
abstract: In the rapidly evolving digital economy, AI personalized recommendations have become essential tools for enhancing consumer shopping experiences and increasing business revenues. However, there is a significant research gap in systematically studying how the scale of AI personalized recommendations affects consumer purchase decisions. This study focuses on the impact mechanism of AI personalized recommendations on consumer purchase decisions, aiming to explore how the scale of AI personalized recommendations (independent variable) influences consumer purchase decisions (dependent variable) through perceived attractiveness (mediating variable), and to analyze the role of decision-making style (moderating variable) in this process. By conducting an empirical analysis with a sample of 380 online shoppers collected through an online survey, the results reveal that perceived attractiveness significantly mediates the effect of the scale of AI personalized recommendations on consumer purchase decisions. Additionally, decision-making style positively moderates the impact of the scale of AI personalized recommendations on perceived attractiveness, further enhancing the effect on purchase decisions. This study not only extends the application context of personalized recommendation systems in consumer behavior research but also clarifies the psychological mechanisms and boundary conditions of how AI personalized recommendations influence consumer purchase decisions, providing important insights for online retail enterprises to optimize AI recommendation system designs and enhance consumer shopping experiences.

articleTitle: Predicting Lung Disease Severity via Image-Based AQI Analysis using Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: Air pollution is a significant health concern worldwide, contributing to various respiratory diseases. Advances in air quality mapping, driven by the emergence of smart cities, has led to an increase in available data, fueling momentum in air pollution forecasting. The objective of this study is to devise an integrated approach for predicting air quality using image data and subsequently assessing lung disease severity based on Air Quality Index (AQI). The aim is to implement an integrated approach by refining existing techniques to improve accuracy in predicting AQI and lung disease severity. The study aims to forecast additional atmospheric pollutants like AQI, PM10, O3, CO, SO2, NO2 in addition to PM2.5 levels. Additionally, the study aims to compare the proposed approach with existing methods to show its effectiveness. The approach used in this paper uses VGG16 model for feature extraction in images and neural network for predicting AQI.In predicting lung disease severity, Support Vector Classifier (SVC) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithms are utilized. The neural network model for predicting AQI achieved training accuracy of $\mathbf{8 8. 5 4} \%$ and testing accuracy of 87.44%, while the KNN model used for predicting lung disease severity achieved training accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 4 \%}$ and testing accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 5 \%}$. In conclusion, the integrated approach presented in this study forecasts air quality and evaluates lung disease severity, achieving high testing accuracies of $\mathbf{8 7. 4 4 \%}$ for AQI and 97.5% for lung disease severity using neural network, KNN, and SVC models. The future scope involves implementing transfer learning and advanced deep learning modules to enhance prediction capabilities. While the current study focuses on India, the objective is to expand its scope to encompass global coverage.

articleTitle: Research and Application of 10kV Feeder Frequent Power Outage Line Life Cycle Control
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional greedy algorithm in the research and application of the whole life cycle control of 10 kV feeder lines with frequent power outages, a research and application scheme of the whole life cycle control based on the improved ant colony algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors were accurately located through the colony foraging theory, and the indicators were reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the improved ant colony algorithm was used to construct a research and application scheme for the whole life cycle control. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional greedy algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the whole life cycle control research and application, and the processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. The research and application of life cycle control plays an extremely important role in the frequent power failure line of 10 kV feeder, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of frequent power failure line of 10 kV feeder. However, traditional greedy algorithms have certain limitations in solving life cycle control simulation problems, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research and application scheme of whole life cycle control based on improved ant colony algorithm to better solve this problem. In this scheme, the influencing factors were accurately located through the colony foraging theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and the improved ant colony algorithm was used to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on the improved ant colony algorithm can better solve the limitations of the traditional greedy algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency in the research and application of the whole life cycle control of 10 kV feeder frequent power outage lines.

articleTitle: Adam Pine cone optimization with Deep learning for cervical cancer detection using pap smear image
abstract: Cervical cancer is the main reason of mortality in females worldwide. The Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is the major reasonfor cervical cancer in female patients. The virus first infects cells in the cervix of female patients and spreads throughout the cervix. This cancer is curable if diagnosed early and treated on time. Here, this paper presents an innovative method based on Deep Learning (DL) for detecting cervical cancer. Initially, the input pap smear image is considered as inputand is forwarded to the preprocessing step in which the noise contained in the pap smear image is eradicated utilizing an adaptive bilateral filter. Next, Utilizing a Mask Regional Convolutional Neural Network (Mask-RCNN) the affected region is segmented and shape features are mined from the segmented image. Then, cervical cancer detection is effectuated by exploiting the Deep Maxout Network (DMN) model, which is structurally optimizedbythe designed Adam Pine Cone Optimization Algorithm (APCOA). Furthermore, the performance of APCOA_DMN is assessed using several metrics and it obtained anaccuracyof $\mathrm{9 1. 2 8 4 \%}$, a True Negative Rate (TNR) of $91.315 \%$, and a True Positive Rate (TPR) of $\mathrm{9 1. 9 7 9 \%}$.

articleTitle: Modifying Artificial Human Personas through Reality Therapy-based ArtiPsychotherapy
abstract: Artificial humans have the potential to change through psychological counseling. We verify the possibility of persona changes in artificial humans through AI-based counseling in metaverse, and based on this, we propose a new academic field called ‘ArtiPsychotherapy’. Two types of artificial humans with PTSD and depression (Michael and Clara) were created, with 24 replicas each divided into experimental and control groups. The experimental group received AI-based reality therapy counseling, resulting in improvements of up to 69.37% in psychological scales (IES-R, CES-D, PSS), while the control group showed minimal changes. This research suggests that ArtiPsychotherapy can positively alter the personas and psychological states of artificial humans in metaverse, providing a foundation for a new academic field that can contribute to improving management and human interaction techniques for artificial humans in future metaverse applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Cluster Head Selection and Secure Routing Approach Industry 4.0 Framework for Precision Agriculture
abstract: As Precision Agriculture (PA) evolves through the integration of Industry 4.0 technologies, it also faces new and sophisticated threats. This paper presents an in-depth analysis and framework for threat detection in PA utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI). The proposed framework focuses on identifying and mitigating both cybersecurity and physical threats that could compromise the efficiency, safety, and sustainability of agricultural operations. By leveraging machine learning algorithms and real-time data analytics, the framework aims to provide proactive threat detection and response mechanisms, ensuring robust protection for PA systems. This study System describes a network threats detection mechanism using machine learning for IoT-based precision farming application. In the first phase of this research detection of http threats under the large Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN). We developed a cloud-connected precision farming application & applied the data mining &machine learning algorithms for accurate Hypertext Transfer Protocol(HTTP) threats. In this paper describes an cross-layer-based clustering & routing algorithms have been intended to diminish network correspondence deferral, dormancy, &energy utilization. The boundaries of various layers like a physical, Medium Access Control (MAC) & network layer of every sensor are utilized to assess & choose ideal Optimized Cross-Layer Routing for Industry $4.0(O C L R I) \&$ productive information transmission. Initial cluster head $(\mathbf{C H})$ selection has done and then Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) proposed for secure data transmission. In experimental analysis results demonstrates the proposed OCLRI-ACO techniques improves the overall QoS parameters.

articleTitle: Detection of Pcos/Pcod and Prediction of Infertility at the Early Stage Based on RF-ELM Technique
abstract: When infertility does not happen during ovulation, over 70% of cases are due to polycystic ovarian syndrome. Hyperandrogenism and polycystic ovary morphology are the hallmarks of ovarian dysfunction syndrome. Olig- or anovulation, hyperandrogenemia (clinical and/or biochemical), and ultrasound-verified polycystic ovaries are the diagnostic criteria for polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS). The following steps must be carried out in the precise sequence: preprocessing, data segmentation, feature extraction, and model training. Preprocessing is an essential step before adding data to the feature extraction stage. Segmentation analysis was used to eliminate those that did not correspond to actual follicles. Feature extraction retrieves the original statistical forms of factors like homogeneity, contrast, and standard deviation. Features are retrieved first in the training of RF-ELM models. The proposed method outperforms two state-of-the-art alternatives, RF and ELM. Following the implementation of the technique, the results demonstrated an accuracy boost of 93.50%.

articleTitle: OptiNLP: Leveraging Natural Language Processing for Optimal Feature Selection in Dimensionality Reduction
abstract: In today’s data-driven world, the exponential growth of data has led to the emergence of high-dimensional datasets, often causing complexity and overload in machine learning models. To address these challenges, dimensionality reduction techniques such as feature selection and feature extraction have become pivotal in enhancing model performance and interpretability. This paper focuses on exploring various feature selection methods to assist researchers in identifying the most suitable technique for sentiment analysis tasks. Utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP), we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of different feature selection models. Our experimental findings show that, in the context of sentiment analysis, filter method consistently tends to be more effective than other evaluated feature selection techniques. Filter performs better than other methods in terms of precision, effectiveness, and model interpretability, which makes them ideal compared to other feature selection techniques. By leveraging insights from our comparative analysis, researchers can make informed decisions on feature selection techniques.

Author Keywords: Natural Language Processing Toolkit (NLTK) Dimensional Reduction (DR)

articleTitle: Analyzing Machine Learning Techniques for Software Defect Prediction: A Comprehensive Performance Comparison
abstract: This study used the JM1 dataset of software module metrics and tested various machine learning classifiers to detect defective modules. Classifiers used: Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost XGBoost LightGBM Catboost The models were assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and cross-validation metrics. Our findings indicated that XGBoost achieved the most balanced performance between precision and recall, with a cross-validation mean of 0.8437 and a macro average $F 1$-score of $\mathbf{0. 6 0}$. LightGBM also gave a good performance with a CV mean of 0.8466 and an F1 score as 0.57. AdaBoost and Gradient Boosting had the lowest precision but highest recall, which indicates that these models have some issues in the area of finding all faulty modules. Regarding defect prediction, it was observed that for the selected models CatBoost performed best in terms of accuracy with a bit lower recall than XGBoost and LightGBM. This leads to the conclusion that LightGBM and XGBoost can be used as competitive alternatives in defect detection, balancing accuracy with the quality of being able to catch real defects. To further improve fault identification performance, future research can concentrate on hyperparameter optimization and the integration of other data sources.

articleTitle: EchoEase: Leveraging Python and Machine Learning for Enhanced Text-to-Speech Solutions for the Visually Impaired
abstract: EchoEase provides a new concept in Text-to-Speech (TTS) technology aimed at improving accessibility for blind people. Traditional TTS systems for the visually impaired frequently have optical character recognition (OCR) errors and speak robotically, making communication difficult. EchoEase, however, overcomes the limitation by combining powerful Python-based OCR with deep learning algorithmic algorithms. The technique uses Tesseract OCR for high-accuracy text extraction and improves the text with BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) and GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) before combining it in a deep-learning TTS engine to produce natural speech. According to the data acquired so far, EchoEase is a higher-performance TTS system. It has an OCR accuracy of up to $\mathbf{9 5. 8 \%}$ and creates speech with a naturalness score of $\mathbf{9. 2}$ far better than any other recognized system. User satisfaction is clearly higher. The results show that EchoEase has greatly outperformed traditional solutions like that on almost every metric. According to the results of the survey, EchoEase has the greatest satisfaction percentages for simplicity of use and customization.

articleTitle: Human Emotion Classification for Valence and Arousal via EEG-Based Machine Learning
abstract: In the realm of affective computing, the accurate classification of human emotions through physiological signals, particularly electroencephalogram (EEG), presents a significant opportunity to influence practical outcomes in neuroscience, psychology, and human-computer interaction. This paper introduces a novel machine learning approach to emotion classification that adeptly decodes the emotional dimensions of valence and arousal from EEG signals. Our methodology is comprehensive, involving meticulous data preprocessing, feature extraction, and the implementation of an ensemble of sophisticated algorithms, such as support vector machines and neural networks. The effectiveness of our model is demonstrated through rigorous testing, where it significantly surpasses existing benchmarks in accuracy. Importantly, the results reveal the potential of EEG-based models to revolutionize our understanding of emotional states, enhancing applications in adaptive user interfaces and emotional health monitoring. These applications are crucial for developing technologies that adjust to user emotions in real-time, offering substantial benefits in personalized digital interactions and therapeutic settings, thereby extending the research’s relevance beyond academia to directly benefit industry practitioners and clinicians.

articleTitle: Ranked Search of Encrypted Cloud Data Using Multi-Keyword Synonyms and Greedy Depth-First Search
abstract: With the advancement of cloud services, usage of cloud services in every aspect of information technology has surpassed its peak. More and more people are worried that private data would be vulnerable while it is being sent through cloud services. If people who aren’t part of a company get access to its cloud tools, they could tamper the company’s databases and its content to some extent. Encryption is the primary mode to make sure that the data you store in the remote server is safe. But looking through a enormous amount of protected data comes with its own set of problems. In this work, we study the state-of-the-art research that has been worked in this domain to delve how other researchers have dealt with these issues. Our main aim is to provide the fastest search speeds that could be attempted without compromising the privacy of the data or the efficiency with which computers handle the data at risk. In answer to this, we have come up with a new way to encrypt data that is perfect for cloud computing. We think that the Greedy Depth-First Search (DFS) Ranked Searching method will make it easier to find encrypted content quickly and accurately. Our number one goal is to come up with the best ways to cut down on the time spent using cloud technology. In order to reach our goal of making a unified encryption method that can work with a wide range of encryption methods, we are researching how to combine these methods. This method allows approach of multi ranked keyword search algorithms and makes sure that a good way to protect privacy is in place at the same time.

articleTitle: DC Sources and Switching Angles Optimization for Enhanced Performance of a 9-Level MLI
abstract: In electric vehicles and power conversion technologies, multilevel inverters (MLIs) are crucial in providing wide output voltage ranges with minimal harmonic distortion. This research presents an innovative approach to optimizing a 9-level multilevel inverter (MLI) using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to minimize Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) and enhance efficiency. By fine-tuning the switching angles and corresponding DC source voltages, the PSO algorithm effectively reduces harmonic distortion up to the 51st harmonic. The optimization spans modulation indices (M) from 0.8 to 0.98, analyzing the impact on switching angles, DC sources, and phase and line THD. Comparative evaluations with existing studies demonstrate significant improvements, with the proposed method achieving the lowest phase THD of $10.29 \%$ at a modulation index of 0.85 and the lowest line THD of $4.09 \%$ at a modulation index of 0.91. These findings underscore the potential of PSO in advancing MLI performance, though further refinement and experimental validation are recommended for broader applicability.

articleTitle: Optimizing Sewage Systems for Real-Time Flow Analysis and Predictive Maintenance with IoT and LSTM
abstract: This research introduces a new real-time method for analyzing sewage flow utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT). This method relies on long-short-term memory (LSTM) networks. In urban areas, sewage systems are an integral part of the infrastructure, and keeping them in good working order is crucial to reducing pollution and protecting residents’ health. System breakdowns and expensive repairs are common results of the reactive and inefficient maintenance practices commonly used in the past. In this research, it presents preventative methods that make use of IoT sensors to gather real-time data from wastewater treatment facilities. The information is then analyzed using LSTM networks to foresee problems like backups and overflows. Municipalities and utility companies may save money and lessen their environmental impact by implementing preventative maintenance plans that address potential issues in advance. It examines the practical implications of applying IoT and LSTM-based predictive maintenance to sewage systems and gives experimental findings confirming the technique’s usefulness in properly predicting flow irregularities. This study is crucial to ensuring the long-term viability and effective operation of urban sewage systems.

articleTitle: Development of Multistage Machine Learning Classifier using Decision Trees and Boosting Algorithms
abstract: In recent years, the clandestine nature of darknet activities has presented an escalating challenge to cybersecurity efforts, necessitating sophisticated methods for the detection and classification of network traffic associated with these covert operations. The system addresses the significant challenge of class imbalance within Darknet traffic datasets, where malicious traffic constitutes a minority, hindering effective discrimination between normal and malicious behavior. By leveraging boosting algorithms like AdaBoost and Gradient Boosting coupled with decision trees, this study proposes a robust solution for network traffic classification. Boosting algorithms ensemble learning corrects errors iteratively and assigns higher weights to minority class instances, complemented by the hierarchical structure of decision trees. The additional Feature Selection which is a pre-processing method by utilizing Information Gain metrics, Fisher’s Score, and Chi-Square test selection for features is employed. Rigorous experimentation with diverse Darknet traffic datasets validates the efficacy of the proposed multistage classifier, evaluated through various performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, offering a comprehensive solution for accurate detection and classification of Darknet activities.

articleTitle: Advanced Data Science Techniques for Predicting Financial Crises in SMEs: A COA-FS and LightGBM Framework
abstract: These days, data scientists are helping small and medium-sized business owners and operators make an impact and expand their companies by utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. It is difficult and expensive for SMEs to evaluate credit risks since there is a lack of reliable data and other characteristics. Contrarily, it is becoming critical to develop effective models for the prediction of SME financial crises or company failures. Financial crisis prediction (FCP) makes use of historical data to forecast an organization’s financial health using a variety of data classification techniques. Picking the right features to improve classifier outputs is a big part of FCP design. In light of this, the primary objective of this research is to present a model for the forecast of financial crises affecting SMEs that makes use of machine learning. Two parts make up the suggested method: the first is data categorization using Light Gradient-Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and the second is feature selection using the Coyote Optimization Algorithm (COA-FS) algorithm. The suggested model reduces memory consumption by switching from continuous to discrete values. The suggested method is tested besides validated using a benchmark financial dataset, and the results are evaluated according to different parameters. The suggested method performed better than the alternatives, according to the experimental data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Financial Markets: Analyzing Predictive Accuracy for Stock Prices
abstract: Researchers understand that investigating the prediction of stock market movements is an important and productive area of research. Astute investors have the capacity to create substantial financial profits by taking advantage of swings in stock prices. Investors face a significant challenge when attempting to predict the stock market: the data they have access to is either unchanging or unpredictable. Predicting the performance of the stock market is a major challenge for investors aiming to maximize their profits. Cutting-edge mathematical techniques and advanced learning systems produce forecasts for the stock market. This paper’s review encompasses various topics, including computational methodologies, Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, performance metrics, and reputable references cited in various research works. As a result, the selected publications contribute to the development of datasets and ML algorithms used to forecast future stock market movements. Typically, we generate stock market forecasts using Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB), Decision Tree (DT), Logistic Regression (), and Gradient Boosting (GB) approaches. Regrettably, the current methods for predicting stock market trends still suffer from numerous issues.

articleTitle: Integrating Quantum Error Correction with Quantum-Inspired Genetic Algorithms for Enhanced Network Reliability
abstract: Ensuring network reliability is crucial to support increasing data demands and complex operations. Traditional networks are prone to errors from noise, interference, and environmental factors. This research introduces a hybrid approach that combines Quantum Error Correction (QEC) techniques with Quantum-Inspired Genetic Algorithms (QIGAs) to enhance network reliability. Meta-heuristic algorithms, such as genetic algorithms, efficiently explore large search spaces to find nearoptimal solutions, making them suitable for complex problems. Quantum computing leverages principles like superposition and entanglement, which enhance processing speed and problem-solving capabilities. In this approach, QEC is used to protect data integrity from decoherence and quantum noise, while QIGAs, which emulate natural evolution, enhance QEC performance through efficient solution space exploration. The study highlights the benefits and performance of integrating QEC with QIGAs, with an emphasis on dynamic adjustment for optimal results. Initial simulations show significant improvements in network reliability compared to traditional methods. The hybrid approach demonstrates rapid convergence and effective error correction, proving to be superior to conventional methods. Further investigation is needed to confirm the efficacy of this approach across broader real-world contexts and larger network scales. Nonetheless, this research paves the way for robust and reliable communication systems that can meet the demands of modern data transfer and network complexity. By integrating QEC with QIGAs, we can achieve a new level of network reliability, ensuring that data integrity is maintained even in the face of errors and environmental challenges. This innovative hybrid approach holds promise for the future of network technology, providing a foundation for more reliable and efficient communication systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning & Zapier Automation based Medicinal Leaf Talk:Unraveling Nature’s Secrets
abstract: Medicinal plants in India are incredibly diverse and have a long and illustrious history of medicinal use in traditional systems of medicine. Although they are commonly used by people, the identification of these plants sometimes is based on subjective judgment, hence, inconsistency and inaccuracy arise. This research suggests a new approach to automated plant medicine recognition using highly developed computer techniques. Through the utilization of Deep Learning, Image Processing, and Natural Language Processing approaches we preprocess plant pictures to solve their common classification issues.In this research work,ruthless experimentation is done by evaluating different models and hyperparameter tuning to improve the precision of the identification of the plants. The results of this study show the superiority of deep learning methods in comparison with the traditional ones, CNN outperforms with accuracy of 89%, VGG16 has accuracy rate of 72% and ResNet50 with accuracy rate of 69% whereas loss is lesser comparatively in CNN model 53%. thus highlighting their effectiveness in being used in plant recognition tasks. On the other hand, we designed a platform that includes a chatbot element to provide users with current information on the selected medicinal plants, making access to the application easy and convenient.

articleTitle: Innovative MPTSSNet with Modified Dung Beetle Algorithm for Superior Remote Sensing Performance on UC-Merced and SIRI-WHU Datasets
abstract: Many fields rely on land division classification in satellite imagery, including urban planning, environmental monitoring, remote scene analysis, earth observations, and remote surveillance. The land scene classification job has many benefits, so many that numerous approaches to automatically identify land scenes in remote sensing photos have been suggested in recent years. Creating deep networks that can recognise land landscapes in high-resolution satellite photos is where most of the effort is concentrated. But distinguishing between various geographical scenes is a problem for these algorithms. Common obstacles that limit the models’ ability to attain high performance include complex textures, busy backgrounds, extremely small objects, and substantial fluctuations in object scale. A new architecture for remote sensing picture categorization, Multi-Path Temporal State Space Representation (MPTSSNet), is introduced in this study. An efficient, hardware-aware architecture called the Mamba is incorporated into MPTSSNet, which is based on the State Space Model (SSM). It combines the best features of linear modelling complexity with a global receptive field. We present a dynamic multi-path activation method to enhance Mamba’s ability to represent non-causal data, thereby addressing the shortcoming of vanilla Mamba—its inability to adapt to twodimensional picture data and its only focus on causal sequences. To improve the algorithm’s capacity to avoid local optima, this work tunes the MPTSSNet parameters using a modified dung beetle optimisation algorithm (MDBO). The approach employs Latin hypercube sampling for better population initialization. Two benchmark datasets, SIRI-WHU and UC-Merced, are used to assess the presentation of the suggested framework. Our experimental results demonstration that the framework outperforms competing models in its class..

articleTitle: Identifying Sources of Soil Pollution in Industrial Areas Using IoT Data and Neural Networks
abstract: Quick and precise source identification is crucial for developing successful remediation solutions to address soil contamination in industrial locations, which presents serious dangers to both the environment and human health. To locate the origins of soil contamination, this research presents a new method that combines neural network models with data collected from the Internet of Things (IOT). To monitor soil type, pollution levels, and weather conditions in real-time, set up IoT devices. After that, advanced neural network algorithms are used to process and analyze the data to find connections and patterns that might indicate the origins of the pollution. Our findings show that this method is useful for identifying where soil pollution inside industrial zones is coming from. Achieve high accuracy in source identification by integrating IoT technology and machine learning approaches. This allows us to address environmental harm and protect public health via focused remediation activities. Policymakers, environmental scientists, and stakeholders engaged in sustainable development and pollution control may benefit greatly which highlight the potential of IoT data and neural networks in challenges difficult environmental concerns.

articleTitle: Logistic Regression for Personalized Hypertension Risk Profiling in Cloud-Integrated Healthcare Systems
abstract: Advanced analytics for personalized chronic disease risk profiles are becoming possible as healthcare systems combine cloud-based technology. This work applies logistic regression (LR) models to cloud-integrated healthcare systems for personalized hypertension risk profiling. A large dataset of heterogeneous patient records was used to train and evaluate the LR model, including clinical characteristics and lifestyle variables. To assess the LR model’s predictive accuracy in identifying high-risk hypertension patients and to provide a framework for personalized risk stratification that can be seamlessly integrated into cloud-based healthcare systems. The model’s performance was rigorously cross-validated and compared to risk assessment methods. The LR approach predicted hypertension risk better than older techniques. Healthcare professionals and patients found the cloud integration of the personalized risk profiling system convenient, scalable, and accessible. It shows that cloud-based analytics may improve preventive healthcare by personalizing treatments to risk profiles. LR techniques can optimize personalized hypertension risk management in cloud-integrated systems, advancing data-driven healthcare.

articleTitle: Enhanced Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning on NVIDIA DGX Systems
abstract: Medical imaging has advanced significantly with recent advances in tumor detection using deep learning (DL) on NVIDIA DGX computers. Particularly in complex cases, traditional procedures that rely on manual radiologist analysis frequently suffer from inefficiencies and human mistakes. On the other hand, the proposed system makes use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on powerful NVIDIA DGX hardware to improve detection speed and accuracy. By preprocessing medical images to improve consistency and quality, the proposed system teaches CNNs on a variety of datasets to recognize tumor features on their own. Extensive training and validation optimize the CNN’s parameters, made possible by the powerful computational capabilities of the DGX system. When compared to existing systems, evaluation metrics show improved performance in terms of accuracy (92%), sensitivity (89%), specificity (94%), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) (95%). Faster diagnosis and treatment decisions are promised through implementation into clinical workflows, supported by real-time feedback to radiologists. Better patient outcomes in clinical practice are ensured by the proposed system, which not only expedites tumor identification procedures but also establishes new benchmarks for dependability and effectiveness in medical imaging diagnostics.

articleTitle: Development of Operational Framework and Standard Requirements for AI Assisted Robotic Surgery: Analysis Level of Autonomy
abstract: Almost every facet of contemporary life is being revolutionised by artificial intelligence (AI). Robotic surgery is the field of medicine that has seen some of the most significant and inventive developments. The range of surgeries that can be performed has expanded thanks to robotic surgery. Over the last ten years, a number of instances of partial surgical automation have been observed. We decompose the path of automation jobs into features that are necessary and offer a checklist that can assist in achieving higher surgical automation levels. Advances in technology, such as RMIS (robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery), have created new opportunities for automated and objective assessment systems. In this study, we automatically evaluated the surgeon’s performance in RMIS using machine learning techniques.Various classification techniques are used to distinguish between experienced and inexperienced surgeons. In order to evaluate the approach utilising actual surgical data for suturing tasks, this study compares the classification result with ground truth data. The outcomes of the experiment demonstrate that the suggested framework has $\mathbf{9 1. 5 \%}$ classification accuracy for surgical skill level.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Cyber Security Threat Detection Based on Artificial Intelligence Approaches
abstract: Amount of individuals and applications utilising the internet has been steadily rising in recent years, particularly with the advancements in Internet of Things technologies. The Internet is transforming how people learn and work as a result of its increasing integration with social life, but it also puts us at risk from ever-increasing security risks. In the present security landscape, the spread of IoT, the quick growth of computer networks, and the abundance of relevant applications have all contributed to the increased focus on cyber security in recent times. Developing an automated method for detecting cyber threats is one of the main difficulties facing cyber security. The advancement of learning-based strategies for cyber-attack detection as well as their noteworthy results can be attributed to the development of artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. So, this article compares various Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques for cyber-threats detection. Different Machine Learning (ML), Deep learning (DL), and Rule Based Approaches (RBA) are utilized to detect cyber security threats. Several parameters are analysed, such as accuracy, precision, f1-score, specificity, recall, error, FPR, FOR as well as NPV are utilized to analyse also evaluate the performance of AI approaches in cyber security. The accuracy values attained by using machine learning, deep learning, and rule based approaches are 91%, 95%, and 93%. According to the experimental analysis, deep learning algorithms performs better when compared to other machine learning and rule based approaches.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Optimization of EV Charging:Enhancing Efficiency and Grid Stability
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence to transform the infrastructure for charging electric vehicles (EVs) is examined in this article. The suggested intelligent charge management system forecasts demand with 95.2% accuracy using sophisticated machine learning models, cutting average wait times to 3.5 minutes and increasing resource usage efficiency to 87.4%. By lowering average load variation to 12.5 kW, attaining a 93.8% load forecasting accuracy, and providing 2,500 MWh via vehicle-to-grid interactions which results in a 22.1% decrease in peak load the AI-based load management module improves grid stability. Regression approaches are used by predictive maintenance models to accurately predict equipment failures, reducing downtime and prolonging the life of charging infrastructure. Real-time sensor data, historical charging data, and V2G logs are all included in the collection, which was obtained from utility companies and smart grid pilot programs. In the age of electric transportation, the suggested method demonstrates significant gains in all parameters, opening the door for more effective and sustainable energy management. The results show notable improvements in grid integration and EV charging optimization, providing a solid answer for the future of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Elderly Care Service System Based on Cloud Computing Platform
abstract: The elderly population is rapidly increasing, accompanied by a demand for better nursing services. In recent years, cloud computing has become a powerful tool for improving healthcare services. This article discusses the research and implementation of a cloud computing platform based elderly care service system. The system aims to provide personalized care services for the elderly at home. It uses cloud computing technology to store and process data related to the health status of the elderly. The system collects data from various sources, such as wearable devices, medical sensors, and electronic health records. Then, machine learning algorithms are used to analyze the collected data to identify patterns and trends in the health status of the elderly. Based on this analysis, personalized care plans were developed to meet the specific needs of each individual. The implementation of this system has several benefits, such as improving the quality of care, reducing medical costs, and improving efficiency. It also provides a platform for remote monitoring and remote medical services. In summary, researching and implementing a cloud computing platform based elderly care service system is an important step towards improving medical services for the elderly population. It provides a scalable solution that can be customized to meet individual needs while reducing costs associated with traditional healthcare systems. This article studies the K-Means clustering algorithm and implements its parallelization. Finally, based on the data integration analysis requirements of the system, this article designs a data integration processing scheme based on Map/Reduce, analyzes and processes the data in the system, explores the impact of elderly family education level on elderly people’s admission to elderly care institutions, and obtains clustering results that provide auxiliary decision-making for elderly care institutions.

articleTitle: The Diagnosis Method of Igbt Wiring Fault in Inverter
abstract: To solve the problem that IGBT wiring fault of inverters are difficult to be found and easily ignored, and the existing diagnostic methods are slow and have low recognition rate, a feature ex- traction strategy based on voltage mean is proposed, and the Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM) is optimized using Improved Loin Swarm Optimization (ILSO) to achieve fault diagnosis of IGBTs. Firstly, the effect of the Concordia transformation of the three-phase voltage in each state of the inverter is analyzed to obtain a two-dimensional vector that clearly characterizes the fault, and the separability of the wiring fault is verified by a two-dimensional scatter plot. Secondly, the parameters of KELM are optimized by the ILSO of Sine chaotic mapping to establish the diagnostic model. Finally, the inverter is taken as an example for verification. The results show that the proposed method can extract two-dimensional fault features containing rich fault information for IGBT wiring faults of inverters, which greatly simplifies the process of feature extraction. More- over, the proposed method is suitable for single and double faults. Compared with other methods, the proposed method is faster and has higher fault recognition rate.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Anomaly Detection for Enhancing Cybersecurity in Financial Institutions
abstract: It is important to highlight that the mere financial sectors are experiencing a heightened threat from cyber attackers, and thus, evidential anomaly detection remains pertinent when it comes to protection of confidential information as well as the integrity of financial transactions. The following is a machine learning based anomaly detection architecture which is aimed at improving the security of financial environments. Support Vector Machines (SVM), neuronal network, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) are some of the cutting-edge algorithms used in the proposed system to extract the features and classify. The studies were designed comprehensively on the basis of a rich set of transactions records. The findings show that the system sinks a high detection rate of $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$ and a low false alarm rate of 5%, which was quite higher to that of the rule-base and statistic model methods. Precision, recall and F1-score, additional measures that provide the examination of the selected algorithms’ efficiency and redundancy, attests to the reliability of the proposed approach. Thus, the system is easily scalable and can handle large amounts of data, which is why it is suitable for detecting anomalies in large and dynamic financial contexts. Further research will be directed at studying various continuous learning approaches that will complement the system’s antecedents to bolster its defenses against emerging threats. Thus, this investigation shows that it is possible to enhance security scenarios in the financial field using machine learning and offers further influence protection plans and tactics.

articleTitle: AI and Machine Learning for Intelligent Traffic Management in IoT-Connected Cities
abstract: The paper researches the possibility of identifying a potential approach of an intelligent traffic management system worrying the feasible uses of AI & ML for Traffic management in Smart Cities under IoT technology. The nodes that make this system efficient are the ability to capture real time data from the IoT devices including the sensors as well as the cameras in order to analysis the traffic patterns and therefore has the ability to adjust the traffic signals in real time. The specific form of the artificial intelligence algorithm used in the method were machine learning models, for example, Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) networks so as to enhance the ability to predict traffic condition. The enhancement that was attained permitted rural accessibility with flow densities throughout the peak period being lowered to a quarter and the average trip duration being cut down by to one fifteenth. From the results it was revealed that with the huge amount of data and real time decision making the proposed system minimally could address the traffic problem of the urban area. Hence, this current research supports AI interventions in improving the utility of the transport systems in cities.

articleTitle: Leveraging XGBoost based GBM for Proactive Detection of Man-in-the-Middle Cyber Attacks
abstract: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) cyber-attacks provide a substantial risk to network security, since they allow hostile individuals to intercept and alter communications between two parties. Conventional detection approaches frequently fail to recognize these complex threats, requiring the creation of more resilient and precise solutions. This study introduces a model called XGBoost-based Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) to identify MitM attacks in advance. The system employs extensive datasets from Kaggle, namely CICIDS 2017 and UNSW-NB15, for the purpose of training and evaluating the model. By carefully preparing the data, selecting relevant features, and doing thorough cross-validation with hyperparameter optimization, the suggested model attains exceptional performance metrics. The assessment findings indicate an accuracy of 0.98, precision of 0.97, recall of 0.96, F1-Score of 0.965, and a remarkable ROC-AUC score of 0.99. Our model regularly outperforms existing technologies like as Random Forest and Traditional GBM in identifying MitM attacks, achieving higher performance metrics across the board. This research demonstrates the effectiveness of the XGBoost-based GBM model in improving cybersecurity defenses and suggests that it might serve as a standard for future advancements in cyber-attack detection systems. The suggested system’s exceptional accuracy and resilience make it an invaluable tool for proactively detecting and reducing MitM attacks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Internet of Things Safety with AI-Powered Intrusion Avoidance Systems
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has ushered in unprecedented levels of connectivity, offering enhanced automation and data sharing across diverse domains. However, this surge in interconnectivity has brought about a significant challenge regarding cyber security threats and intrusions. To overcome this problem, we propose a Hybrid Bayesian Tree Fusion (HBTF) for predicting the detection system. These systems leverage the capabilities of Artificial Intelligence to predict and proactively mitigate potential security breaches. We gather the NSL-KDD data set for evaluating the proposed method for forecasting intrusion detection. The collected data are preprocessed using Z score normalization to eliminate the noise. Extract the feature from the preprocessed data using kernel-based independent component analysis (KICA). The experimental findings of the proposed method are evaluated by recall, precision, f1-score, and accuracy from the result. The HBTF is greater than the existing method. The integration of AI augments the capability of IoT networks to counter emerging threats, ultimately fostering a safer and more secure interconnected world.

articleTitle: Effective Optimization of Crop Monitoring and Management, Weather Forecasting & Network Slicing
abstract: Modern technologies help precision agriculture by improving weather predictions, crop management, and crop monitoring. To improve these farming techniques, this research develops a system that integrates a 5G network connection. The system consists of Network Slicing for Agricultural Applications, a Weather Forecasting Module, and a system for managing and monitoring crops. Real-time data on crop health, nitrogen levels, soil moisture, and other factors are gathered by the Crop Monitoring System for insect infestations using drones and IoT sensors. ML algorithms are then used to evaluate the data. For localized weather predictions, the Weather Forecasting Module uses sophisticated time series models and distributed weather stations. Network slicing guarantees the best possible resource allocation and service quality for a range of agricultural applications. The suggested system achieved a prediction accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 5 \%}$, resource utilization efficiency of $\mathbf{8 8. 3 \%}$, data latency of 25 ms, average bandwidth of 50 Mbps, latency for real-time monitoring of 15 ms, and overall network performance of $\mathbf{8 9. 8 \%}$, indicating significant improvements as shown by the experimental results. These results show that by integrating 5 G, the suggested solution significantly increases the efficacy and efficiency of precision agriculture.

articleTitle: GenBee: Hybridization for Cloud Load Balancing
abstract: Cloud computing, which is the central pillar of technological progress, simplifies access to services and resources through internet connection in cloud data centres. Load balancing, which is one of the key components of cloud computing, enhances performance, resource utilisation, and availability by distributing incoming network traffic to multiple servers or resources. Effective load-balancing mechanisms adaptively allocate tasks and workloads based on server capabilities, network conditions, and user demands for better system responsiveness. This paper presents a hybrid methodology that combines Genetic Algorithm (GA) with Honeybee Optimization Algorithm (HBO) for optimal workload distribution and resource allocation in cloud environments. GA optimises the solution iteratively while HBO refines solution space and improves exploration ability. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach makes response time better, enhances throughput as well as improves resource utilisation. The comparative analysis demonstrates that our hybrid model performs much better in terms of load distribution and resource efficiency. This investigation has contributed to advancing load management methods in cloud computing thereby opening up possibilities for hybrid optimization strategies in sophisticated computing applications.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based SVM Approach for Automated Sleep Stage Prediction in Children Using Wearable Technology
abstract: Proper sleep is necessary for growth and development; hence, sleep stage prediction is very important for understanding people’s sleep habits and quality, especially in children. A non-invasive and practical solution, wearable electronics, has recently emerged as a potential instrument for continual monitoring of sleep. Automated sleep stage prediction in children utilizing data acquired from wearable devices is proposed in this research using a cloud-based Support Vector Machine (SVM) technique. The technology makes use of data collected from wearable sensors that measure physiological signals, such as electrocardiograms (ECG), accelerometers, and electroencephalograms (EEG). To improve prediction accuracy while reducing computational complexity, feature extraction methods are used to extract relevant properties from raw sensor data. These features are selected for further use. The collected characteristics are used to train a SVM classifier on a cloud-based platform, which then sorts sleep phases. With its cloud-based design, massive data sets can be processed easily, and real-time predictions can be made with ease. When tested on industry-standard sleep datasets, the proposed technique outperforms innovative approaches in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. By combining the power of wearable devices with cloud computing, the proposed approach provides an effective and dependable method for predicting the stages of a child’s sleep automatically.

articleTitle: Cavier Migration Algorithm Enabled Deep Kronecker Network for Student Performance Prediction
abstract: With the advancement of technology, the prediction of student performance has reached a lot of attention in the educational field. Moreover, academic achievement is one of the major goals of educational institutions to monitor the performance of their students and provide special care to the students who are in lagged performance. Due to the massive volume of educational data, the performance computation methodologies become more complex. To solve such complicity, a novel model named Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk by Regression Migration Algorithm-based Deep Kronecker Network (CAViaRMA_DKN) is developed to predict student performance. The gathering of student’s data is the primary process. The min-max normalization is utilized for normalizing the redundant data. The feature selection is needed for selecting the essential features with the utilization of Chord distance. The student performance prediction is performed by the DKN, which is trained by the CAViaRMA. The metrics like accuracy, recall, precision, F-measure, and Negative Predictive Value (NPV) are utilized to compute the effectiveness of CAViaRMA_DKN-based student performance prediction, which offers the optimal outcome of $91.79 \%, \mathbf{9 0. 9 6 \%}$, 91.27%, $\mathbf{9 0. 9 6 \%}$, and $\mathbf{9 0. 2 7 \%}$.

Author Keywords: Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk by Regression (CAViaR)

articleTitle: Personalized Care for Multiple Sclerosis with IoT Wearables and Deep Learning
abstract: This research work presents a new method for improving individualized treatment for patients with Multiple Sclerosis (MS) by combining Internet of Things (IoT) wearables with deep learning (DL) methods, namely Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. MS is a long-term autoimmune disorder that affects the central nervous system. It is marked by unexpected episodes of worsening symptoms and periods of improvement, highlighting the need for tailored therapy. The widespread use of IoT devices presents unique possibilities for the ongoing monitoring of many physiological and activity measurements important to the development and symptoms of MS. Using LSTM networks, which are very proficient in analyzing temporal sequences, create a prediction model that may anticipate exacerbations of MS symptoms and customize therapies appropriately. Through the analysis of longitudinal data obtained from IoT devices, our model acquires knowledge about unique patterns of illness development and treatment response. This knowledge allows us to create customized care plans for individuals. These paths include proactive activities such as adjusting medication, making lifestyle changes, and seeking early medical advice. The goal is to reduce the worsening of symptoms, improve the quality of life, and optimize treatment results for individuals with MS. The proposed method shows potential for transforming the treatment of MS by offering proactive and patient-centered therapy adaptable to individual requirements and the dynamics of the illness.

articleTitle: Ensemble Classifiers Optimized for Diabetes Mellitus Prediction via Hyperparameter Tuning
abstract: Diabetes is an enduring health malady that influences entity globally, leading to serious health intricacies if not addressed well. Early detection and diagnosis are quintessential for management and cure. This research employs the Pima Indians’ diabetes-related dataset, focusing on variables essential for predicting diabetes, especially within a population with a high prevalence of the condition. The data includes information on 768 women from the Phoenix, Arizona area. Our approach entails data preprocessing and feature selection, utilizing the method to pinpoint the most relevant features with the goal of improving model performance. This process resulted in a consistent dataset for training effective machine learning models. To address any imbalances in class distribution, we applied SMOTETomek for augmentation, and model validation was accomplished with the technique called as stratified K-fold cross validation used for model evaluation, particularly in classification problems, to ensure reliability. We explored machine learning techniques ranging from Decision Tree, K Nearest Neighbor, Naive Bayes, and Logistic Regression to advanced ensemble methods such as CatBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest in order to determine which approach yields the most accurate predictions. We evaluated criteria such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and ROC AUC to compare models. After adjusting hyperparameters, the LGBM model demonstrated accuracy in predicting diabetes, with values of 0.9342 for accuracy, 0.9228 for precision, 0.9351 for F1 score, 0.9486 for recall, and 0.9798 for AUC. This study emphasizes how innovative data-driven methods in healthcare can be leveraged to enhance detection and personalized treatment plans within healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Pufferfish Optimizer based Enhanced UNETR for Accurate Lung Cancer Segmentation and Classification
abstract: According to recent data released by the WHO, lung tumours are the top cause of death worldwide. One of the promising areas for effective lung cancer detection is tumour segmentation. To determine the location of tumours and the extent of malignancy, doctors use computerised tomography (CT) scans. Radiation oncologists face a daunting and timeconsuming challenge with medical imaging segmentation that requires handcrafting. This article proposes a comprehensive approach for early detection of lung cancer using CT scan imaging as a solution to this challenge. In order to improve patients’ chances of survival, this study presents an automated diagnostic algorithm. Part one of the suggested lung cancer diagnostic system is a segmentation constituent built on the UNEt TRansformers (UNETR) network, and part two is a classification component that uses the output segmentation component to label the output as benign or malignant, built on the self-supervised network. Pufferfish Optimisation Algorithm (POA) identifies the best values for UNETR’s trainable parameters. The suggested practise offers a potent resource for the early detection and treatment of lung cancer by utilising data from 3D-input CT scans. The three-stage suggested lung cancer classification model makes use of a modified U-Net for detection. To improve segmentation and classification outcomes, a large amount of trials have been conducted.

articleTitle: Iris Monitor: Real-time Surveillance Systems Integrated with Iris Recognition
abstract: Using iris recognition technology, Iris Monitor is a state-of-the-art surveillance system that improves biometric authentication and offers real-time monitoring in modern security environments. Measuring factors including FAR, FRR, authentication speed, correctness, scalability, and system dependability allowed the researchers to evaluate how well Iris Monitor performed. The findings showed that the accuracy rate was 98.5%, the FAR was 0.5%, the FRR was 1.2%, and the authentication time was 0.2 seconds. Furthermore, with a $\mathrm{9 9. 9 \%}$ system dependability rate, Iris Monitor demonstrated remarkable scalability. When compared to other biometric systems, like voice recognition, facial recognition, and fingerprint scanners, Iris Monitor performs better. It exhibits improved accuracy, a shorter authentication time, and a reduced FAR. The results demonstrate the robustness and efficiency of Iris Monitor and point to its potential for broad use in security-sensitive scenarios requiring stringent authentication and monitoring features. As a leading biometric surveillance system, Iris Monitor is a state-of-the-art device that excels in performance measures.

articleTitle: Enhancing V2V Communication Systems with Deep Learning-Based Parametric Models for Improved Performance and Reliability
abstract: This paper provides the processes of designing and testing the deep learning-based parametric models to improve the performance of V 2 V systems. The proposed approach aims at solving some of the key challenges facing the V2V communication including the SNR, low latency and data through put in dynamic environment. The models were trained on both simulated and actual data so that they were able to easily employ changes in gain in response to fluctuations in the communication environment. The communication SNR, latency, BER and the reliability of the communication were used as the KPIs of the models. From the results we obtain high gains and enhancements; SNR increased to rate of fifty percent, latency reduced to a level of twenty percent; BER reduced by order of magnitude. At the same time, data transfer rate was increased by 20% and the signal reliability was compensated with the range.
