These results, therefore, provide evidence of deep learning methods’ ability to support the improvement of V2V communication systems and their subsequent implementation in the lookup of strong and efficient intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: Evaluating The Impact of Activation Functions on CNN Performance in Brain Tumor Detection
abstract: In today’s world, mental health is significantly impacted by lifestyle changes, aging populations, environmental factors, food habits, social media, and technology. Brain tumors, an aggressive malignant disease, drastically shorten life expectancy if not diagnosed early. The classification of tumors, which relies on their size, shape, and location, is crucial in medical image processing. Tumor detection with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has shown promise. Because convolutional neural networks (CNNs) can learn features by backpropagation using convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers, they are frequently employed for image categorization tasks. Activation functions, which introduce non-linearity and normalize outputs, play a critical role in enabling neural networks to learn complex patterns and reduce computational complexity. This research paper evaluates the impact of different activation functions on CNN performance in brain tumor detection. Using a dataset containing 4468 images across 17 classes, we implemented a CNN architecture consisting of an input layer, convolutional layers, activation functions (ReLU), normalization layers, and pooling layers, with softmax and sigmoid functions in the output layers. Our study conducts a comparative analysis of various activation functions to enhance model accuracy and detection rates. The findings contribute to improving brain tumor diagnosis, offering valuable insights for medical professionals, researchers, public health authorities, and healthcare institutions. The ultimate goal of this research is to improve CNN performance in medical image processing, which will help with brain tumor early identification and therapy.

articleTitle: Routing-Based Distributed Mobility Management Supporting Seamless Data Transmission in Smart Cities Study
abstract: In the context of burgeoning smart cities, seamless data transmission plays a pivotal role in enhancing urban mobility management. This paper introduces a novel approach to Routing-Based Distributed Mobility Management (RBDMM) designed to support robust and seamless data communication. By integrating advanced routing protocols with distributed architectures, our proposed system addresses critical challenges of scalability, reliability, and latency in urban networks. The methodology involves the deployment of multiple distributed nodes across urban landscapes, each independently managing local traffic to facilitate quicker responses and reduced network latency. Key algorithms include a Path Selection Algorithm, Load Balancing Algorithm, and Data Integrity Algorithm, optimized through mathematical models to evaluate network latency and throughput. Simulations conducted using NS3 demonstrate significant improvements in data transmission efficiency and reductions in packet loss compared to conventional centralized mobility management solutions. The results show that the RBDMM system achieves a 41.67% reduction in average latency, a 37.5% increase in throughput, and an 8% improvement in packet delivery ratio. These findings indicate the system’s potential to significantly enhance data transmission processes in smart cities, ensuring more reliable, efficient, and scalable network management. In conclusion, the RBDMM system sets a foundation for future advancements in urban mobility management, promoting enhanced smart city operations and paving the way for further innovations in data management and urban planning.

articleTitle: Development of an All-Trained Rover for Comprehensive Monitoring of Extraterrestrial Environments
abstract: This work presents the concept of a new advanced robotic rover that is to be employed for the environmental assessment in the space environment. It has a complex of sensors to measure and categorise several parameters of the environment, including the oxygen, carbon dioxide, methane, temperature, humidity, pH of the soil and water. The primary purpose is the creation of a sufficient and autonomous tool for the assessment of the possibilities of existence and danger on other planets. The smart system of the rover processes information on the surrounding area and initiates necessary response to the threat seen and informs the mission control. Good communication systems increase the chances of getting information and data to the Earth in real-time thus increase the chances of observing the environment and atmospheric changes. In order to function in the aggressive and unstable environment of space, the rover is equipped with improved features in automation, environment awareness and safe operation, which will benefit the future space missions to make better decisions.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method System of Investment and Financing Institutions based on Graph Neural Network
abstract: The investment and financing institution system is based on graphical neural network. A graph is a structure in which information is represented as a network of nodes and links. The main idea of the model is to use the information contained in the financial statements to predict future performance, which is not always available to investors. The model was tested using the data of companies listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) from 2003 to 2017. The results show that it performs better than traditional methods (such as cash flow discount analysis and earnings per share). In the Internet financial environment, financial institutions hope to collect and analyze a large number of data on the daily trading behavior of technology-based SMEs, and judge their business scope, business status, credit status, enterprise positioning, capital demand and industry development trend. In the context of the era of big data mobile internet, the sharing and access of credit data are undergoing fundamental changes. Small and medium-sized technology-based enterprises that use the Internet to conduct business operations and product promotion have accounted for a large proportion. In order to enable SMEs to obtain financing more scientifically and effectively and select appropriate SMEs for financing institutions, the BP neural network model of financing credit evaluation method is constructed based on the analysis of SMEs’ financing credit evaluation method and the characteristics of BP neural network by establishing a scientific SME credit evaluation index system.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Detect, Analyze, Act: Advancing Cybersecurity Investigations with Data Engineering and AI
abstract: The complexity of cybersecurity operations is on the rise as cyber threats continue to multiply and evolve. One potential solution for tackling these obstacles is the combination of data engineering and artificial intelligence. The paper focuses on the role of data engineering in cybersecurity investigations, highlighting techniques for effectively gathering, organizing, and storing data. The utilization of AI-driven analytics, incorporating both supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, has significantly transformed the realm of threat detection within the realm of extensive datasets. Furthermore, AI enables the implementation of automated response actions through the use of dynamic risk assessment, adaptive access controls, and incident remediation procedures. Utilizing AI and data engineering can greatly benefit businesses in bolstering their cybersecurity efforts. These technologies empower organizations to take a proactive approach in identifying potential threats, swiftly responding to incidents, and effectively detecting threats in real time. It also highlights the importance of strengthening defensive measures against constantly changing cyber threats in today’s interconnected digital landscape through the use of advanced technology.

articleTitle: Smart Allergy Management: Integrating ML into Immune Disorder Care
abstract: The study presents a Smart Allergy Management system that uses machine learning (ML) to transform immune disorder treatment. The existing healthcare system is based on delaying interventions and generalist therapies that lack accuracy. The proposed system combines ML algorithms for early identification with wearables for continuous tracking and environmental analysis. Patient education is improved with ML-powered applications and telehealth integration. Methodologically, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), AdaBoost, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machines (SVM) are used for early detection, tailored treatment plans, environmental monitoring, and telehealth integration. The results demonstrate enhanced early detection accuracy (94%), treatment adherence (87%), environmental alert response time (5 minutes), and telehealth efficiency (94%). Patients report a 30% reduction in allergy reactions, a better quality of life, and excellent satisfaction ($\mathbf{9 4 \%}$). The system’s versatility, ongoing learning, and ethical concerns guarantee a patient-centered system. Limitations include privacy problems, technological accessibility, and algorithm interpretability. Future study should address these concerns and investigate future technologies to improve system capabilities.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Network Security in MANETs using Modified Self-Optimization Algorithm (MSFO) for IoT Applications
abstract: The communication between smart devices in the Industrial Internet of Things relies heavily on Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (MANETs), allowing decentralized connectivity between nodes. Because of its digital qualities, encrypting one-dimensional data directly might be challenging. For this reason, a lightweight key frame extraction method is developed that is both safe and efficient for enhancing personal data confidentiality. Further, this proposed research aims to develop robust security protocol named Modified Sail Fish Optimization Algorithm (MSFO) for MANET-based IoT applications. The proposed approach introduce a chaotic cryptography-based privacy preservation model and optimizing the key generation process through a newly developed MSFO algorithm. The suggested MSFO model is tested for throughput and evaluated for effectiveness. Experimental observations and findings show that the suggested SA-SFO algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms. The PSO algorithm exhibited a decreasing trend in throughput, starting at 87.65% for 10 iterations and gradually declining to 77.23% by the 100th iteration. IASFO showed a similar trend but maintained higher throughput values compared to PSO, beginning at $\mathbf{9 2. 3 5 \%}$ and reducing to $\mathbf{8 4. 1 \%}$ over the same range. MSFO consistently outperformed both PSO and IASFO, with initial throughput of 95.4% at 10 iterations, which decreased to 88.1% at 100 iterations. These results demonstrate that MSFO provides superior performance in maintaining higher throughput values across the tested range.

articleTitle: Neural Networks for Effective Member Density Monitoring in IoT-Enabled Smart Fitness Centers
abstract: Improving user experience and operational management in the quickly growing field of IoT-enabled smart fitness centers relies heavily on accurate member density monitoring. This paper provides a new method that uses neural networks to effectively monitor member density in these kinds of settings. Incorporating Internet of Things (IoT) sensors into the fitness center's layout to gather occupancy data in real-time is essential to our process. Feed this data into a neural network architecture that was built to estimate densities. It demonstrates the accuracy, scalability, and durability of our system in various operating circumstances by evaluating its performance via real-world experiments and comprehensive simulations. It communicates about how our method may be used in smart fitness centers that are connected to the IoT to improve management efficiency, resource allocation, and user happiness. Our efforts help push the current state of the art in the use of artificial intelligence methods for improving the efficiency of advanced gyms.

articleTitle: Multi-Model Deep Learning Fusion for Improved Alzheimer’s Disease Classification with MRI and Cognitive Data
abstract: Given its increasing impact and enormous global societal impact, Alzheimer’s disease (AD) presents a serious issue in the healthcare industry. Effective therapies and management techniques for AD depend on early detection and a precise diagnosis. On the other hand, traditional diagnostic approaches frequently depend on expensive imaging methods and arbitrary clinical judgments, which causes delays in diagnosis and less than ideal results. By utilizing MRI scans and handwriting samples, the suggested strategy embraces the ability of multi-modal data integration to offer a novel perspective to AD prediction. A non-invasive and economical method of identifying minor motor and cognitive problems suggestive of early-stage $A D$ is handwriting analysis, whereas MRI offers important insights into the structural brain abnormalities linked to AD. To rigorously pre-process and extract significant features from MRI and handwriting data, state-of-the-art deep learning techniques are used. A multimodal neural network architecture is then fed these features for combined analysis and prediction. Accuracy rates of $\mathbf{8 8 \%}$ for handwriting data and $\mathbf{9 0} \%$ for MRI images are attained by each independently trained model. A unified classifier is then used to aggregate the outputs of different models and refine the categorization through the addition of denser layers A remarkable $\mathbf{9 7 \%}$ accuracy on the test set is achieved by this combined model, which considerably improves diagnostic accuracy. The technique provides a comprehensive approach to AD prediction by combining structural and functional information from MRI with handwriting data, enabling early detection and individualized treatment plans. In order to create robust and trustworthy diagnostic tools, the results emphasize how crucial it is to integrate many data modalities and use deep learning approaches.

articleTitle: Advanced Diagnosis of Alzheimer’s Disease Through Deep Learning Analysis of MRI Images
abstract: This study builds a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture specifically to identify Alzheimer’s disease. The background of this study is that at present there is no proper testing tool for AD and there is a pressing need for the diagnosis and treatment of this disorder; which can greatly impact patient outcomes. The goal of this study is to propose an AD classification system based on CNN architecture that classifies four categories in real-time by MRI images. The dataset contained 6400 MRI images and the CNN model was trained for an epoch using a batch size of $\mathbf{3 2}$ running at the default learning rate over 20 epochs. The CNN architecture was formed through powerful iterative rounds of training to make sure it can perform accurately when divided into Alzheimer’s disease subtypes. The results show that this CNN model achieved a stunning 99% accuracy rate in diagnosing Alzheimer’s disease based on MRI images. A standard method for AD estimation, the results achieved for age-specific access are highly instructive for determining the effectiveness of CNN-based methodologies in medical image analysis and differentiating diseases. The results of this study are significant because it can be diagnosed and classified into a system, as a matter of course Alzheimer’s will be detected earlier the outcome for patients made better treatment outcomes superior. The CNN model proposed in this study creates an opportunity for future testing systems in Alzheimer’s disease classification that promise significantly improved performance. This in turn will contribute not only to the digital image technology of medical imaging technology but also to patient care.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Optimized Energy Management in Smart Grids
abstract: The implementation of smart grids has brought about a revolution in the operation of energy systems, hence paving the way for power distribution systems that are more efficient and environmentally friendly. The purpose of this investigation is to explore the operation of underlying literacy (RL) methods that optimize energy operation in smart grids. The purpose of the study is to develop adaptive strategies that minimize energy usage, improve grid performance, and strike a balance between demand and force in real-time. These strategies will be developed through the use of RL algorithms. Bluffing grid scripts and driving RL agents to learn and improve decision-making processes are both components of the methodology that has been offered. To determine whether or not the RL-based strategy is successful, it is necessary to quantify the effectiveness of relevant criteria such as energy efficiency, cost reduction, and trustworthiness. The results of the study indicate that the use of learning as a foundation considerably enhances the functional efficacy of smart grids, providing a robust solution to the issues that are associated with ultramodern energy systems. The purpose of this study is to shed light on the potential role that RL could play in attaining sustainable energy operation and to establish the foundation for future developments in smart grid technology.

articleTitle: Integrating Advanced Neural Network Architectures for Effective Skin Disorder Classification
abstract: Skin illnesses, such as vitiligo, provide considerable hurdles in proper diagnosis due to their resemblance to other conditions, necessitating time-consuming examinations by medical personnel. Taking advantage of advances in deep learning and medical image processing, this study suggests a novel way to swiftly and accurately classify these disorders. The proposed model uses many convolutional layers to extract detailed features from skin pictures, followed by Long ShortTerm Memory (LSTM) layers to capture temporal dependencies and improve feature representation. This hybrid architecture consists of six convolutional layers that gradually increase in depth and spatial reduction via max-pooling, culminating in two LSTM layers and three fully connected layers for precise classification. By combining CNNs’ spatial feature extraction powers with LSTMs’ sequence processing skills, our model obtains a high training accuracy of $\mathbf{9 3. 4 0 \%}$ and precision of $\mathbf{9 4. 4 8 \%}$, proving its usefulness in distinguishing between vitiligo and scar images. This approach shows potential for improving diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in clinical settings, resulting in better patient outcomes and healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Harnessing Meta-Heuristics for Predictive Analytics: Enhancing Workplace Success through Advanced Algorithms
abstract: In today’s dynamic professional world, predicting workplace success is crucial for fostering a productive and harmonious environment. The Big Five personality traits—Openness, Conscientiousness, Extra-version, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism are widely recognized for their impact on job performance and employee well-being. Openness involves creativity and change, while Conscientiousness reflects discipline and organization. Extra-version signifies sociability, Agreeableness involves compassion, and Neuroticism relates to negative emotions. The prediction of workplace success using the Big Five personality traits has become a prominent focus in the field of organizational psychology. Traditional predictive algorithms are unable to capture complex and multidimensional relationships inherent in personality data hence this study leverages biologically inspired meta-heuristic algorithms. Meta-heuristic algorithms are high-level problem solving algorithms which help finding optimal solutions. The classification algorithm Random Forest(RF) is used as predictive model for its robustness and ability to handle large datasets with multiple dimensions. This study conducts a comparative analysis of meta-heuristic algorithms, specifically Ant Colony Optimization(ACO) and Genetic Algorithm(GA), to enhance the predictive accuracy of workplace success models by finding optimal feature sets and weights. By providing a deeper understanding of how personality traits influence workplace success, this research contributes to countering toxic work environments and also helps improve team compositions. It offers valuable insights for organizations and human resource professionals focused on optimizing employee selection and development processes, ultimately fostering a more healthier and productive work environment.

articleTitle: Explainable AI for Shaping Adoption of Artificial Intelligence
abstract: The rapid integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across diverse sectors has revolutionized operational processes and decision-making frameworks, yet the opaque nature of many AI models remains a significant barrier to widespread adoption. Explainable AI (XAI) emerges as a pivotal solution to this challenge, offering methodologies that enhance transparency and interpretability, thereby fostering trust and confidence among users. This paper delves into the critical role of XAI in shaping the adoption of AI technologies, emphasizing the necessity for AI systems to be not only powerful but also understandable. We conduct a comprehensive literature review on current XAI techniques, highlighting model-agnostic methods such as LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations) and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), as well as intrinsically interpretable models like decision trees and rule-based systems. Furthermore, we propose a novel framework for integrating XAI principles into existing AI systems, enhancing their transparency without compromising performance. The framework’s efficacy is demonstrated through a detailed case study, showcasing how XAI can improve user trust and decision-making processes. Results from the implementation are analyzed and discussed, providing insights into the practical benefits and challenges of XAI. This study underscores the potential of XAI to significantly influence the future trajectory of AI adoption, making AI systems more accessible and trustworthy.

articleTitle: Automatic Motorcyclist Helmet Rule Violation Detection using YOLOv5
abstract: Road traffic injuries rank among the leading causes of death worldwide, with motorcyclists accounting for a significant proportion of these fatalities. According to the World Health Organization, helmets are effective in reducing the risk of head injuries by approximately 69% and fatalities by about $\mathbf{4 2 \%}$. Despite these benefits, compliance with helmet laws remains inconsistent, underscoring the need for enhanced enforcement strategies. This paper presents the development of an Automatic Motorcyclist Helmet Rule Violation Detection system that employs the advanced YOLOv5 model to address this challenge. The system is designed to detect motorcyclists without helmets in real-time and simultaneously capture their vehicle number plates, thus aiding law enforcement in the effective enforcement of helmet laws. By automating the detection and reporting process, the system reduces the reliance on manual monitoring and helps ensure more consistent and unbiased enforcement across various road conditions and traffic volumes. Additionally, the real-time functionality of the system allows for immediate action to be taken against violators, potentially deterring future non-compliance and fostering a culture of safety among riders. Through this technology-driven approach, our project contributes to ongoing efforts in leveraging cutting-edge technology to improve road safety and reduce the incidence of motorcycle-related accidents and injuries, aligning with global initiatives for safer roads.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Optimization: Leveraging Meta-Heuristic Algorithms for Sustainable Agriculture
abstract: Agriculture is the main industry in India and plays a major role in the country’s economy, which is the primary source of GDP growth, rural development, and the production of needs like food, fiber, and medicinal plants. It is a factor in improving infrastructure and creating employment in rural areas. This proposed meta-heuristic approach provides precise resource allocation schemes by utilizing advanced algorithms such as the Firefly Algorithm (FA), Simulated Annealing (SA), and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO). These algorithms, inspired by nature, effectively distribute labor, fertilizer, and water among other resources while considering weather conditions, soil type, crop type, and land size. They ensure a balance between maximizing production and using resources efficiently by continuously improving their search for optimal solutions through trial and error. Traditional techniques frequently depend on set models whereas meta-heuristic algorithms provide adaptable and flexible solutions for the complex structure of agriculture systems. For complex agriculture optimization issues, scalable solutions are provided by meta-heuristic algorithms. Their flexibility allows them to serve a range of farm sizes and needs, including small-family farms and large-scale businesses. This approach combines smart optimization techniques with innovative algorithms like ACO, SA, and FA to improve farm productivity sustainably. Through the integration of modern technology and efficient resource management, farmers are provided with an effective tool that increases yields while decreasing their environmental impact. This meta-heuristic approach can be used by organizations in the agricultural sectors-tech, analytics, consulting, research, agribusiness, startups, and government agencies-to increase agricultural sustainability and production.

articleTitle: Securing Fog Nodes: Behavioural and Anomaly Based Hybrid IDS
abstract: Strong security measures are required due to the widespread use of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in various fields, particularly in the context of fog computing, where devices are distanced from the cloud. Fog nodes act as intermediaries between IoT devices and cloud resources. By placing resources closer to end users, fog computing raises the possibility of targeted attacks. This distributed nature of fog computing environments creates multiple entry points for attackers. This research addresses the imperative need for secure fog computing by proposing a Behaviour and Anomaly-based Hybrid Intrusion Detection System that combines Network Intrusion Detection System and Host Intrusion Detection System, incorporating resource usage metrics monitoring and network communication pattern analysis at the same time. Transfer Learning is used to change the models so they suit the environment. By using this method, we improve the models to better fit the specific requirements of fog computing setups.

articleTitle: Research and Development of On-Line Partial Discharge Monitoring System for switch Gear Based on DSP
abstract: In order to meet the challenges of the research and development of on-line monitoring system for partial discharge of switch gear, in view of the shortcomings of the existing dynamic programming algorithms, this study proposes a research and development method of an innovative on-line monitoring system based on DSP. This new scheme uses the theoretical principles of remote sensing monitoring to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly carries out a sensible classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, using the unique mechanism of DSP, the design strategy of the monitoring system is cleverly constructed. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows a significant improvement compared with the traditional dynamic programming algorithm in the key performance indicators such as the accuracy of the research and development of the online monitoring system, the processing efficiency of key factors, and shows its obvious strong advantages. The research and development of on-line monitoring system plays a vital role in the partial discharge of switch gear, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of on-line monitoring system of switch gear partial discharge. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional dynamic programming algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of the research and development of DSP-optimized online monitoring system, which accurately controls the influencing parameters through remote sensing monitoring theory, and uses this as a road map for index allocation, and then uses DSP to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the research and development of the on-line partial discharge monitoring system of switch gear, the DSP-based simulation scheme successfully overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional dynamic programming algorithm, and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of the simulation.

Author Keywords: Partial discharge of the switch gear

articleTitle: Enhancing Enterprise Resource Planning Sustainability with Adaptive CNN-Ensemble Techniques
abstract: Globally, companies are struggling with the integration of their long-term operations. There is a lack of sufficient integrated sustainability data to underpin decisions. To tackle this challenge, businesses must have information systems that back up sustainability initiatives. Sustainable Enterprise Resource Planning (S-ERP) is a proposed method that offers a holistic approach to strengthening sustainability initiatives. This proposed approach consists of feature selection, model training, and log preprocessing as its three steps. When it comes to log preprocessing, finding problems with the data quality in the event $\log$ is crucial. Feature selection makes use of optimization in human resource management. Throughout the entire model training process, an Adaptive CNN Ensemble was employed. The average accuracy achieved by this new approach is 94.45%, which is higher than CNN and ELM.

articleTitle: Design of a simplified Charging Equalizer for Safety Enhancement of Electric Vehicle
abstract: Lithium-ion (Li-ion) batteries are commonly used in electric vehicle (EV) applications due to their higher energy density, longer lifespan, and better performance. However, there are few limitations of Li- ion setup including overcharging, undercharging, risk of explosion and nonlinear life cycle. These issues when sustained over a period, significantly reduces the effective charging capacity and the efficiency of the battery pack. It is estimated that the conventional charging cycles deviate above the permissible variation up to $7 \%$ of the long time average of the installed pack. For the dynamically varying loads, this deviation increased up to even $15 \%$. Keeping an objective of maintaining the duty cycle deviation within $10 \%$, this paper proposes a simple Charge equalizer that uses Arduino based controller to handle the relays for changing the charging process from one cell to another. Different combinations of relay activations tried for extended charging cycle. The dynamic variation of cell voltages, calculating maximum and minimum transient voltages, controlling charge/discharge cycles are the few topics discussed in this paper. It is found from the experiment that up to 7 charge cycles the deviation was about $10 \%$ and beyond which it remains constant. Final conclusion and future scope have discussed in brief.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction of Space-Ground Integrated Information Network Based on Improved Lstm Algorithm
abstract: A network traffic prediction system based on the modified LSTM algorithm was devised in response to the constraints of the standard BFS algorithm in space-ground integrated information network traffic prediction. Initial steps in developing a network traffic prediction scheme include precisely localizing influencing components using gating mechanism theory, properly dividing indicators to decrease interference, and finally, building the scheme using the upgraded LSTM algorithm. The experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested scheme outperforms the conventional BFS algorithm under certain assessment criteria, particularly with regard to the processing time of influencing variables and the accuracy of network traffic predictions. The ability to effectively forecast and optimize the development characteristics and product creation of the space-ground integrated information network is enabled by network traffic prediction, which plays a crucial role in this network. When it comes to tackling traffic simulation challenges, the classic BFS method has its limits, particularly when dealing with complicated situations. To address this issue more effectively, this research proposes a network traffic prediction technique that is based on an upgraded LSTM algorithm. This technique makes use of the upgraded LSTM algorithm to build itself after precisely locating the influencing components using the gating mechanism theory in order to decide the division of indicators. Under certain assessment conditions, the experimental findings reveal that the scheme’s speed and accuracy are much enhanced for various tasks, and it performs better overall. Hence, for the purpose of improving the simulation accuracy and efficiency in space-ground integrated information network traffic prediction, a method based on the upgraded LSTM algorithm is preferable to the classic BFS algorithm.

articleTitle: Cloud-Enabled Decision Tree Algorithm for Intelligent Tire Pressure Monitoring and Vehicle Safety Enhancement
abstract: This paper introduces a new method for monitoring tire pressure and improving vehicle safety by combining cloud computing with Decision Tree (DT) algorithms. Although tire pressure is an important metric for both the efficiency and security of a vehicle, conventional monitoring systems often fail to provide both real-time data and comprehensive analysis. Tire pressure data may be quickly gathered, processed, and analyzed in real-time by using the power of cloud computing. Using this information, the proposed DT algorithm may predict any tire pressure irregularities and suggest the best course of action to improve vehicle safety. The system determines the best tire pressure levels for each individual vehicle by taking a few data into account, including weather, driving conditions, and vehicle specs. The proposed system’s versatility, scalability, and capacity to integrate with current vehicle safety systems are its key strengths. To provide consistent performance across varied vehicle fleets, the system makes use of cloud resources to adapt to different data volumes and processing needs. The DT method may also be enhanced and improved over time by incorporating real-world input into ongoing refinements and updates. The method reduces the potential of tire-related mishaps and improves vehicle safety, according to the experimental findings. Overall road safety and vehicle performance are enhanced by the system’s ability to detect and fix low tire pressure in advance, giving drivers more information to make informed decisions and avoid problems.

articleTitle: E-commerce Reviews Decoded: The Power of LLMs in Rating Helpfulness
abstract: Consumer reviews play a pivotal role in influencing purchasing decisions on e-commerce platforms. However, the sheer volume of reviews available for most products imposes a cognitive burden on consumers. Therefore, the reviews presented on the first few pages are crucial. Prioritizing the most helpful reviews to include in these initial pages not only enhances user experience but also facilitates better purchasing decisions. Identifying the helpfulness of a review is essential for implementing any type of sorting mechanism. Although websites have implemented upvoting mechanisms, their utility is often diminished due to conformity bias and exposure bias, leading to less helpful reviews flooding the initial pages.This study initially investigates the sentiments associated with consumer behavior, consumer reviews, and the current methods for determining the helpfulness of these reviews, using a survey to gather these insights. Consequently, it examines the potential of large language models (LLMs), in identifying the helpfulness of product reviews. The effectiveness of LLM models is analyzed by comparing LLM-generated scores against human-labeled helpfulness scores for Amazon reviews of products across a few categories. Our findings confirm that the latest models consistently achieve RMSE values of less than 1 on a $\mathbf{1 - 5}$ score scale when comparing LLM and human scores, indicating that LLMs can accurately assess review helpfulness. This research highlights the strengths of LLMs in streamlining the review ranking process, potentially improving the relevance and quality of reviews showcased to consumers on e-commerce platforms.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Pneumonia Detection: Leveraging Advanced AI and Machine Learning for Enhanced Diagnostic Accuracy using YOLOv8
abstract: The healthcare sector has observed notable progressions as a result of incorporating computer technology and artificial intelligence (AI). This study explores the application of deep learning and machine learning techniques to the detection and management of pneumonia, a common respiratory disease caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi. Pneumonia poses a significant hurdle in medical environments due to its diverse symptoms and the necessity for accurate diagnosis to ensure effective therapy. This study uses artificial intelligence (AI), namely convolutional neural networks (CNN), VGG16, ResNet50v2, and the most recent YOLOv8 algorithm, to increase the accuracy and efficiency of pneumonia recognition from chest X-ray images. Our dataset, obtained from Guangzhou Women and Children’s Medical Center, consists of $\mathbf{5, 8 6 6}$ X-ray images that have carefully been examined and annotated to uphold data integrity. The investigation offers a Comparative evaluation of the performance of different AI models. This is in categorizing pneumonia as opposed to normal instances. The YOLOv8 model emerged as the leading performer, attaining an impressive mean average precision ($\mathbf{m A P}$) score of $\mathbf{9 7. 4 \%}$. demonstrating its potential for instantaneous, high-accuracy Diagnostic utilities: The results highlight the transformative influence of AI in clinical decision support systems (CDSS). streamlining prompt and accurate diagnoses that can substantially enhance patient outcomes. This manuscript aims to provide perspectives on the implementation of advanced AI models in healthcare, accentuating their capacity to revolutionize Pneumonia diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: A Novel IoT Framework for Smart Agriculture Using Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: This paper aims to explore the pertinence of future study and usage of IOT in dealing with the use of artificial intelligence in farming as one of the effective ways on how a better practices can be promoted in the farming sector. Consequently, the objective of this paper is to develop a new architecture for IoT usage that can be instituted systematically for monitoring and assessing productivity in the agricultural sector with a view of arriving at the right decision. The framework makes use of the best of what is currently available in machine learning for yield forecasting, the resource for example water and energy, among others. This was, in turn, followed by experiments and simulation and where differential features such as crop yield prediction, resource usage, and amongst others, were enhanced. Some of the suggested ideas have been owning to below 5% accuracy for the crop yield forecasts and lowering the usage of water by a quarter, and accurate detection of the temperature and relative humidity for integration of energy. Thus, one can suppose that the offered framework can be helpful in solving the problems connected with the management and sustainment if the resources for agriculture. For such reasons, the offered framework has a potential to redefine the contemporary agriculture since this framework offers actual advice to farmers.

articleTitle: Blood Cancer Diagnosis Using Pretrained VGG16 Transfer Learning Model with Lymphoma Dataset
abstract: This work presents a comprehensive study on classifying lymphoma subtypes using a VGG16 model. Lymphoma is a heterogeneous group of cancers originating from lymphocytes, and accurate classification of subtypes is crucial for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. The study utilises a deep learning approach with the VGG16 architecture to classify lymphoma subtypes based on histopathological images. The dataset, obtained from a Kaggle repository, comprises images of chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL), follicular lymphoma (FL), and mantle cell lymphoma (MCL). Data augmentation and preprocessing techniques are applied to enhance model performance, and the model’s architecture is optimised for improved classification accuracy. The results show high accuracy, with the model achieving an accuracy of 96.19% on the validation set and a test set accuracy of 95.20%. This underscores the effectiveness of accurately identifying lymphoma subtypes. The confusion matrix provides further insights into the model’s classification performance, highlighting areas for improvement. Overall, the study underscores the potential of deep learning models, particularly the VGG16 architecture, as valuable tools for the automated classification of lymphoma subtypes, with implications for improved clinical decision-making and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: RNN-Based Models for Predicting Seizure Onset in Epileptic Patients
abstract: Early management and better clinical outcomes for epileptic patients depend on seizure prediction. The accuracy and false alarm rates of existing systems are often compromised by their dependence on static thresholds and basic Electroencephalogram (EEG) properties. A novel Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)-based method for seizure start prediction is proposed in the article to overcome these limitations. As opposed to conventional techniques, the proposed system makes use of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to extract temporal correlations from unprocessed EEG data. It enables the system to adapt dynamically to the unique EEG patterns of each patient, improving prediction accuracy. The methodology of the system comprises thorough data collecting, preprocessing, and LSTM-based feature extraction. Annotated EEG datasets are then used for model training and validation. Results show a considerable reduction in false alarm rates (average of $\mathbf{6. 8 \%}$) and an improvement in prediction accuracy $(90.2 \%$ sensitivity, 88.9% specificity, and AUC-ROC of 93). Additionally, computational efficiency is significantly higher than that of existing systems (12 ms processing time, 45 MB memory consumption). About improving seizure prediction reliability, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed RNN-based strategy, opening up possibilities for its practical application to improve epilepsy treatment.

articleTitle: Unraveling Sugarcane Leaf Diseases: Combining Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forest for Enhanced Detection
abstract: It aims to tackle the crucial problem of anticipating the degree of severity of illnesses that affect sugarcane leaves, which is essential for carrying out prompt and efficient agricultural treatments. Using cutting-edge deep learning methods, everyone created a complex neural network architecture specifically for this purpose. It is made up of a carefully thought-out series of layers, each purposefully created to extract and condense important information from input photos of sugarcane leaves. Three convolutional layers, which have been meticulously constructed to decipher complex patterns suggestive of illness severity, occupy the center of human architecture. These layers process $128 \times 128$ pixel input images using three color channels, gradually improving the model’s comprehension with each repetition. A key factor in dimensionality reduction is the combined use of three maxpooling layers, which deliberately retain important information while eliminating unnecessary details. This deliberate reduction of spatial dimensions simplifies calculations and makes it easier to extract important elements that must be present for precise forecasts. This model’s core is a fully linked layer that functions as a hub for the synthesis of retrieved characteristics to produce accurate forecasts of illness severity levels. This model, which has an astounding $\mathbf{6 7, 5 2 0, 8 9 6}$ parameters, demonstrates an unmatched ability to learn from data, demonstrating its comprehension of the finer details of sugarcane disease of the leaves. This research highlights the profound potential of deep understanding in agricultural settings, providing a glimmer of hope for landowners facing difficulties in managing diseases. Through our work, they hope to further scientific understanding while simultaneously equipping those who work in agriculture with the know-how to protect crop health and guarantee food security for future generations.

articleTitle: AlcoNet: A Robust Deep Learning-based Framework for Detecting Alcoholism using EEG
abstract: Alcoholism is a profound disorder that represents a substantial concern for present-day society. If alcoholism is not diagnosed at an early stage, then it negatively impacts a patient’s life. Patients affected by alcoholism can face a variety of health complications, including kidney damage, cardiovascular issues, neurological and mental disorders, behavioural and social problems, digestive issues, immune system suppression, cancer risk, reproductive problems, and even death. Currently, there are no standard procedures for diagnosing alcoholism. The electroencephalogram (EEG) signal of the human brain has proven to be useful for diagnosing alcoholism. In this research, a deep learning-based methodology is adopted for classifying a subject into one of two classes, alcoholic or non-alcoholic, by analyzing EEG signals. A publicly available dataset containing EEG signals from both alcoholic and non-alcoholic (control) subjects is utilized for the research. The EEG data from both alcoholic and non-alcoholic subjects is filtered to remove noise. Then, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the dimensionality of the EEG data while preserving its key features. A hybrid deep learning model named AlcoNet, consisting of CNN (Convolution Neural Network) and BiLSTM (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) with attention mechanism, is designed and trained with PCA-transformed EEG data. The proposed model exhibited a mean accuracy level of 98.34%, showcasing that the proposed work achieved high accuracy in differentiating between the EEG signals of alcoholic and non-alcoholic subjects. The novelty of the research lies in: i) designing a novel deep learning model named ‘AlcoNet’ for automated detection of alcoholism using EEG, ii) incorporating attention mechanism to increase the classification performance of the designed ‘AlcoNet’ model.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Predictive Maintenance for Electric Vehicle Fleets
abstract: For operational effectiveness and cost savings, electric vehicle (EV) fleets must receive proper maintenance. However, reactive repairs and scheduled inspections are frequently the mainstays of traditional maintenance methods, which raises costs and results in more downtime. The predictive maintenance solution for electric vehicle fleets that the research proposes uses artificial intelligence (AI) and real-time data analysis to predict possible faults. The proposed system gathers and analyzes data from different car components to predict maintenance needs ahead of time by integrating IoT devices and machine learning techniques. Comparing the proposed system with existing systems, the study shows that it performs better in terms of accuracy (9 0%), lower rates of false positives (10) and negatives (5), and improved performance metrics (accuracy: 90%, precision: 88%, recall: 85%, F1-score: 86%). The proposed system presents a viable way to improve fleet management in electric vehicle operations, ensuring higher uptime, sustainability, and dependability. Higher cross-validation findings (average accuracy: 88%, average F1-score: 85% and improved maintenance effectiveness further support the claim.

articleTitle: Optimizing Music Genre Classification: A Hybrid Approach with ACO and Ensemble Learning
abstract: The classification of music genres accurately is an ongoing challenge due to the diverse and complex nature of music. Current methods can struggle to identify genres correctly. This study introduces a combination of ensemble learning and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) to better select features that are key to identifying music genres. Using a diversified collection of songs from Spotify, the research applies detailed data preparation before utilizing a Stacking Classifier framework, which brings together several base learners and an Extra Trees algorithm to improve prediction accuracy. This method achieved a $\mathbf{9 6. 7 5 \%}$ accuracy in classifying music genres, surpassing previous methods and advancing the field. The study also compares this new model with other innovative models, highlighting the effectiveness of using a mix of methods. These improvements have important implications for building better music recommendation systems that are both accurate and user-friendly, paving the way for future developments in automatic music analysis.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing: A Literature Survey of Approaches, Applications, Current Trends, and Future Directions
abstract: This comprehensive survey explores the diverse and rapidly evolving landscape of Natural Language Processing (NLP), covering foundational approaches and wide-ranging applications across various industries. NLP, which lies at the intersection of computer science, artificial intelligence, and linguistics, aims to enable machines to understand, interpret, and generate human language. The paper delves into methodologies such as rule-based systems, statistical models, neural networks, and hybrid techniques. The survey examines NLP’s pivotal roles in key sectors. In healthcare, it enhances patient care and medical research through data analysis. In finance, it aids in sentiment analysis, risk assessment, and fraud detection. Education benefits from automated grading and personalized learning. Detailed analyses highlight applications in customer service with chatbots, legal compliance through document automation, disaster risk mitigation via data processing, and social media analysis for sentiment tracking. The paper also identifies current challenges, such as handling ambiguous language and ensuring data privacy, and discusses emerging research trends like deep learning advancements and sophisticated language models. By illuminating these aspects, the survey underscores NLP’s transformative potential and provides valuable insights for further exploration in this dynamic field.

articleTitle: GestureNav: Eye and Facial Gesture-Based Cursor Control and Action Triggering
abstract: A novel human-computer interaction system using computer vision and machine learning to enable hands-free control of a computer using facial landmarks and gestures. The system integrates and combines OpenCV, MediaPipe, and PyAutoGUI to receive a real-time video feedback from a connected webcam,it works by extracting facial landmarks from the video feed and using this information to control the computer with accurate facial gestures.. The framework also incorporates text-to-speech capabilities using Google Text-to-Speech (gTTS) for auditory feedback and web automation with a web-browser module. Key functionality includes controlling the mouse cursor with eye movements, executing mouse clicks and triggering predefined web actions such as opening websites based on specific facial expressions. The functionality of the system is demonstrated by real-time applications, such as YouTube, Google AI and ChatGPT websites or any preferred website, based on the movement of specific facial landmarks. This new way approach highlights the potential of developing accessible and intuitive interfaces for users with motor impairments, providing a seamless and efficient way to interact with the digital environment.

articleTitle: Meta-Heuristic Algorithms for Optimizing Microgrid Energy Management: A Comparative Study
abstract: Energy is a scalar quantity that can be attributed to objects and systems, enabling them to perform work. It is crucial for powering industries, homes, and transportation systems.The energy sources used in modern times are a combination of renewable like solar, wind, hydro, biomass and non-renewable like coal, oil, natural gas. Vulnerabilities related to the supply, cost, and dependability of resources are referred to as energy insecurities. Resolving the escalating insecurity is indispensable. Resources might be allocated with consideration for energy demand, production, peak load, base load, seasonal variation, use of renewable and non-renewable energy, costs related to generation, transmission, and distribution, pollution levels, carbon emissions, storage system and grid integration. Microgrids are decentralized energy management systems that incorporate diverse energy resources. These systems can improve the overall performance by effectively balancing supply and demand, optimizing operating efficiency, and minimizing costs.Conventional optimization techniques frequently prove inadequate for handling the intricacy of contemporary systems. Robust alternatives are provided by meta-heuristic algorithms. Meta-heuristics techniques iteratively optimize by efficiently exploring vast solution spaces for nearoptimal solutions. The employed algorithms include Tabu Search (TS) and Simulated Annealing (SA). TS is a combinatorial optimization algorithm that uses memory to prevent revisiting previously explored solutions while SA is a probabilistic optimization algorithm inspired by the metallurgical process of annealing. The observation further explores how various hyper-parameters affect each algorithm’s performance. We also analyse certain challenges and prospects for further study in this field. This work provides important insights for researchers and practitioners interested in using meta-heuristics to energy insecurity optimization problems or any other relevant applications.

articleTitle: Behavioral Analysis in Video Streams: Towards Automated Suspicious Activity Detection
abstract: Improving safety precautions calls for automatic detection of suspicious activity in video feeds, but existing systems are frequently prone to mistakes and inefficiencies. The article offers a novel system that uses advanced behavioural analytical techniques to overcome these limitations. The proposed system achieves higher precision and efficacy by analysing item interactions and motion trajectories together with machine learning (ML) models that distinguish between normal and aberrant behaviour. Real-time monitoring capabilities enable prompt response to dubious actions, and thorough training ensures adaptability in a range of environments. Tests against the existing system demonstrate that the proposed system outperforms it in many different contexts and has a higher accuracy rate in identifying both normal and questionable activities. While having a little higher false positive rate ($\mathbf{1 2 \%}$ vs. 5%), the proposed system exceeds the competition in real-time detection speed (90 fps vs. 20 fps) and processing efficiency (120 fps vs. 80 fps). It recommends better security protocols and threat identification. Overall, the study is a milestone in surveillance technology as it emphasizes how effective sophisticated behavioural analysis is in assisting automatic detection of suspicious conduct.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Social Networks: A Dual Perspective on Positive and Negative Links
abstract: Social networks encompass a variety of relationships, from positive relationships such as friendships to negative associations such as opposition. Link prediction is very important in these networks, extending its usefulness beyond social sciences to information retrieval, bioinformatics, e-commerce, etc. This paper presents various aspects on link prediction and gives them ways and means of doing good and negative aspects of relationships. Different methods proposed by researchers deal with correlation prediction differently, some involving only positive correlations, some negative correlations, and some addressing both areas simultaneously. Through these methods by examining it, this paper aims to provide insights into the development of network forecasting and the importance of socially meaningful network dynamics at work. This research gives the details overview of link prediction with both positive and negative aspects.

articleTitle: An Innovative Approach to Detecting Fraud in E-Commerce Applications based on Anomaly Intrusion Detection Systems Using ALO-ELM Approach
abstract: Online shopping and selling has been increasingly popular in recent years. Along with the expansion of online transactions, the number of attacks targeting the safety of computer networks has also grown. In recent years, e-commerce sites and online auctions have seen an uptick in fraudulent transactions. Some of these bogus online purchases are the product of hackers breaking onto these platforms. The problem of application-based attacks in e-commerce remains unsolved, even though these facts have received a lot of attention. Model training, feature selection, and data preprocessing must all be executed in this particular order. Prior research on data sample analysis indicates that there are two possible issues with preprocessing that require fixing: multicollinearity and discretization. The study on feature selection aims to reduce noise, improve feature matrix differentiation, and eliminate mutual interference. Feature retrieval is the first step in training ALO-ELM models. When put side by side with two cutting-edge approaches, ALO and ELM, the suggested strategy comes out on top. Accuracy improved by 95.36 percent following application of the approach.

articleTitle: Employee Development and its Effect on Employee Performance a Conceptual Framework Using Psychological Empowerment Link Based on CNN-DELM Approach
abstract: The people that work for a firm are its greatest asset. The success or failure of the corporation is determined by the performance of its employees. This is why businesses are investing heavily in employee education and training programs. This system analyses the applicable theoretical framework and models to determine the effect of staff development on performance. The approach consists of three main steps: preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model. It used the preprocessing pattern to test data after obtaining it for training data. When choosing features, the latest Intensive Optimized PCA method is employed. It was the CNN-DELM model that the proposed approach used for training the model. In comparison to modern methods like CNN and ELM, this approach appears dated. A staggering $\mathbf{9 7 . 0 5 \%}$ accuracy percentage is revealed by the data, which is very remarkable.

articleTitle: Compact Deep Learning Architecture for Oral Cancer Classification
abstract: A compact deep learning model is designed to classify oral cancer based on histopathological images in this work. It has the capacity to learn varying quantities of contextual information by making use of image patches. The proposed model consists of four convolution layers and four sub-sampling layers to extract the features. It uses softmax classification in the fully connected layer for the classification. Because of its straightforward architecture, it is a lightweight model that is suitable for use in settings with limited access to resources and in which it may provide superior results in terms of the amount of space and time required. The performance is evaluated using 1224 histopathological images in two distinct resolutions. The first set has 528 images (100 x magnifications) and the second set has 696 images (400 x magnifications). Results prove that the proposed system provides an accuracy of $\sim 98.5 \%$ for both sets when data augmentation is employed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Techniques for Security of Healthcare Systems
abstract: The aim of this research is to examine the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) an Machine Learning (ML) methods for the security of healthcare systems. Starting with the historical background and works in this area, the research examines methods like anomaly detection, patterns and signs emergence, and risk prediction methods that are suitable to detect and prevent them. By providing a comprehensive overview of the machine learning algorithms like neural networks, decision trees, and clustering, the research proves that these technologies efficiently enhance the defense mechanisms of the healthcare system against cyber threats. Measurement indices which include Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score among others are tested on benchmarking scenarios which gives the researcher an understanding of the strengths as well as the weaknesses of these methodologies. It also incorporates comparative assessments with wellestablished reference techniques highlighting the need to integrate strong security protocols and advanced contingency plans for securing patients’ enclosed and critical health information and healthcare IT networks from emerging cyber threats.

articleTitle: Designing a Smart Healthcare System of Cardiovascular Disease using SMO Optimizer based Conditional GAN Network
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) denotes to conditions that disturb the heart and blood arteries. It is absolutely critical for the survival of life that the heart functions properly. Heart disease has become the leading basis of death. Worldwide, cardiovascular disease is thought to be the leading killer. The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that 17.9 million people died from cardiovascular illnesses in 2017. The perseverance of this scheme is to improve the accuracy of cardiac disease diagnoses by analyzing the heart disease dataset housed in the UCI Machine Repository. An optimization method has the potential to improve the sensitivity and accuracy of heart disease diagnostics. Optimization is the process of finding the best possible solution to a problem from a set of possible options. The objective of this paper is to develop a dynamic mapping relationship between the deployment of input data and output, and to usage a conditional deep convolutional generative adversarial network (CDC-GAN) classical to forecast the CVD. The features of the input data are extracted and the adversarial model is made more stable through the use of a deep convolutional network and a deconvolution network. The model’s training speed and accuracy are enhanced, and CVD is predicted dynamically. The study work employs the Spider Monkey Optimization Algorithm (SMOA) to fine-tune the parameters of CDC-GAN. When it comes to predicting the occurrence of heart disease, the trained CDC-GAN clearly outperforms the others. Experimental results reveal that while current methods only managed to get $\mathbf{8 5 \%}$ to $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$ of the metrics (precision, recall, accuracy, besides F -score), the suggested archetypal managed to get $\mathbf{9 3 \%}$ to $\mathbf{9 5 \%}$. As mentioned before, CDC-GAN is a great way to study how to forecast CVD events rapidly.

Author Keywords: Conditional deep convolutional generative adversarial network

articleTitle: American Sign Language (ASL) Detection using DenseNet201 Deep Learning Architecture
abstract: In this paper, deep learning techniques for the precise detection of hand signals in American Sign Language are presented, a necessary aid to communication and the relay of ideas between persons who are hard of hearing. For ordinary computation, earlier methods cannot do the job because of meagre precision and insufficient effectiveness, and consequently, more recent deep learning architectures must be investigated to achieve high accuracy. With the achievement of good results using DenseNet201, a new method of American Sign Language detection will be presented in this paper. A total of $\mathbf{2, 5 1 5}$ images of different hand gestures formed the database for testing and training in American Sign Language comprehension. The model was trained for 20 epochs at a batch size of $\mathbf{3 2}$ using the default parameters for learning rate settings. The front-ends of DenseNet 201 were designed and implemented with TensorFlow and Keras, a system based purely on transfer learning from pre-trained ImageNet weights. Fine-tuning the model with hand gesture dataset information as familiar input, arbitrary hand gestures could be more perfectly identified by the program. The proposed DenseNet201 model has a high accuracy rate: testing on the testing set only $\mathbf{9 7 \%}$. This high accuracy indicates that it is feasible to solve American Sign Language hand gesture detection with this deep learning architecture. The experimental results reported in this paper have important practical implications for assistive technology in aid of the hearing-impaired. A system for detecting American Sign Language was developed with DenseNet201 effectively promoting communication and the integration of persons with hearing impairment into society. Success like this shows the potential for deep learning to offer new solutions in a variety of fields very successfully.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Smart Healthcare Systems for Remote Patient Monitoring and Management
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has come to stay in healthcare whereby this advanced technology has drastically changed remote patient monitoring and management which has paved way for enhanced effective, affordable and patient centered approach to care delivery. This paper describes IoT-based smart health care system to improve the quality and effectiveness of patient care through the integration of wearable devices and sensors that are used to monitor the patient’s health status in real-time. The collected data is transmitted through secure data networks to the cloud-analysis blocks in which sophisticated analytical algorithms work to analyze the available data and provide suitable information. As illustrated in the result section, obtained results show that there is a enhancement of previous systems by up to $\mathbf{1 5 \%}$ on monitoring accuracy, that the response time for data processing has been reduced by $\mathbf{2 5}$ milliseconds and that there is a $\mathbf{2 0 \%}$ increase in patients satisfaction. It also has the ability of outputting a $\mathbf{3 0 \%}$ decrease on false alarms and a decrease of 15% on total healthcare expenses. These findings come as a proof that IoT has a capability of revolutionizing healthcare through early identification of risky conducts and timely medical treatments.

articleTitle: An optimization Method for Cloud Load Balancing using a Hybrid Oppositional Forgetting Learning (OFL) based Crow Search Algorithm and Fractional Dragonfly Algorithms (HOFL-CS-FDA)
abstract: There is an unbalance in resource usage in the cloud environment due to uneven user requests. As a result of the unbalanced Virtual Machine (VM), the cloud server is not being fully utilized to its capabilities, which forced the researchers to implement a load balancing algorithm. Through load balancing algorithms, resource utilization can be optimized, throughput can be maximized, response times can be reduced, costs can be reduced, and workload overload can be prevented. Our research introduces Oppositional Forgetting Learning (OFL) based Crow Search algorithms and Fractional Dragonfly Algorithms (HOFL-CS-FDA) for load balancing in a clustered cloud environment. We designed this hybrid combination to work with two probabilities: Task Selection Probability (TSP) and VM Selection Probability (VSP). As part of this research, a multi-objective model is used to select the most suitable VM for migration. This multi-objective model that acts as a fitness criterion for the HOFL-CS-FDA optimization algorithm. By examining the load status in each VM, our proposed algorithm can propose a load balancing strategy. The algorithm transfers the allocated task to a less loaded virtual machine when its load goes beyond a certain threshold. Using fitness criteria, the optimization algorithm chooses the virtual machine (VM) to migrate the tasks. Avoiding local optima and improving convergence accuracy are achieved with the use of Oppositional Forgetting Learning (OFL) based Crow search (CS) algorithm, which integrates forgetting mechanisms and opposition-based learning. We compare the outcomes with several state-of-the-art methods after simulating the proposed algorithms in various cloud settings. Based on the simulation findings, we know that HOFL-CS-FDA reallocates 6 jobs and produces a load value of ${0. 1 3 1 3}$. The minimal load value of 0.1023 and minimum number of tasks value of 4 were both achieved by the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Automotive Power Train based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm for Maintaining Diversity
abstract: In order to solve the challenge of multi-objective optimization of automotive power train, in view of the shortcomings of the existing improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, an innovative multi-objective optimization method for power train based on adaptive diversity-preserving genetic algorithm is proposed. This new scheme uses the principle of overlapping sub-problem theory to accurately identify and locate the key influencing factors, and accordingly carries out a wise classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, by using the unique mechanism of adaptive genetic algorithm to maintain diversity, this scheme cleverly constructs a multi-objective design strategy for the drive train. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows a significant improvement compared with the traditional improved particle swarm optimization in terms of the accuracy of multi-objective optimization of the power train and the processing efficiency of key factors, showing its obvious strong advantages. In automobiles, power train multi-objective optimization plays a crucial role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of automotive power train multi-objective optimization. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional improved particle swarm algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of multi-objective optimization of power train optimized by adaptive genetic algorithm to maintain diversity, and accurately controls the influencing parameters through the theory of overlapping sub-problems, and uses this as the road map for index allocation, and then uses the adaptive genetic algorithm to maintain diversity to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the multi-objective optimization of the automotive power train, the simulation scheme based on the adaptive genetic algorithm for maintaining diversity successfully overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional improved particle swarm optimization and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of the simulation.

Author Keywords: adaptive genetic algorithm for maintaining diversity

articleTitle: Leveraging Multi-Model Gradient Boosting Techniques for Workforce Enablement: A Transparent Framework for Task Management and Issue Resolution
abstract: In the rapidly shifting workplace environment, fostering an inspiring and dynamic atmosphere is essential for organizational success. This paper introduces an innovative Workforce Enhancement Platform designed to improve transparency, teamwork, and communication within the team. The platform employs state-of-the-art techniques for analyzing textual data, utilizing Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM) such as XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost, to evaluate and categorize worker-submitted issues. It features a comprehensive data cleaning procedure to remove extraneous elements like markup and special symbols, followed by converting the processed text into actionable features using methods such as term frequency and inverse document frequency. Central to the system is the application of GBM algorithms, which detect and classify the emotional tone of the reports, distinguishing between positive and negative sentiments. Furthermore, the platform incorporates advanced data visualization tools to provide an in-depth analysis of model performance, including accuracy metrics, confusion matrices, and feature importance evaluations. By optimizing the identification and classification of workplace issues, the platform facilitates effective resolution, fostering a setting of innovation and teamwork. The main goal of the platform is to boost staff engagement and support by addressing challenges proactively, thereby promoting both individual growth and collective progress. This comprehensive approach ensures that team members’ feedback is acknowledged and valued, ultimately contributing to a more positive and productive organizational environment.

articleTitle: Efficient Thermal Pollution Management in Water Bodies through Cloud-Based Monitoring and XGBoost
abstract: Thermal pollution is a major ecological concern for water bodies across the globe, and there is no way to control it. To effectively regulate thermal pollution in bodies of water, this research suggests a new method that uses cloudbased monitoring integrated with XGBoost, an advanced machine learning algorithm. Comprehensive environmental monitoring is made possible by the integration of cloud-based monitoring systems, which allow for the collection of data in real-time. To evaluate the data obtained and precisely forecast the levels of thermal pollution, XGBoost is used, which is renowned for its outstanding predictive skills. There are several benefits to the suggested method. Timely identification of thermal pollution situations is made possible with cloudbased monitoring, which provides continuous data collection. Additionally, using XGBoost to increase prediction accuracy makes proactive management strategies possible. To reduce the negative impact of thermal pollution on aquatic ecosystems, the system analyzes data and provides stakeholders with actionable insights. These insights may then be used to perform targeted interventions. Potential techniques for effective thermal pollution control in bodies of water. Proactive and data-driven decision-making is made possible by this unique technology, which promotes sustainable environmental conversion and helps aquatic ecosystems stay healthy.

articleTitle: Preserving Information Integrity: Analyzing the Impact of Deepfake Videos on Social Media Trust and Security
abstract: The proliferation of deepfake videos on social media has raised huge issues about disinformation, identity manipulation, and fraud. Advanced AI techniques now enable the creation of pretty convincing fake films, posing threats to character and countrywide security, eroding consider in digital media, and undermining online discourse. This research paper aims to develop a strong deepfake detection set of rules that leverages superior laptop vision and device getting to know strategies to accurately pick out manipulated films on social media. We will look at the unfold of deepfakes throughout social media platforms, examine their effect on on line discourse, and evaluate the effectiveness of our detection set of rules on numerous platforms. Furthermore, we will provide insights and recommendations for social media organizations, policymakers, and users to mitigate the dangers associated with deepfakes. Our last intention is to make contributions to a safer and greater honest on line surroundings with the aid of combating the spread of deepfakes and disinformation. The study will include a comprehensive literature evaluation on deepfake detection and social media vulnerabilities, experiments and analyses on a massive dataset of deepfake and real motion pictures, visualizations and information illustrating the spread and effect of deepfakes, and an assessment of our detection algorithm’s performance the use of metrics such as accuracy, precision, consider, and F1-score. Relevant legal guidelines, rules, and ethical guidelines related to deepfakes and social media may also be cited.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks based Handwritten Signature Verification using Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: Signatures are unique forms of identity that are used especially in the authentication of documents. Although, there are ways to increase accuracy in verification including fingerprint scanning, retina scanning, face and voice recognition, it comes with the cost of extra hardware. One of the major difficulties in signature verification is the within class variability of offline signature where even the trained signers are unable to reproduce the same signatures repeatedly. Such fluctuations complicate distinguishing real signatures from fakes with the help of traditional methods of checking the authenticity of signatures. To overcome this problem, methods like machine learning algorithms and deep neural networks are used. Multilayer perceptrons and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) may provide effective solutions for the image classification problem inherent in signature verification. The goal of this research isto design a dependable technology to detect the authenticity of signatures. CNNs and binary classifiers were applied to preprocessed signature images which include genuine and fake signatures. All the proposed works have been implemented and tested on different datasets while varying the signature type and readability. Our implementation included the use of CNN to classify these datasets and generate useful results.
