The performance of the proposed method was evaluated using datasets from the GPDS Synthetic Signature Database and presented. The proposed research shows how deep learning networks can perform well in identifying forged signatures thereby playing a critical role in the fight against signature forgery.

articleTitle: Image Restoration with Noise Diffusion: Recovering Lost Clarity and Details
abstract: Image enhancement is a crucial task in various domains, including photography, medical imaging, and surveillance. However, existing methods often struggle to effectively address both noise reduction and resolution enhancement simultaneously. This paper proposes a novel approach that merges a custom-built diffusion model with the Enhanced Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Network (ESRGAN) to achieve comprehensive image enhancement. The diffusion model is employed for efficient noise removal, while ESRGAN is utilized for high-quality super-resolution. By integrating these two powerful techniques, we create a synergistic effect that amplifies the benefits of each model, leading to superior image quality. The merged model is finetuned on a diverse dataset to ensure optimal performance across various scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in enhancing image quality, outperforming in-dividual models in both noise reduction and resolution enhancement tasks. The proposed method offers versatility and can be deployed in real-time applications, which makes it a valuable tool for practitioners and researchers in the field of image processing.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation Method of H Voltage Switch State based on FCM Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional Whale algorithm in study on the evaluation method of partial discharge state of high voltage switch gear, a research scheme of study on the evaluation method of local discharge state based on FCM algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through Circular dispensing theories, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the FCM algorithm is used to construct a research scheme for study on the evaluation method of local discharge state. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional Whale algorithm in terms of research accuracy and processing time of influencing factors of study on the evaluation method of local discharge state, and has obvious advantages. The research of study on the evaluation method of local discharge state plays an extremely important role in high tension switch gear, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth characteristics and product generation of high tension switch gear. However, the traditional Whale algorithm has some limitations in solving the problem of assessment of discharge status simulation, especially when dealing with complex problems. In this paper, this paper proposes a research scheme of study on the evaluation method of local discharge state based on FCM algorithm to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through Circular dispensing theories, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses the FCM algorithm to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the simulation scheme based on FCM algorithm in study on the evaluation method of partial discharge state of high voltage switch gear can better solve the limitations of traditional Whale algorithm and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Driven Real-Time Facial Recognition for Enhanced Security
abstract: The purpose of this investigation is to investigate the operation of deep literacy methods for real-time facial recognition to improve detection systems. The approach that has been described seeks to attain high delicacy and effectiveness in facial recognition tasks by making use of advanced neural networks, more notably convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The purpose of the system is to reuse videotape aqueducts in real-time, so linking and vindicating individualities with a minimum of quiescence. Some of the most important aspects include facial recognition, point birth, and matching algorithms that are optimized for both speed and delicacy. The resilience of the system is demonstrated through extensive experiments under a variety of settings, including but not limited to diverse lighting, angles, and occlusion scenarios. According to the findings, there has been a substantial improvement in recognition rates when compared to the conventional methods, which highlights the possibility of a profound level of language proficiency in security operations. The purpose of this study is to provide a foundation for further breakthroughs in the field of face recognition technology by highlighting the feasibility and effectiveness of installing facial recognition systems that are powered by deep literacy in real-world security contexts.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Non-Contact Live Detection Technology for High-Voltage Circuit Breaker Based on Eddy Current Change
abstract: With the continuous growth of power system capacity, the number of power control and protection highvoltage circuit breakers has greatly increased. The reliability of high-voltage circuit breaker as the connection link between power and electrical equipment is of great significance to ensure the safe operation of power system. The performance test of high-voltage circuit breaker is mainly related to the preventive test of equipment and regular maintenance during power failure, so as to replace the mechanical performance test of parts and operating mechanism. Experience shows that frequent operation and excessive overhaul will reduce the reliability of high-voltage circuit breaker. Therefore, it is very important to implement fault diagnosis or monitoring of high-voltage circuit breaker, timely understand the situation, grasp the characteristics and trends of operation, and improve the reliability of operation. Non-contact live detection technology is a new type of non-contact detection equipment for high-voltage circuit breakers. It can detect whether there is live current in the circuit through the electric field generated by the small metal plate connected to the surface of the circuit breaker. The principle and working principle are as follows: when the highvoltage current passes through the metal plate, it will generate an electric field that can be detected by the antenna. Compared with other types of contact detection equipment, non-contact live detection technology has many advantages and benefits, such as no need for any special training or skills.

articleTitle: Cell Imbalance Prediction in Autonomous Vehicle Battery Management System using CSA Based Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Cell balancing is an essential component of the battery management system (BMS), which is used to increase the lifespan and run time of the batteries. Various cell balancing strategies are being addressed to meet the rising need for larger and superior performance of battery packs. Passive cell balancing systems are expensive and complex, requiring extra components and standby power loss. However, it faces thermal challenges and high balancing time, making them less feasible in fast charging scenarios. To overcome these problems, an autonomous vehicle cell’s battery imbalances are efficiently predicted using the CSA-based MNN technique. Initially, data for processing is collected from the eVTOL battery dataset and pre-processed using missing completely at random (MCAR) for missing value replacement. MaxAbsScaler normalization is used to standardize input dataset values. Then, Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) is then used to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset. Finally, the Chameleon Swarm Algorithm based Multilayer Neural Network (CSA-MNN) technique is utilized to predict imbalances in autonomous vehicle cells. A simulation study shows that the proposed technique attains $\mathbf{9 4. 6} \%$ accuracy, $\mathbf{0. 0 6 3} \%$ MSE, $\mathbf{0. 1 6 4 \%}$ MAE, and $\mathbf{9 2. 4 \%}$ precision. For OBEVBM, the battery cell performance voltage reaches 5V. Therefore, the proposed method can significantly predict the battery cell imbalance in autonomous vehicle.

articleTitle: Towards Precise Peach Disease Detection: Leveraging PCNN with Enhanced Activation and AFHOA Fine-Tuning
abstract: Many innovations in farming and manufacturing have helped the world’s seven billion inhabitants get the food they need. Diseases and pests provide the greatest risk to food products because they reduce both the number besides quality of food. Various methodical methods have been devised to enhance food production while also reducing the risk of pests and illnesses affecting plants and fruits. The diagnosis of diseases is still dependent on human skill and manual labor when using these techniques. These past ten years have seen widespread usage of AI for the automation of various tasks, including harvesting in agriculture. Processing photos and identifying things using Machine Learning procedures is gaining popularity. We can automate harvesting by identifying plant diseases using Machine Learning algorithms; this will allow us to grow more food while cutting down on crop losses. Using the parallel convolution neural network (PCNN) suggested in this paper to detect peach disease traits—using the improved elu activation function rather than the traditional ReLu activation function—we first create an image denoising procedure to mitigate the impact of the complicated background on the images. Next, the classification accuracy is enhanced by fine-tuning the hyper-parameters of PCNN using the Archerfish hunting optimizer (AFHOA) model. This method proved effective for peach disease diagnosis, as evidenced by the results of 25513 photos. The greatest detection accuracy for black spot, peach was almost 92% to 96% accordingly.

articleTitle: Modern Techniques for Ancient Art: Deep Learning in Rock Art Motif Classification
abstract: Rock art motifs are painted or carved on the stones. They represent a wide range of subjects,animals, humans, symbols, and abstract designs. They usually provide clarity into the beliefs and daily lives of the ancient human ancestors. These rock art motifs are present around the globe, representing their own unique culture. Traditional methods of analyzing rock art involves heavy field work, photographic documentation, manual classification by experts, and are also resource-intensive. This research utilizes deep learning techniques such as Convolutional neural network, Efficient-Net, and Res-Net for the automatic classification of rock art motifs. Deep learning is the subset of the ML that uses a neural network with many layers to automatically learn and extract complex patterns from large datasets. CNN, along with efficient-net and Res-Net(Residual net), have had a remarkable success in the image classification domain. CNN is the type of deep learning technique designed for analyzing image dataset. They have a number of Convolutional layers and pooling layers to help with data abstraction. Efficient-Net is a deep learning technique for image classification which uses the compound scaling techniques. Res-Net is also a deep learning technique used for image classification, which has residual blocks and identity mapping. Advancements in technology offer promising solutions to these challenges. This intends to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of classifying rock art images, providing archaeologists with a powerful tool to preserve and understand our culture. The result of this research extends to archaeology, art history and ancient culture which helps other researchers for future study.

articleTitle: An analysis on Financial Statement Fraud Detection for Listed Companies using DCNN-LSTM-AE-AM Model
abstract: Financial fraud is a huge problem all over the world and has a negative impact on the growth of financial markets. It is challenging to identify frauds with a heavily skewed dataset since there are so many legitimate firms compared to fraudulent ones. Algorithms that can intelligently detect financial statement fraud have so been created to assist stakeholders in making decisions. Therefore, this research aims to improve financial statement fraud detection by integrating numerical data with cutting-edge deep learning algorithms. It is important to perform data preparation, feature extraction, and model training in this specific order. Fraud detection for narratives in annual reports is a part of data preprocessing that includes establishing a library of fraudulent feature terms and clustering yearly reports. Methods for Evaluating Vocabulary Similarity rely on feature extraction. Training DCNN-LSTMAE-AM models begins with feature retrieval. The suggested approach achieves better results than two state-of-the-art methods: LSTM and DCNN. After using the method, accuracy went up by $\mathbf{9 7. 4 8 \%}$.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms is used for the Design and Improvement of Low-Temperature SCR Catalysts
abstract: In order to solve the challenges of designing and improving low-temperature SCR catalysts for chemicals, in view of the shortcomings of the Learning sting AHP algorithms, this study proposes an innovative design and improvement method of low-temperature SCR catalysts based on machine Learning algorithms. This new scheme uses the principles of statistical information theory to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly performs a sensible classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, using the unique mechanism of machine Learning algorithm, the design strategy of low-temperature SCR catalyst is cleverly constructed. The empirical results show that this scheme shows significant improvement compared with the traditional AHP algorithm in terms of key performance indicators such as the accuracy of the design and improvement of the low-temperature SCR catalyst, and the processing efficiency of key factors, showing its obvious advantages. In chemical products, the design and improvement of low-temperature SCR catalysts play a crucial role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of the design and improvement of low-temperature SCR catalysts for chemical products. However, when faced with complex simulation tasks, traditional AHP algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of designing and improving the low-temperature SCR catalyst optimized by machine science Learning algorithm, and accurately controls the influencing parameters through statistical information theory, and uses this as a road map for index allocation, and then uses machine Learning algorithm to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the design and improvement of low-temperature SCR catalysts for chemicals, the simulation scheme based on machine Learning algorithm successfully overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional AHP algorithm and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of the simulation.
